name: “Younger Sister Aura” Sicily
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, choose a character facing this card, and that character gets -1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Big Brother, do you need to go to the bathroom before we leave?

name: Death Emizel
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your opponent's hand is four or less, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's stock.
flavor: As Death, I will reap……your soul.

name: Kyoko Needleworker
text: 【CONT】 If your opponent does not have any climax in the waiting room, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: That’s our lady! A model delinquent!

name: Childhood Friend Raspberyl
text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Overlord Mao" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Overlord Mao" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: But I won’t let go of these hands! That’s the bond between me and you!

name: Fallen Angel Flonne
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Demon》 characters in front of this card get +1 level and +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your 《Demon》 characters, that character gets +1000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Sir Laharl, do your best for the things that were stolen from us!

name: Salvatore the Magnificent
text: 【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot move to another position on the stage.
flavor: I command you! Show me your true strength!

name: Legendary Chief Graduate, Beryl
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card attacks, if a card named "And have become legend……" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put that character into his or her stock.
flavor: Asuka: "Your perfect attendance shall continue to shine radiantly throughout the history of this school!"

name: Overlord Laharl
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.
【AUTO】 Encore [(2)] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor:
Haaaahahaha!!
Now I'll get to show up more often!!

name: Netherworld Honor Student, Mao
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into the waiting room from your stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Brave》 character or character with "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: ……Now, how do I want to cook him? Hahaha……

name: “Big Sis” Fuka
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your other 《Clone》 characters, and that character gets +1 level and +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're gonna protect me, right?

name: Pampered Child, Emizel
text: 【CONT】 If your opponent has a climax on his or her climax area, the character facing this card gets -1 soul.
flavor:
Call me Sir Emizel.
The only son of the President, Sir Emizel!!

name: Special Assassination Task Force Leader, Emizel
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. Search your deck for up to X 《Death》 characters, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand and shuffle your deck. Choose X cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of climax cards revealed among those cards.
flavor: Shut up! I'm not a weakling!!

name: Girl in a Prinny Cap, Fuka
text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] This card gets +1 level and +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Hmhmhm! There you are!

name: Like a Picnic, Sicily
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is four or less, your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: I can bring up to 300 HL's worth of snacks, right?

name: “Overlord's Spot” Sicily
flavor:
My name is Sicily.
I'm here to become the Overlord!

name: Middle Schooler Who Fell to Hades, Fuka
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, and return it to his or her deck. If you do, shuffle your opponent's deck, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: This is war! A war to rid my dream of all demons and make it more fantastical and girly! A battle for freedom and youth!

name: Netherworld President Jr, Emizel
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other characters get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put this card into your waiting room] When a card named "Vow of the Phoenix" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Death Emizel" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: I will become a great demon all on my own!!

name: Package from Celestia, Sicily
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your stock] When a card named "Birth of a New Overlord" is put into your waiting room from your climax area, if your opponent does not have any other characters in his or her center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Overlord” Sicily" in your waiting room, and put it on this card's previous stage position as 【REST】.
flavor: It's time for my secret weapon finisher.

name: Adell & Rozalin
flavor: Rozalin: "You love the thrill of battle, don't you?"

name: President Raspberyl
text:
【AUTO】 When you use "Brainstorm", if a climax is put into the waiting room by that effect, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is canceled, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
My manifisto requires everyone to do one good turn daily!
Soon enough, this Netherworld is gonna be filled with delinquents!!

name: “Overlord” Sicily
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room].
flavor: Yes! That means I'm the Overlord now, right?

name: Mao & Raspberyl
flavor: Raspberyl: "Mao and I are enemies, and friends! We're not strangers in the least!!"

name: Delinquent Student, Raspberyl
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is less than your opponent's hand, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: Why not forget this evil stuff for now and do a little something good with me?

name: Sexy Demon Wish, Hanako
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Adell isn't alone! Hanako is here for him!

name: Majin Etna
text: 【CONT】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is four or more, this card gets +1 soul.
flavor: Ohh, no no no. That wasn't even a warm-up. That was just to show you how strong and beautiful I am.

name: Geoffrey
text: 【CONT】 Alarm When this card is the top card of your clock, all of your characters get the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's stock."
flavor: Hmhmhm... ... Good thing I thought this might happen―――

name: Battle Maniac, Adell
text: 【ACT】 [ICON:C-ICON] Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor:
I can't let you do that!
Abandoning a friend just isn't my style!

name: Overthrow! God of All Overlords!
text: Choose up to five cards in your waiting room except climax cards, and return them to your deck. Shuffle your deck afterwards. If you returned five cards, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +5000 power and +2 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Adell: ". . . My goal is to defeat Zenon."

name: Strongest Overlord
text: Choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, and return it to your opponent's deck. If you do, shuffle your opponent's deck, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it into his or her stock.
flavor:
Are you all ready?
We're off to search for Tyrant Overlord Baal!

name: Important… Allies?
text: Choose a card in your waiting room, and return it to your deck. Shuffle your deck afterwards. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: Raspberyl: "Hehehe, then you better remember that stuffiness was friendship."

name: Battle Arena Begins!
text: [ICON:C-ICON] All of your characters get +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Usagi: "Great fighters can expect to be rewarded with fame, and may even test their skill by challenging Overlord Zenon himself."

name: And trust this!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Adell: "I'm gonna say it again. You are not alone."

name: Prinny Wars
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I'll annihilate you and all of the Prinnies! It'll be total annihilation! For all of you!

name: To my lab---!!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Mao: "You're a rare subject."

name: And have become legend……
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3 soul until end of turn.
flavor: ――Raspberyl's accomplishments are told and retold for generations to come――

name: Vow of the Phoenix
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I wanna earn the recognition I deserve with my own power.

name: Birth of a New Overlord
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: "Over the next few thousand years, Angel Overlord Sicily became a legend who was talked about for all eternity."

name: “Aloof Majin” Etna
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Prinny》 or have "Etna" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Like I said before, I don't need, nor do I want, an older brother.

name: Unemployed Etna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Supreme Overlord Girl" is in your climax area, all of your characters get +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Okay, Prince. Are you happy now?

name: Tyrant Etna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck, and all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Hmph. Killing all these stupid things was just a waste of time.

name: Evangelist of Love, Flonne
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: I, Flonne, The Fallen Angel of Love, will not allow this angel bullying to stand!

name: Thief Angel, Artina
text: 【AUTO】 [【REST】 two of your 【STAND】 characters] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."
flavor: Of course, I've been praying since the beginning.

name: Archangel, Flonne
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 2 or higher characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 two of your characters] Search your deck for up to one 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 or 《Love》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
It's...LOVE!!!!
Praying will become the power of love!!

name: Cute Little Demon, Etna
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of characters you have with "Assist".
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, search for up to one 《Demon》 or 《Prinny》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Wasn't that nice of them, Prince? They gave us their tickets.

name: Awakened Angel, Pure Flonne
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of your other 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 characters is three or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor:
On Netherworld soil, where evil looms, an ephemeral flower blooms!
Pure Flonne the Awakened Angel?(黒いハート)

name: Pringer X
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【CONT】 Great Performance (When your opponent attacks, if this card is in the middle position of your center stage and not 【REVERSE】, your opponent frontal attacks this card instead)
【ACT】 [Put one of your other 《Prinny》 characters from the stage underneath this card as a marker] This card gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Etna: "The Pringer X is created when Prinnies master the art of fighting, lose themselves, and then combine into one!"

name: Big Sis Prinny
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Laharl(ラハール)" in its card name get +500 power.
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power and 《Love》.
flavor:
He has suffered enough already……
My silence is how I show my love.

name: Laharl & Etna
text: 【AUTO】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is four or more, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor:
Etna: "Ohh! That's our Prince!
You're so ruthless."

name: Super Alloy Great Flonzor X
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck, and this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Archangel Flonne: "To protect the beautiful blue Earth! It comes from another dimension! The unstoppable power of love and prayers!!"

name: Young Etna
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +1 level.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your characters with "Overlord(魔王)" in its card name, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: I don't have any more food. If you want some more, you'll have to steal some on your own.

name: Angel Trainee Flonne
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get 《Love》.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Supreme Overlord Laharl" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Supreme Overlord Laharl" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: This is love.

name: Ordinary Cleric
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Feel free to call me if you get hurt.

name: Petty Thief
text: 【ACT】 [(2)] Choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, until end of turn, that character gets -1500 power and this character gets +1500 power.
flavor: Hello! It's me, your friendly burglar♪

name: Flonne, the Love Maniac
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Love》 characters or characters with "Love(愛)" in its card name get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When a card named "Even a Demon Needs Love" is placed in your climax area, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Don't worry! The power of friendship will lead you to victory!

name: Supreme Overlord Baal
text: 【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +10000 power, +2 soul, and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's clock."
flavor:
The Lord of Terror, Baal…...
The Legend was true…...

name: Nurse, Altina
text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Tyrant, Valvatorez" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Tyrant, Valvatorez" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: If you'd like mine, go ahead.

name: Judge Nemo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may choose a card in your opponent's clock, and put it into your opponent's waiting room. If you do, put the top card of your opponent's deck into his or her clock.
flavor:
I'm not a criminal.
I was born to judge humanity's sins.

name: Nice-Bodied Etna
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, return it to your opponent's deck, and your opponent shuffles his or her deck.
flavor: I'm not giving in about being Nice-Bodied!!!!

name: Mystery Demon, Xenolith
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your 《Demon》 characters is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I used to live here with my sister.

name: Player 2, Etna
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Demon》 or 《Prinny》 characters get +500 power.
flavor:
Wh-What the hell!?
I look like I'm Player 2!?

name: Samurai Legend
flavor: I choose to live by the way of the sword.

name: Trespasser from Celestia, Artina
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is four or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Please wait for me, Lady Archangel. I've almost reached my goal.

name: Unkind Demon, Etna
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +1 level, +4000 power and +1 soul.
【AUTO】 [Put a card named "Siblings' Conversation" face down underneath this card as a marker] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if there are no markers underneath this card, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your next stand phase.
flavor: But in return, you're going to have to do whatever I say for the rest of my life.

name: Elusive, Artina
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your encore step, if you have a card named "Demon and Angel Bond" in your climax area, 【REST】 this card, and move it to any position of your stage. (You may choose the current position)
flavor: Hmhmhm. Good day, everyone.

name: “Out-of-control Artifact” Xenolith
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: Dumbfounded Etna
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose two of your 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 them.
flavor:
*sigh* There she goes again.
Whaddaya wanna do, Prince?

name: Prinny Squad
text:
【CONT】 You can put any number of cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【ACT】 [Put a 《Prinny》 character into your waiting room] Choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Etna: "Come on, Prinny Squad!!"
Etna: "Get your butts out here, NOW!!"

name: Genius Magic Knight
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, and return it to his or her deck. If you do, shuffle your opponent's deck, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I will become the sword of everyone from now onwards.

name: Etna & Flonne
text: 【ACT】 [ICON:C-ICON] Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor:
Etna: "Hey, have you got flowers for brains?"
Flonne: "Oh, well I just adore pretty little flowers."

name: Space Detective Guardian Flonne
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Assassin from Celestia" is in your climax area, all of your characters get +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 one of your characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Let the people's cheers bring you courage!
Trannnnsforrrrrrrmmmmm! Guardian Flonne!!

name: Helplessly Useless Archer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
My hobby is shooting at vital points.
My forte is these awesome curls.
Let's all get curly!

name: Seraph Lamington
flavor:
Demons certainly have love inside of them.
They just haven't found it yet.

name: Winged Slayer
text:
Perform the following action until you level up. "Put the top card of your deck into your clock."
All of your opponent's characters get -3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: A devastating strike from the sky

name: They are all mine
text: Choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, and return it to his or her deck. If you do, shuffle your opponent's deck, and put two cards from the top of your deck into your stock.
flavor: I'll kill anyone who would steal my sweets!!

name: Conspiracy of the School Board
text: Choose two of your characters, and 【REST】 them. If you 【REST】 two characters, all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Who are you!? I was about to begin a re-education program.

name: Bow Revival!
text: [ICON:C-ICON] Choose up to five cards in your waiting room except climax cards, and return them to your deck. Shuffle your deck afterwards. If you returned five cards, choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, and that character gets -1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Finally… I have finally returned!

name: Supreme Overlord Girl
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, put the top card of your deck into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: The world is mine!!

name: Siblings' Conversation
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: ……Stupid Big Brother.

name: Even a Demon Needs Love
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: If there's love in your life, you just can't help but smile.

name: Assassin from Celestia
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Ｎｉｃｅ ｔｏ ｍｅｅｔ ｙｏｕ． Ｉ’ｍ ａｎ ａｓｓａｓｓｉｎ~

name: Demon and Angel Bond
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Valvatorez: "Woman…… why did you protect me?"

name: Most Evil Overlord, Laharl
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Overlord Passing Through" is in your climax area, until end of turn, this card gets +3000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may deal one damage to your opponent." (This damage may be canceled)
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]
flavor: I'll agree to join you as long as I get three meals a day.!

name: Laharl & Mao
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose a climax in your opponent's waiting room, and return it to his or her deck. If you do, shuffle your opponent's deck, and this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
flavor:
Laharl: "Whoever loses is the real legendary Overlord! Got it !?"
Mao: "Bring it!"

name: “Power of Sardines” Valvatorez
text: 【CONT】 If the number of your other characters is one or less, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot become 【REVERSE】 from your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effect."
flavor: How magical─── Are these insignificant creatures, known as sardines!!!

name: Werewolf Butler, Fenrich
text: 【CONT】 If the number of your other characters is one or less, all of your other characters get +1500 power.
flavor: My Lord……! Do not be so rash in making so many futile promises!

name: Reborn Krichevskoy
text:
【CONT】 You can put any number of cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Garungun: "He is the newest and evilest Overlord in New Netherworld history, New King Krichevskoy!"

name: Dominating Presence of Netherworld, Laharl
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
flavor: Haaahahahaha!!

name: Tyrant, Valvatorez
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your other 《Demon》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: My pride will not allow me to indulge in the blood of a human who possesses no fear of demons.

name: Likes Superhero Shows, Flonne
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", put the top three cards of all players' decks into the waiting room.
【ACT】 [ICON:C-ICON] Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Look at that crowd of demons.

name: Supreme Overlord Laharl
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【ACT】 [Put this card into your memory] Choose up to two 《Angel》 or 《Demon》 characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: ……What fool dares awaken me, the great Laharl?

name: Former Angel Flonne
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Demon》 characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, if the number of climax in your waiting room is four or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Attack! Attack!! Attack!!!

name: “Dark Adonis”Mid-Boss
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck, and you may deal one damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled) 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may return this card to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck.
flavor: Mid-Boss: "But, do not foolishly think that I am an ordinary mid-boss." Etna: "Hey! You just admitted that you're a mid-boss."

name: Caretaker of Prinnies, Fenrich
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Prinny》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Blood》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: ……We must plan accordingly.

name: Trainer of Prinnies, Valvatorez
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Prinny》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: What a splendid idea! I shall show them! What a fighting Prinny Instructor can do!!

name: Self-centered Overlord, Laharl
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: I'll destroy your Majin, as well．

text: 【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is canceled, if a card named "Vow of the Moon" is in your climax area, choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: The moon is the symbol of my loyalty to my Lord.

name: Sharp Criticism, Etna
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of 《Demon》 or 《Prinny》 characters you have.
flavor: Prince, this place has a lot of expensive looking stuff. You want us to take it all, right?

name: Rebel Against God, Valvatorez
text:
【CONT】 If the number of your other 《Demon》 or 《Angel》 or 《Prinny》 characters is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When a card named "Ties of "Camaraderie"" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a level 3 or lower character in your opponent's center stage, and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: ……Then, shall we head out? To rebel against God!

name: Master Big Star
text: 【AUTO】 When another of your characters becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: My, my. What a troublesome brat.

name: Fake Laharl
text: 【CONT】 If you have a card named "Prince Laharl of the Netherworld" in your waiting room, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: Etna: "There! Perfect! From now on you're Prince Laharl"

name: Vyers, the Dark Adonis Mid-Boss
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may return this card to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck.
flavor: Laharl: "I don't care what your name is. I'm calling you 'Mid-Boss'."

name: Prince Laharl of the Netherworld
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "King of the Earth" is in your climax area, you may choose a card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of his or her deck.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Etna & Flonne" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Etna & Flonne" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)

The name's Laharl.
I'm heir to the throne of the Netherworld!

text: 【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Choose up to two of your opponent's level 1 or lower characters in the center stage, and put them into his or her waiting room.
flavor:
Don't laugh!!
It's not like I had a choice!!

name: Overlord Laharl and his Vassal Etna
text: 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if there are no climax in your opponent's waiting room, you may choose a card in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor:
Prince, you're just a big softy!
If that was me, I would've wasted them all.

name: “Busty” Girl Laharl
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one level 3 or higher character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Who cares about that!？ I became a damned woman for Overlord's sake!

name: “Overlord's Dignity” Laharl
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a 《Demon》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.

I won't lose this battle.
I'll put everything I have into destroying you!

text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the number of cards in your opponent's clock is zero, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.

flavor: Prince, this guy's really getting on my nerves. Let's kill him already.

text: 【AUTO】 When another of your 《Demon》 characters becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: His undemonlike "Undoubting Heart" is also one of Lord Valvatorez's formidable powers……

name: New Overlord, Laharl
flavor: Don't hold back. Take everything!

name: Demon Girl Etna, the Ultimate Beauty
flavor:
Act II: "The Rise of Queen Etna"
A pretty girl strutting her stuff in the darkness of the Netherworld!

flavor: Did you call for me!

You owe me one!
No, let's make that two…!

"Sweat!"
"Roger-!"

flavor: Give up / Persuade by force

flavor: Flonne: "So…… I get credit for getting them back togther～! ……Right?"

text:
Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
Put the top card of your opponent's deck into your opponent's waiting room, choose a card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of his or her deck.
Choose one of your characters with "Etna" in its card name, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Next time on "Demon Gal Etna Dimension 2" Episode 2: "The Birth of Overlord Etna". A new history begins now!

First day of school and I am so late!

text: 【CONT】 If your opponent has a 500 power or lower character, this card gets +1500 power.

Fighting is for the lower classes!
It is our duty as nobles to use those fights to improve our kingdom and subjects!

【CONT】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is four or more, this card gets +2000 power.
【ACT】 [(3) Put this card into your waiting room] Choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters in the center stage, and put it on the bottom of his or her deck.

【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.

text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +1000 power.

【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.

I pledge my life to serve you.

【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Overlord Almaz" is in your climax area, draw a card, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: Dark Hero, Axel
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

Just watch me!!
The Dark Hero is about to make his grand return!!

text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. Follow the path of taste!
Young one, go forth on high heat!

Meeeeeee!?

text:

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or a 《Knight of the Round Table》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Be proud, Bedivere. You have truly fulfilled the order of your king.

name: The Mercy of Buddha, Mordred
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
flavor: But you know, monks who aren't all talk... do exist, huh?

name: Setting Sun, Gawain
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: I won't make it to the king's fight again...

name: Reversed Fairy Strings User, Tristan
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card's power does not decrease by your opponent's effects."
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, if "Failnaught" is in your climax area, and you have another 《Knight of the Round Table》 character, choose 1 of the following effects and perform it. "Choose up to 3 《Knight of the Round Table》 characters in your waiting room, and put them into your stock in any order." "Choose 1 level 1 or lower character in your opponent's back stage, and put it into their waiting room."
flavor: Ah... This truly makes me sad.

name: Knight of the Sun, Gawain
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +2000 power for each other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character in your back stage.
flavor: I am now Gawain, a knight serving the Lion King!

name: The Ritual of Holy Selection
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
If you do not have a character with "The Lion King(獅子王)" in its card name, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Choose 1 of your 《Knight of the Round Table》 characters without markers, put this card face up underneath that character as a marker, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: There are few who can be led to the end of this world.

name: Rhongomyniad
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Excalibur Galatine
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
This sword is a replica of the Sun.
Its flame shall cleanse all the impurity of this world!

name: Clarent Blood Arthur
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.

name: Failnaught
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Dance as my heart sees fit!

name: Ancient Queen of the Heavens, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 Resonate [(1) Reveal 1 "The Sun King, Ozymandias" in your hand & 【REST】 this card] Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: My name is Nitocris! I'm a Servant summoned to this land along with the Sun King!

name: Bonze Traveling the Wastelands, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "Five Elements Mountain Buddha Palm" is in your climax area, and you have 2 or more other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn, and perform the following action 2 times. "Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room."
flavor: Punishment exists... to save your soul from the burden of sin.

name: The Sun King, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If there is a face up marker underneath this card, this card gets +6000 power.
【AUTO】 During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, at the beginning of the encore step, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Ramesseum Tentyris" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock, and deal 2 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Mage King, huh? Nothing to be afraid of!

name: Rescue of the World, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Pharaoh》 characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock]".
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [TREASURE] in its trigger icon, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 card in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: Still, "save the world" they say.

name: The Mercy of Buddha, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character, you may put it face up underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: To people who can't even see their true desires, I have to show the mercy of Buddha to the very end, don't I?

name: As a Pharaoh, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are green or 《Chaldea》, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "To the Land of Eternity" is in your climax area, you may choose 1 green or 《Chaldea》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor: Ozymandias: "I'm taking a rest now.

name: The God King, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, and you have 4 or more green or 《Chaldea》 characters, at the beginning of your climax phase, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【ACT】 [Put this 【STAND】 card into your waiting room] You may choose 1 of your "The Sun King, Ozymandias", and put this card face up underneath that card as a marker.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your green or 《Chaldea》 characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Cooping up without fighting is not like me.

name: Compassionate Mage Queen, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character in your back stage.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the bottom card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: I ask of you, as well, Pharaoh! The refugees are injured, and some of them are children.

name: Influence of the Mage Queen, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 2 or higher, you may return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Wake up! That is disrespectful!

name: Where Justice Is, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if there is a climax in your climax area, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: My disciple has taught me!

name: Magnanimous Like the Sun, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor:
Listen! Don't think that I will show you mercy ever again!
Stand firm by that whim of yours!

name: Condition for the Alliance, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", put the bottom X cards of your opponent's deck into their waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters you have.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: So, you're Lancelot? Good. You understand the concept of opportunity.

name: Body Outside Body, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 [【REST】 1 of your 【STAND】 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 2 "Where Justice Is, Xuanzang Sanzang", put them on separate positions of your stage, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Caster, Xuanzang Sanzang!

name: Guardian of the Egyptian Region, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If your level is 2 or higher, this card gets the following ability. "【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 "The God King, Ozymandias" in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage."
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
flavor: Do you intend to invade this land, aware that it is the Sun King's territory?

name: Provocative Gaze, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if you have another 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: Heh...

name: Joining Up With Counterattack Forces, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.
flavor: This is serious treason, Lancelot!

name: King Among Kings, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "The Sun King's Holy Grail" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card is in your back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 that character.
flavor: I, the great and mighty pharaoh, have manifested here, and my territory is right here. Humanity is as good as saved already.

name: Confrontation Against the Strong, Xuanzang Sanzang
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [Return 2 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking until end of turn.
flavor: Mordred: "Because in the next round of humanity, there won't be any war! Idiots like me won't be born, either!"

name: Pharaoh's Divine Authority, Ozymandias
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, if all of your characters are 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.

name: Delivery of an Unneeded Item, Nitocris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is cost 0 or lower, this card cannot become 【REVERSE】.
【AUTO】 When your other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Have all the troops before the gate stand back immediately. They're in the way.

name: The Sun King's Holy Grail
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: Choose 1 of your opponent's level 1 or higher characters, your opponent chooses 1 level X or lower character in their waiting room, and exchanges them. X is equal to the level of the character you chose -1.
flavor: As I have so rashly taken the Holy Grail, I may have engrossed myself with something out of character.

name: Ramesseum Tentyris
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Look upon my works, ye Mighty! All judgment is to be passed down by the hands of pharaohs!

name: To the Land of Eternity
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
I don't want you being taken to the underworld.
I don't really like that dark place.

name: Five Elements Mountain Buddha Palm
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Then, I shall free you of your reservations.

name: Girl of Poison, Hassan of the Serenity
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: My bodily fluids are poisonous. My breath, my sweat and my saliva are all deadly poison...

name: Radiant Agateram, Bedivere
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Switch On - Agateram" is in your climax area, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to 1 level X or lower 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: No matter the cost, this time... This time for sure, I will... kill my king with my own hands!

name: Silver Knight of Violet, Bedivere
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
flavor: I also love Camelot. The smiles of the people in this city...

name: Night Before the Decisive Battle, Hassan of the Serenity
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Hearing that the time for the decisive battle has come, I, as Serenity, have rushed over.

name: Loyal Knight, Bedivere
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 character, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: On behalf of the Knights of the Round Table... thank you.

name: Replica, Bedivere
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text: 【ACT】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] Choose 1 "Switch On - Agateram" in your waiting room, put it on your climax area, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: This is the end of my duty and my journey.

name: Arrow of All His Strength, Arash
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3) Put this card into your waiting room] At the end of this card's attack, if "Stella" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put all level 2 or lower characters from your opponent's center stage into their waiting room.

name: Independent Knight, Lancelot
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Lancelot of the Light of the Lake" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, choose up to 2 cards in your opponent's waiting room, return them to their deck, your opponent shuffles their deck, and this card gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: In a world where ruin is imminent, the path demonstrated by my king is just and unwavering above all!

name: First Hassan-i Sabbah "Old Man of the Mountain"
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 1 or less characters in your back stage, this card cannot attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -4500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of all players' attack phase, if this card is in the center stage, all players cannot use "【AUTO】 Encore" until end of turn. （The "【AUTO】 Encore [(3)]" rule cannot be used either）
flavor: O wandering knight, there is but one way thou might liberate the one thou servest.

name: Arash Kamangir
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When "Stella" is placed on your climax area, if your level is 1 or higher, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to 1 "Arrow of All His Strength, Arash" in your hand, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
【AUTO】 [(1)] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Do you know why you know my name?

name: Grand Assassin "Old Man of the Mountain"
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, put it into their memory, and your opponent puts that character from their memory on any position of their stage.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Evening Bell" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: The will of Heaven has already been demonstrated.

name: The Way of a Round Table Knight, Lancelot
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, choose 1 of your other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, 【REST】 it, and move it to an open position of your back stage."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or waiting room, if you have another "Divine Spirit, The Lion King" or "In the Name of the King of Storms, The Lion King", you may choose 1 "The Ritual of Holy Selection" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Calling me that is bad for my heart.

name: Dance of Pale Death, Hassan of the Serenity
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If this card is 【REST】, all players' characters in their center stage without "Fujimaru(藤丸)" or "Arash(アーラシュ)" or "Hassan(ハサン)" in their card names get -500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the top of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Iseult of the White Hands has finally caught up with you.

name: Confrontation Against the Strong, Lancelot
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Chaldea》 or 《Camelot》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Arash: "An ambush? Knights of the Round Table? It's disgraceful!"

name: Return of the Sacred Sword, Bedivere
expansion_raw: Fate/Grand Order THE MOVIE Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
text:
