name: Battle with Soichiro, Saber
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Armor Release" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, and this card gets +5000 power until end of turn.

name: Shirou in the Morning Glow
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [Put a 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2500 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

name: Battle Within the Field, Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +4000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Resonate [(1) Reveal a card named "Activating a Command Seal, Shirou" in your hand] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2500 power until end of turn.

name: Battle After School, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, put this card into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Rin: "You finally came out, eh, Emiya?"

name: Past Hero, Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "A Fateful Night" is in your climax area, you may choose one of your other characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
Rin: "Servants are basically always
with you in spirit form, and should the need arise, you can materialize them and make them fight."

name: Confronting a Servant, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named ""Heroic Spirit" Saber" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Search your deck for up to one 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor:
Rider: "I'm surprised. You aren't going to use a Command Seal?"
Shirou: "Sorry, I don't have many left."

name: Heading for the Rescue, Saber
text: 【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named ""Heroic Spirit" Saber" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Assassin: "Even now, you will not
reveal your Noble Phantasm."

name: Mischievous Smile, Taiga
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your opponent's stock into your opponent's waiting room. If you do, choose a card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it into your opponent's stock.
flavor: Yay?

name: "Servant" Gilgamesh
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 【STAND】 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and 【REST】 it.

name: Kind Soul, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.)
flavor: …man, this place never changes.

name: Archery Club Captain, Mitsuzuri
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +3500 power.
【ACT】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your memory] At the beginning of your next draw phase, choose a card named "Archery Club Captain, Ayako" in your memory, put it on any position of your stage, and put the top card of your deck underneath that character as a marker.
flavor: Well, I need to go to the faculty room.

name: Commanding Aura, Saber
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

name: At the School Cafeteria, Mitsuzuri
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your draw phase, if you do not have any other characters in your center stage, this card gets +4000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
You're not eating with the student
council president today.

name: Shirou's Close Friend, Issei
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power and the character facing this card gets +1 soul for each of your other "Battle After School, Shirou".
flavor:
Emiya, you'd better hurry and eat
before the lunch break ends.

name: Tinkering with Machines, Shirou
flavor: It's okay, I'm almost done.

name: During Morning Practice, Mitsuzuri
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, reveal the top card of your deck, and your opponent may put the top card of your deck on the bottom of your deck. (If not, return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor:
Hey, Tohsaka?
You're early today.

name: Usual Morning, Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, 【REST】 this card. (The revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: Morning, Fuji-nee.

name:
Student
Council President, Issei
flavor: Tohsaka…

name: Usual Morning, Taiga
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, your opponent chooses the number 0 or 1 or 2. Reveal the top card of your deck, and if that card is a card of a level that matches the number that your opponent chose, draw up to X cards. X is equal to the number that your opponent chose +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. If it is not, the revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: Sakura, good morning～

name: Activating a Command Seal, Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Return this card to your hand] When a card named "Summoning Saber" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named "Battle Within the Field, Saber" in your hand, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: That means it's my turn.

name: Servant with Blond Hair
text: 【CONT】 If this card is in the middle position of your center stage, this card gets +1 soul.
flavor: There is a sneer on your lips, holy man.

name: Hidden Weapon, Saber
flavor:
Lancer: "Your Noble Phantasm, is it a sword?"
Saber: "Perhaps, perhaps not. It may be a battle axe.
Or perhaps it is a polearm."

name: Temporary Rest
text: Look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your waiting room. Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +4000 power until end of turn. Put this card into your clock.
flavor: I can also minimize my mana expenditure by sleeping.

name: Self-training
text: Until end of turn, all of your characters get +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
flavor: Tracing basic structure. Tracing component materials!

name: Armor Release
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: A Fateful Night
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one yellow card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I ask you. Are you my Master?

name: Anger Towards Evil
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Like hell I will! Let Fuji-nee go!

name: Summoning Saber
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Please… Come to me, Saber!

name: "Heroic Spirit" Rider
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it into your opponent's waiting room. If you do, your opponent chooses up to one level 0 or lower character in his or her waiting room, and puts it on the stage position that character was on. 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "Dancing After School" is in your climax area, you may put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor: t You've been caught by me from the beginning.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq August 2014 issue

name: Daily Symbol, Sakura
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one green character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: …about that, Senpai. Maybe you could stop by the dojo?
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq September 2014 issue

name: Bewitching Beauty, Rider
text: 【AUTO】 [Put another character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if a card named "" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.

name: "Heroic Spirit" Lancer
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Servant》 characters in front of this card gets +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Curse with your dying breath that
you were born with no luck and no power.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq August 2014 issue

name: Morning Greeting, Sakura
text: 【CONT】 Your other 《Sports》 or 《Weapon》 character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1500 power.
flavor: And good morning to you, Senpai.

name: Archery Club Member, Sakura
text: 【AUTO】 When another of your 《Sports》 or 《Weapon》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: Bystander, Lancer
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is five or more, this card gets +1000 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: You just want me to stand by and watch, right? Don't worry, I'm not gonna help you.

name: Self-concious, Shinji
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, move this card to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: Really? I thought you were.

name: Archery Club Vice-captain, Shinji
text: 【CONT】 Experience This card gets +3000 power for each card named "Self-concious, Shinji" in your level.
flavor:
I was wondering what you've been up to after quitting the club. You're the student council
president's errand boy, eh?

name: Moving Like a Beast, Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in the original order.
flavor:
If you're a man,
show some dignity, damn it.

name: Usual Morning, Sakura
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.)
flavor: I always double-check the gas valve, so we're safe.

name: Shinji's Servant, Rider
text: 【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.

name: Noble Phantasm Unleashed
text:
If the number of green characters you have is two or less, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Put all of your opponent's stock into your opponent's waiting room, and your opponent puts the same number of cards from the top of his or her deck into the stock.
flavor:
So, will you face my
mightiest blow, then?

name: Dancing After School
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I will kill you gently.

name: Bounded Field
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: For Victory, Rin
text:
【CONT】 Experience If there is a card named "For Victory, Rin" and "Dual-wielding Bowman, Archer" in your level, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
I'm not as na?ve as Shirou Emiya, but there are some things I won't budge on.
[「i」の上の2点をご注意ください]
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype November 2014 issue

name: Great Day for a Date, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to two cards, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 【STAND】 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and 【REST】 it.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Tohsaka's Magic Crest" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax in your waiting room. (This damage may be canceled)
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: GIRLS MATE Vol.02

name: "Heroic Spirit" Archer
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Master》 or 《Servant》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that character's level. (This damage may be canceled. The revealed card is returned to its original place)
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "Proof of Contract, Rin" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: Devilish Smile, Rin
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock]".
flavor: Emotional flab.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq September 2014 issue

name: As a Mage, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, perform the following action. "Choose a character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room."
flavor: You don't have to go to such extremes to help others!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype November 2014 issue

name: Rin's Servant, Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When another of your characters becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose one of your 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose up to one 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Oh, and this is the most damning. Your appeal is hard to see.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype November 2014 issue

name: Latecomer, Archer
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Master》 or 《Servant》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When a card named "Precision Piercing" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's cost 0 or lower characters, put it into your opponent's waiting room, and this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
I sensed a threat
to my Master and rushed to her side. It appears I was too late, though.

name: Cursed Magic Bullet, Rin
text: 【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "Proof of Contract, Rin" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the top of your opponent's deck."
flavor:
You'll die instantly
if they hit a vital spot!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq December 2014 issue

name: A Master's Mental State, Rin
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card gets +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 Resonate [(1) Reveal a card named "Proof of Contract, Rin" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, and put it into your opponent's waiting room.
flavor: I brought you here because you weren't officially my enemy yet.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq November 2014 issue

name: A Bowman's True Value, Archer
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it into your opponent's waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Imbecile!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype July 2014 issue

name: Proof of Contract, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your characters with "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, until end of turn, that character gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 If the character facing this card is a lower level than this card, this card cannot attack."
flavor: This is all the proof you need that I am your Master, right?

name: Fashionable Glasses, Rin
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other characters you have is one or less, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card attacks, if a card named "Summoning Ritual" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Well?

name: Proof of Contract, Archer
text: 【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Master》 or 《Servant》, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: As a mage, you should be able to sense the bond between us through our pact.

name: Archer's Surprise Attack
text:
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "Proof of Contract, Rin" in your hand] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.)

name: A Bowman's Speciality, Archer
text:
【CONT】 If the number of "A Bowman's Speciality" in your waiting room is three or more, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor:
He's more an embodiment of
savagery than a mad warrior.

name: Cynic, Archer
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Bond／"Cursed Magic Bullet, Rin" [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Cursed Magic Bullet, Rin" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor:
If we were to fight now, I wouldn't
have a choice but to die just like Rider.

name: Rough Summoning, Archer
flavor: …hm?

name: Dual-wielding Bowman, Archer
text: 【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.

name: A Different Morning, Rin
flavor: I guess it's just one of those days.

name: Summon Rites, Rin
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters.
flavor: Close the gates of the four directions. Come forth from the Crown and follow the forked road leading to the Kingdom.

name: Father's Keepsake
text: Choose up to two 《Jewel》 characters in your waiting room, return them to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Oh, right. That pendant.

name: Tohsaka's Magic Crest
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
This is the embodiment of
the magics passed down in my family.

name: Summoning Ritual
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor:
Come forth from the circle of
binding, Guardian of the Scales!

name: Precision Piercing
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: I am the bone of my sword.

name: A Bowman's Speciality
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: "Heroic Spirit" Caster
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have. 【AUTO】 [(4) Put two cards from your hand into your waiting room] This ability activates up to one time per turn. When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card.
flavor: Do you think you can escape?

name: Mages' Fighting Style, Caster
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, draw up to one card.
flavor:
Had you worked with me, I would have been willing
to share the Grail with you.

name: Silver Thread Alchemy Elgen Lied, Illya
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Master》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Attacking without warning? What are you, an animal, Rin?

name: "Heroic Spirit" Assassin
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, if this card is in the middle position of the center stage, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor:
Kojiro Sasaki,
Assassin-class Servant.

name: "Caster's Master" Soichiro Kuzuki
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +1 level and +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You underestimated me, Saber

name: Rin's Classmate, Kane Himuro
text:
【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
【ACT】 [【REST】 one of your characters with "Assist"] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Maki, all we need to do is go eat lunch at the cafeteria, right?

name: Overwhelming Violence, Berserker
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top card of your deck into your clock, and 【REST】 this card.

name: Lady, Illya
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Illya's Magic, Storch Ritter" is in your climax area and the number of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters is three or more, you may draw up to two cards. If you do, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: It's nice to meet you, Rin. I'm Illya.

name: Hypocritical Courtesy, Kirei
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is five or more, this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your draw phase, if you do not have any other characters in your center stage, this card gets +4000 power until the end of turn.
flavor:
It is the sixth day since the war commenced. You are the first to have
made his way here.

name: "Finishing" Move, Assassin
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other ""Finishing" Move, Assassin".
【AUTO】 [(1) Put two cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to two ""Finishing" Move, Assassin", and put them on separate positions of your stage. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Ultimate Technique, Swallow Reversal

name: Tactician, Caster
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Master》 characters in front of this card gets +1000 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 Change [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named ""Heroic Spirit" Caster" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor:
I am leaving
to claim my prize early.

name: Warning Before the Battle, Illya
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets "【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card gets +1000 power.".
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to one card named "Warning Before the Battle, Illya" in your hand, reveal it to your opponent, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: If you don't summon yours soon, you're gonna die, Big Brother.

name: Modern Power, Kirei
text: 【AUTO】 When another of your 《Weapon》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: "Heroic Spirit" Berserker
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a 《Servant》 character from your stage into your clock] （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Rin: "Berserker!?"

name: Rin's Classmate, Yukika Saegusa
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Rin's Classmate, Kane Himuro" and "Rin's Classmate, Kaede Makidera" get +500 power.
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor:
E-Excuse me, Tohsaka?
If you don't mind, would you like to eat lunch together?

name: "Berserker's Master" Illya
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.)

name: Rin's Classmate, Kaede Makidera
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, until end of turn, you cannot use "【AUTO】 Encore". (You cannot use the "【AUTO】 Encore [(3)]" rule either)
flavor: Didn't I tell you? Tohsaka never brings a boxed lunch.

name: Rule-breaking Noble Phantasm, Caster
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Rule-breaking Noble Phantasm" is in your climax area, choose one trait of a character on your opponent's stage, and until end of turn, all of your opponent's characters lose that trait.
flavor: Hmph…

name: Overseer of the Holy Grail War, Kirei
flavor: It chooses the Master who is worthy of it.

name: Reticent Teacher, Soichiro Kuzuki
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a ""Caster's Master" Soichiro Kuzuki" from your hand into your clock] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.)
flavor: Ryudou, I need to speak to you.

name: Illusion magic
text: Each player returns all cards in the waiting room to his or her deck. Each player shuffles his or her deck afterwards.
flavor: Saber: "Rider-class Servant!"

name: Taken
text: Choose one of your 【STAND】 《Master》 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Saber is now my puppet.

name: Immense Power
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the number of 《Master》 characters you have.

name: Illya's Magic, Storch Ritter
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
Besides, what do you want me to say
to someone who is going to die here?

name: Rule-breaking Noble Phantasm
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
I had thought that
you were utterly irrational, but you do understand
your situation, don't you?

name: SD Shirou
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters get +500 power.
flavor: I like people like you.

name: SD Saber
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your clock is zero, this card cannot attack.
flavor: Give me an order.

name: SD Archer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: If presented with an enemy that is easy to slay, we ought to do so.

name: SD Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.)
flavor: For starters, good evening, Emiya.

name: The Ones Fighting Against Fate
text: 【CONT】 If you have another 《Servant》 character, this card gets +1500 power.

name: In an Alliance
text:
【CONT】 Assist During your turn, all of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

name: Commanding Aura, Saber
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

name: Tinkering with Machines, Shirou
flavor: It's okay, I'm almost done.

name: Usual Morning, Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, 【REST】 this card. (The revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: Morning, Fuji-nee.

name: Past Hero, Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "A Fateful Night" is in your climax area, you may choose one of your other characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
Rin: "Servants are basically always
with you in spirit form, and should the need arise, you can materialize them and make them fight."

name: Kind Soul, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.)
flavor: …man, this place never changes.

name: Hidden Weapon, Saber
flavor:
Lancer: "Your Noble Phantasm, is it a sword?"
Saber: "Perhaps, perhaps not. It may be a battle axe.
Or perhaps it is a polearm."

name: Self-training
text: Until end of turn, all of your characters get +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
flavor: Tracing basic structure. Tracing component materials!

name: A Fateful Night
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one yellow card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I ask you. Are you my Master?

name: Proof of Contract, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your characters with "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, until end of turn, that character gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 If the character facing this card is a lower level than this card, this card cannot attack."
flavor: This is all the proof you need that I am your Master, right?

name: Rough Summoning, Archer
flavor: …hm?

name: Dual-wielding Bowman, Archer
text: 【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.

name: A Different Morning, Rin
flavor: I guess it's just one of those days.

name: Summon Rites, Rin
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters.
flavor: Close the gates of the four directions. Come forth from the Crown and follow the forked road leading to the Kingdom.

name: Summoning Ritual
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor:
Come forth from the circle of
binding, Guardian of the Scales!

name: A Bowman's Speciality
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Holy Grail War Entry, Saber
text:
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] Choose one of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal one card from the top of your deck, and put it into your waiting room. Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +X soul until end of turn. X is equal to the level of the card put into your waiting room with this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Your Servant Saber has come in response to your summons.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC　First Appearance: TYPE-MOON Ace Vol.9

name: Familiar's Work, Archer
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: You are quite the slob, aren't you, girl?

name: For Victory, Rin & Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters is four or more, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of your encore step, if you do not have any other 【REST】 characters in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Yes, I'm fighting to win. That's all.

name: Jewel Mage, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage ｆｒｏｍ your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When another of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Say your prayers!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC　First Appearance: Anime Guide 2014 SUMMER

name: Reinforce Magic, Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage ｆｒｏｍ your hand, choose one of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Trace on.

name: “Trace On” Shirou
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1000 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, search your deck for up to one character with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: ―Trace, on.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype March 2014 issue

name: “Excalibur” Saber
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your deck is five or less, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other characters with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: “Excalibur”――!

name: “Unlimited Blade Works” Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, draw up to one card, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put another character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "Unlimited Blade Works" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your waiting room with the same level as that battle opponent, put it on any position of your stage, and at the beginning of your encore step, if that character is on the stage, put that character into your memory.
flavor:
I create a world that contains an infinite number of swords. That is the only magic
allowed to Shirou Emiya.

name: “Summoning with a Command Seal” Shirou
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When a climax is put on your climax area, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Please… Come to me… Saber!!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype February 2015 issue

name: “Contract Concluded” Saber
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put a card from the bottom of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room.
flavor: Victory is yours, Rin.

name: “King's Self-esteem” Gilgamesh
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, put the top two cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, this card gets -3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: When I'm done with you, there won't be a single bone shard left of that counterfeiting cranium of yours!!

name: “Tough Strength” Saber
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other characters with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, your opponent may choose a character in your waiting room, and put it on the top of your deck.
flavor: Hurry!! Rin!!!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype July 2015 issue

name: “Gate of Babylon” Gilgamesh
text:
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "“Gate of Babylon”" is in your climax area, put the top two cards of your deck into your waiting room. For each [SOUL] trigger icon revealed among those cards, perform the following action. "Deal one damage to your opponent." (This damage may be canceled)
【ACT】 [Put a 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] This card gets +4000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Hero of justice? A world where no one is hurt? Don't be absurd.

name: “Serious Assault” Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "“Rho Aias”" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put X cards from the top of your deck underneath this card as a marker, and this card gets +1500 power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Weapon》 or 《Jewel》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, put all markers from underneath this card into your waiting room. For each [SOUL] trigger icon among those cards, the character facing this card gets -1 soul until end of turn.

name: “Non-intersecting Ideals” Shirou & Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Signal to Counterattack" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Shirou: "-I can't be beaten by you. I don't mind losing to someone else. But I'm not about to be beaten by myself-!"
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype June 2015 issue

name: “Divine Construct” Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put X cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of characters you have with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of cards in your clock.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype July 2014 issue

name: “Pure White Dress” Saber
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."

name: “Top Servant” Saber
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1500 power, and this card cannot become 【REVERSE】 from your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "“Excalibur”" is in your climax area, you may put a card from the top of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, if there is a marker underneath this card, you may choose one of your opponent's level 1 or lower characters, and put it into his or her stock. If you do, put a card from the bottom of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room, and at the beginning of your encore step, put this card into your memory.
flavor: Master, what is the situation?
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype February 2015 issue

name: “Using a Command Seal” Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 When another of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq January 2015 issue

name: “Furious Punch” Shirou
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name get +500 power and +1 soul.
【AUTO】 Change [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Unlimited Blade Works” Shirou" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Damn you!!

name: “Defeat's End” Gilgamesh
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Gilgamesh(ギルガメッシュ)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name get +500 power.
flavor: Victory is yours. Die with that satisfaction, faker.

name: “A Battle of Legend” Gilgamesh
text: 【CONT】 If a yellow climax is in your climax area, this card gets +1 soul.
flavor: Let us reenact a battle of legend here, shall we?

name: “Greatest Natural Enemy” Gilgamesh
flavor: Damn you… Damn you, damn you, damn you, damn you!!!

name: “Endless Blades” Gilgamesh
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: So, let us pick up where we left off 10 years ago.

name: “Highest Class Noble Phantasm” Gilgamesh
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one climax, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Vexing as it is, it would seem that only the highest class of arms will work on that man.

name: “Dauntless Heart” Shirou
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You'll never know… unless I try!

name: “New Contract” Saber
flavor: Archer, your wish is a mistake.

name: “Neat and Tidy Appearance” Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a character with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" or "Rin(凛)" in its card name, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype September 2014 issue

name: “Challenging a King” Gilgamesh
text: 【AUTO】 [(2) Put two climax from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot deal damage to a player."
flavor: …Hm.

name: “Ultimate Slash” Saber
text:
【CONT】 If a card named "“Trace On” Shirou" is in your clock, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I shall take over from here.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype March 2014 issue

name: Signal to Counterattack
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +3500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Let's get started, King of Heroes――
Do you have enough weapons stored up?

name: Idealism's End
text: Choose one of your characters with "Shirou(士郎)" in its card name, and that character gets +5000 power until end of turn. Put this card into your stock.
flavor: Shirou: "I know my dream isn't a mistake!"

name: “Unlimited Blade Works”
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: “Gate of Babylon”
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one yellow card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

name: “Excalibur”
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: “Battle Mode” Rider
text:
【CONT】 If the number of green characters you have is four or more, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

name: “Dedicated Junior” Sakura
text:
【AUTO】 When a climax is put on your climax area, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, perform the following action. "Choose a card in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock."
flavor: Thank you, Senpai.

name: “Cold and Ruthless” Rider
text: 【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.

name: “Gae Bolg” Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into his or her waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor: But I wouldn't be much of a hero if a little scratch like this did me in right away.

name: “Gae・Bolg” Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top two cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Here it comes. Accept my blow as a gift
for you who are about to die…
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Animedia June 2015 issue

name: “Deadly Strike” Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a 《Weapon》 character from your hand into waiting room & 【REST】 one of your other 【STAND】 green characters] When this card attacks, if a card named "“Gae Bolg”" is in you climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'll have your heart!

name: “Quiet Personality” Sakura
text:
【AUTO】 When a card named "Daily Visits" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, search your deck for up to one green character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When your other green character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq September 2014 issue

name: “Battle Continues” Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 2 or higher, you may return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0. The revealed card is returned to its original place)

name: “Self-defense Class” Luvia
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Rin(凛)" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power, and this card cannot side attack.
flavor: Self-defense. The class where one expresses one's vitality through physical ability.

name: “Complex Emotions” Sakura
text: 【CONT】 If this card is in your center stage, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype March 2014 issue

name: “Uneasiness in the Heart” Sakura
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq January 2015 issue

name: “United Battlefront” Lancer
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: For someone like me who can't casually betray my own Master, that little lady is pretty dazzling.

name: “Invading the Base” Shinji
text: 【CONT】 Experience All of your other characters get +500 power for each card named "Self-conscious, Shinji" in your level.
flavor: If so, it's convenient. Take me to Berserker's…

name: Shaken
text: Choose a green character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put this card into your clock.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq October 2014 issue

name: Last Farewell
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the number of green characters you have.

name: “Gae Bolg”
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Daily Visits
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

name: “Invitation to London” Rin
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other characters you have with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)"in its card name is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "Mischievous Smile" is in your climax area, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Will you come with me?

name: “Idealism's Despair” Archer
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Jewel》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 one of your 【STAND】 characters] When a card named "“Rho Aias”" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put seven cards from the top of your deck underneath this card as markers.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, put all markers from underneath this card into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 You cannot take damage from your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects."
flavor: ―Farewell. Let your ideals drag you down to your death.

name: “Lord and Retainer” Rin & Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Last Words" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal one damage to your opponent, and this card gets +3000 power until end of turn. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: Archer: "I will call you "Rin," then… Yes, the sound of it suits you."
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Compace December 2014 issue

name: “Super First-rate Mage” Rin
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 Resonate [(1) Reveal a card named "“Caladbolg II”" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Lord and Retainer” Rin & Archer" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Archer! Fire support!

name: “Successor of Tohsaka” Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a character with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Choose one of your characters with "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype March 2014 issue

name: “Counterattack Barrage” Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "“Caladbolg II”" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a level 0 or lower character in your opponent's center stage, and put it into his or her waiting room.

name: “Caladbolg Ⅱ” Archer
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you play a card named "“Caladbolg II”", choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: That was magnificent. But not enough.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq July 2014 issue

name: “Fire Support” Archer
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "“Caladbolg II”" in your hand] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REVERSE】 that character.

name: “Beautiful and Smart Honor Student” Rin
text:
【CONT】 If you have another 《Weapon》 character, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is not a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your clock. (If it is, return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: I'll finish you off for good this time♪
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Comptiq January 2015 issue

name: “Dual-wielding” Archer
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one 《Weapon》 character in your hand with level equal to or lower than your level, and put it on any position of your stage.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a level 3 or lower character in your opponent's center stage, and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor:
If you can't live without clinging to such a dream, then let it drag you down
and drown you!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype February 2015 issue

name: “Ideal Existence” Archer
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Caladbolg II”" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters] Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: As long as I am your ideal, Shirou Emiya must deny me more than anyone.

name: “Jewel Magic” Rin
text: 【CONT】 If the number of your other characters is one or less, this card gets +1500 power.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype December 2014 issue

name: “Complex Emotions” Rin
text:
【AUTO】 [Put two cards from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it into his or her waiting room.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype June 2015 issue

name: “Further Pursuit” Archer
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Choose a character in your waiting room with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, and return it to your hand.

name: “End of Fight” Archer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have.
flavor: Now, be gone.

name: “Full Power Pitch” Rin
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" in its card name get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose a character in your waiting room with "Shirou(士郎)" or "Saber(セイバー)" in its card name, and put it into your stock.
flavor: Don't hold back, I'm using everything I've got.

name: “Time to Part Ways” Rin
flavor: I'll try my hardest to make sure he doesn't turn into a twisted jerk like you. I will try hard so that he'll learn to like himself.

name: “Center Breakthrough” Rin
text:
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a red card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "“Caladbolg II”" in your hand] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REVERSE】 that battle opponent.

name: “In the Conflict” Archer
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 【STAND】 characters with "Rin(凛)" or "Archer(アーチャー)" in its card name, and 【REST】 it.

name: “Caladbolg Ⅱ”
text: Look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one red character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Conclusion to the Fight
text: Brainstorm Reveal three cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, choose one of your opponent's characters, and put it on the top of his or her deck.

name: “Rho Aias”
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

name: Last Words
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Don't you worry, Tohsaka. I'll try my best from now on, too.

name: Mischievous Smile
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: What about you, Shirou?

name: “Snow Fairy” Illya
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Official Contract" is in your climax area, and the number of other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have is four or more, you may draw a card.
flavor:
Besides, what do you want me to say
to someone who is going to die here?

name: “Signal to Commence Battle” Illya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
flavor: Get them… Berserker!!
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Newtype February 2015 issue

name: “Mage from the Age of Myths” Caster
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your 《Master》 characters is being frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Yes. That is a wise decision, Master.

name: “Mage of Tragedy” Caster
text:
【AUTO】 When another of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(3) Put a card named "Granted Wish" from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 level 3 or lower characters, 【REST】 it, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that character's soul. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: You should actually be proud. You forced me into a magic duel.

name: “Relationship of Trust” Illya & Berserker
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other cards in the back stage with "Illya(イリヤ)" in its card name.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to two cards, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Encounter and Bond" is in your climax area, put the top five cards of your deck into your waiting room, deal X damage to your opponent, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of climax revealed among those cards. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: Illya: "Because Berserker's stronger than anyone!"

name: “Strong Bond” Illya
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one card named "“Relationship of Trust” Illya & Berserker", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 Bond/"“Sturdy Servant” Berserker" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Sturdy Servant” Berserker" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)

name: “Strongest Warrior” Berserker
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if the number of markers underneath this card is ten or less, put the top card of your stock underneath this card as a marker. If you do, 【REST】 this card.

name: “Confronting a King” Illya
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one character with "Berserker(バーサーカー)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [(2) Return this card to your hand] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named "“Strong Will” Berserker" in your hand, and put it on this card's stage position as the defending character.

name: “A Battle of Legend” Illya
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "“Strong Will” Berserker" get +1000 power.
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card gets +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.

name: “Strong Will” Berserker
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other cards in the back stage with "Illya(イリヤ)" in its card name.

name: “Further Attack” Souichirou Kuzuki
text:
【AUTO】 Bond/"“Mage from the Age of Myths” Caster" [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Mage from the Age of Myths” Caster" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
【ACT】 [(1)] Draw a card, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: “Great Magic” Caster
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Encounter on a Rainy Day" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: “Magic Duel” Caster
text: 【CONT】 If there is a blue climax in your climax area, this card gets +2000 power.

name: “Swallow Reversal” Assassin
text: 【AUTO】 When a card named "Swallow Reversal" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, you may choose a level 1 or lower character facing this card, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: I will break open that belief of yours with brute force.

name: “Repeated Pursuit” Souichirou Kuzuki
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is not a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your clock. (If it is, return the revealed card to its original place)

name: “A Short Rest” Illya
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, your opponent may draw two cards. If your opponent does, your opponent chooses two cards from his or her hand, and puts them into his or her waiting room.
flavor: I wonder if they'll reach here safely, though?
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: Dengeki G's Magazine May 2015 issue

name: “Sturdy Servant” Berserker
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is five or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: “Fictional Heroic Spirit” Assassin
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters is four or more, until end of turn, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking.
flavor: If, that is, a man who went to his death in obscurity had such a thing as a wish…

name: “Middle of the Final Test” Illya
flavor: I'll summon something that won't cause me pain and isn't as scary as Berserker…

name: “Fulfilling the Wish” Souichirou Kuzuki
text:
【CONT】 If you have another character with "Caster(キャスター)" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets +1 soul.
flavor: There is no need to grieve. I will fulfill your wish in your place, that's all.

name: “A Visitor” Illya
text: 【CONT】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is six or more, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
flavor:
Shirou is coming here… to the castle
where mother once stayed.

name: “Priest of Fuyuki Church” Kirei
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and put it into your waiting room.

name: “Reverberation of Defeat” Assassin
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character from your hand into your waiting room] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your memory.
flavor:
And here I considered myself a fair judge of women. I suppose my training in
that art is equally wanting.

name: Encounter on a Rainy Day
text: Look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one blue character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Berserker's Will
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters with "Illya(イリヤ)" or "Berserker(バーサーカー)" in its card name, and put it into your waiting room. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: You've been protecting me of your own free will, haven't you?

name: Encounter and Bond
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: You're so strong, Berserker…

name: Official Contract
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I won't be beaten… I'm the most powerful Master in the world!

name: Granted Wish
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: After all, my wish… was already being granted until this moment.

name: Swallow Reversal
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Ultimate Technique, Swallow Reversal.

name: Petit Gilgamesh
text: 【CONT】 If this card is in the middle position of your center stage, this card gets +1 soul.

name: "Christmas Party" Saber & Rin
text: 【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +1000 power.
copyright: ©TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance Compace February 2015 issue

name: “Loggerheads” Archer & Lancer
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
copyright: (C)TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC First appearance: PASH November 2014 issue

name: Righteous King of Knights, Saber
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Strike Air" is in your climax area, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Master》or 《Servant》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Master, your orders!

name: Justice On Behalf of Another, Shirou
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: The one I must fight… is still in this city.

name: Entrusted Arm of Archer, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if your memory has 2 or less cards, you may put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room.
flavor: Yeah. I love you, Sakura.

name: Reaching for the Grail, Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may choose 1 of your "Black Shadow", and put this card face down underneath that card as a marker.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room.
flavor: It cannot be!

name: Sword Shrouded by Wind, Saber
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, return it to his or her hand, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters get +500 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

name: Blushing, Shirou
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Well, she's famous. And she always kind of stands out, so…

name: Savage King of Heroes, Gilgamesh
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 cost 0 or lower character on your opponent's center stage, and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: You are spellbound by something not so good.

name: As a Master, Shirou
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Solitary Return" is in your climax area, and your stock has 5 or less cards, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: I… I'll fight. I'll fight as a Master!

name: "Rain" Shirou
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 "Irreplaceable Existence, Sakura" from among them, put it on any position on your stage, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have another "Irreplaceable Existence, Sakura", this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I will… continue to forgive you in your place.

name: Injury's Status, Shirou
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other characters with "Saber (セイバー)" or "Shirou (士郎)" or "Sakura (桜)" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Even after my shoulder healed, this life didn't change.

name: What I Can Do, Shirou
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: It's been a while since we did this last time.

name: Entrusted, Shirou
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters.

name: Friendly Teacher, Taiga
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters with "Shirou (士郎)" or "Sakura (桜)" in its card name, and that card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may choose 1 card in your opponent's clock, and put it into his or her waiting room. If you do, your opponent puts the top card of your opponent's deck into his or her clock.
