name: Towards the Battle, Rin
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Are you finally awake, Shirou?

name: Sharing Intel, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When your other character becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Flowing Tears, Sakura
text:
【CONT】 Experience This card gets +1500 power for each "Cloud-Concealed Moon, Sakura" or "Flowing Tears, Sakura" in your level.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Rediscovered Kindness" is in your climax area, you may choose 1 level X or lower 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the number of "Rediscovered Kindness" in your waiting room.

name: Special Feelings, Sakura
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 2 《Servant》 characters from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character with level equal to or lower than your level in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor:
Look at me, Senpai.
I've been crazy from the beginning.

name: Standing Guard, Saber Alter
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Inverted Light" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character, choose up to 2 of your opponent's characters, and those characters get -X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of "Standing Guard, Saber Alter" you have ×1000. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Rin.

name: Temporary Coalition, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, if "Sisters' Relationship" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 1 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Emiya, why don't we fight together?

name: She Who Has Accepted the Shadow, Sakura
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top 4 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a "Fluttering Shadow" among those cards, you may return this card to your hand.
flavor: He is the only one I really want to kill.

name: Smiling, Saber Alter
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character from your hand into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 characters you have.
flavor: That's something that should be obvious with one look.

name: Cold Attitude, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, 【REST】 all of your other 【STAND】 characters.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: So, what about it, huh?

name: Black-Armored Knight, Saber Alter
text: 【CONT】 All of your opponent's characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".

name: Overwhelming Power, Sakura
text: 【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put 1 other 《Servant》 character from your stage into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 character with "Corrupted(黒化)" in its card name with level equal to or lower than your level in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor: Did you like your heart being clutched like this?

name: Bowman's Guidance, Archer
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Can you keep up with me?

name: Cool and Collected, Rin
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(3)] Flip over 3 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. Choose 1 level X or lower 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage. X is equal to the number of "Jeweled Sword Zelretch" or 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters revealed among those cards.

name: Jealous, Sakura
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 characters.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Why are you trying to protect her?

name: Corrupted Mad Warrior, Berserker
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 characters you have ×1000.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Gaaaaawwrr

name: Enchanting Smile, Sakura
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all characters in your opponent's center stage get -500 power until end of turn.
flavor: I will protect Senpai from now on.

name: Lecture, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.

name: Harsh Words, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, your opponent declares 0 or 1 or 2 or 3. Put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and if that card's level is the number your opponent declared, draw up to X cards. X is equal to the number your opponent declared +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I mean, you're not in pain anymore, right?

name: Tiny Shadow People
text:
【CONT】 You can put any number of cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 If your hand has 3 or less cards, this card gets +3000 power.
【CONT】 All of your other "Tiny Shadow People" and "Cloud-Concealed Moon, Sakura" and "Flowing Tears, Sakura" get +1 level and +500 power.

name: Yielding Her Heart, Sakura
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your other 《Servant》 characters, and put it into your stock.
flavor: Okay.

name: Full Picture of the Basement, Archer
text:
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card is in your back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 that character.
【ACT】 [Put 1 event from your hand into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Jewel Defense Magic, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Jewel Defense Magic, Rin" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: I never thought you'd come up with the same idea, Emiya.

name: Roaring, Berserker
text:
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character from your waiting room at the bottom of your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: GAAAAAWWWR

name: Corrupted Knight, Saber Alter
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Nonsense!

name: Bluffing Smile, Rin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 event from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. If you put 1 card into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.

name: Fluttering Shadow
text: 【COUNTER】 Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 or 《Shadow》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. Put this card at the bottom of your deck.

name: Jeweled Sword Zelretch
text:
【COUNTER】 If you do not have a 《Jewel》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. Put this card into your memory.
Choose 1 of your opponent's characters in battle, and that character gets +X soul until end of turn. X is equal to the number of "Jeweled Sword Zelretch" in your memory ×4.

name: Mystic Code Zelretch
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Deep Love
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Rediscovered Kindness
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Big Sister?

name: Inverted Light
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Such a cheap trick won't confine me!

name: Sisters' Relationship
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

name: Dress of Heaven, Illya
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Heaven's Feel" is in your climax area, and your stock has 5 or less cards, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: You said a big brother protects his little sister, right?

name: Silver Thread Alchemy Elgen Lied, Illya
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Master》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Sending Off, Illya
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have.
flavor: See you later, Shirou. Please come home with Sakura before dawn.

name: Strategic Retreat, True Assassin
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and move it to another open position of their center stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card at the bottom of your deck.

name: Enemy Assault at Night, Caster
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose 1 level X or lower 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Master... Souichiro…

name: Self-Deprecating Smile, Illya
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters in front of this card get +1500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your stock.
flavor: It's useless to resist, isn't it? I mean, you're the most powerful one here.

name: Solitary Existence, Kirei Kotomine
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3)] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. At the end of this card's attack, if "Impeding Wall" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card, and at the beginning of the encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor:
If there's something that can't be seen
from the seat…

name: Top Mage, Caster
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)

name: Insane Mage, Zouken
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
【AUTO】 Encore [(1) Put 1 character from your stage into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I would run around the entire world killing every human one by one.

name: Purifying Light, Kirei
text:
【CONT】 Memory This card gets +1000 power for each "Baptism Rite" in your memory.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Baptism Rite" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Kyrie eleison.

name: Vigor, Berserker
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if all of your characters are 《Master》 or 《Servant》, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

name: Battle in the Ruined Church, Kirei
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your "Purifying Light, Kirei" is put into your waiting room from the stage, if this card is in your waiting room, you may pay the cost. If you do, put this card on any stage position as 【REST】.
flavor: Zouken Matou… I see. You came all the way to see me, huh?

name: Elusive Girl Illya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: I came here to chat with you, Shirou.

name: War Cry, Berserker
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or a 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 Bond/"Dress of Heaven, Illya" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Dress of Heaven, Illya" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)

name: Escaping, Kirei & Illya
text: 【AUTO】 [(2) Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
Illya: "Berserker…"
Kirei: "…!"

name: Where It Leads, Illya
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 event from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, 【REST】 all of your other 【STAND】 characters.
flavor: Just a bit further. Let's go.

name: Simple Question, Illya
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose up to 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Hey, how does it feel to be a big sister?

name: Commemorative Photograph, Souichiro
text: 【CONT】 If you have another "Enemy Assault at Night, Caster", this card gets +3000 power.

name: Waiting, Illya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or at the bottom of your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters among those cards ×1000.

name: Requesting Freedom, True Assassin
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -2500 power until end of turn.

name: Baptism Rite
text:
Put the top card of your deck into your clock, and put this card into your memory.
【CONT】 Memory If this card is in your memory, all of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters get +1000 power.
flavor: Let me inform you.

name: Heaven's Feel
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Impeding Wall
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: It seems both of us are barely hanging onto life… Shirou Emiya.

name: Staking All of Himself, Shirou
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 2 of your 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.

name: After the Battle, Sakura
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Master》 or 《Servant》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Master》 or 《Servant》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Senpai…

name: Continuing to Believe, Rider
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When you refresh your deck, you may put this card into your stock.

name: As an Elder Sister, Rin
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Unshackled, Sakura
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your stock.
flavor: Goodbye, Grandfather.

name: "Heaven’s Wheel Armor" Erza
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Circle Sword" is in your climax area, this card gets +4000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Annoying, but I'll wipe them out.

name: Titania Erza
text: 【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.
flavor: So you're the one who harmed our master.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Fairy Tail Master, Makarov
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Makarov's Grandson, Laxus" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Makarov's Grandson, Laxus" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: Nice to meet ya.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Magic Swordsman, Erza
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room.
flavor: Leave it to me.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: "Black Winged Armor" Erza
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Fairy Tail has come calling!!!!!!" is in your climax area, search your deck for up to one character with "Erza(エルザ)" in its card name, and put it into your waiting room. Shuffle your deck afterwards, and this card gets +2500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named ""Flame Empress Armor" Erza" in your waiting room, put it on the stage position that this card was on, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Let's go!
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Childhood Erza
text: 【CONT】 Memory If the number of 《Magic》 characters in your memory is two or more, this card gets +1500 power.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: "Infinity Robe" Erza
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When a card named "And more importantly, live with an open heart" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on the center stage, choose up to two cards in your opponent's waiting room, and return those cards to your opponent's deck. Shuffle your opponent's deck afterwards.
flavor: I swear on this sacred blade I wield, I will end this chaos. And your life!!!!
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Childhood Jellal
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, put this card into your memory.
flavor: Let’s go. Okay?
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ultra Close Type, Erza
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other characters with "Erza(エルザ)" in its card name get +1000 power.
【CONT】 If you would pay the 【ACT】 cost for one of your characters in your hand or stage, you may put a marker from underneath this card into your waiting room instead of a card from your stock.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 two of your 【STAND】 characters] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Good, I really love to see the two of you getting along.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: "Parfum Magic" Ichiya
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, put this card into your memory.
flavor: But don't cry. I'm here.

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【ACT】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] Choose one of your 《Dragon》 characters, and that character gets +2500 power until end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Ur's Student, Gray
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Gray's Teacher, Ur" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Gray's Teacher, Ur" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)

name: Juvia Loxar

name: Wendy Marvell
text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When a card named "Sky Dragon Roar" is placed on your climax area, and this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: Clothes-removing Habit, Gray
text:
【AUTO】 Change [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your memory] At the beginning of your encore step, if this card is 【REST】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Fairy Tail Wizard, Gray" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.
【ACT】 [(1)] Draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: Fairy Tail Wizard, Juvia

flavor: Look at me, Gray!!! Do you like what you see?

name: Gray Fullbuster
text:
【CONT】 Memory If a card named "Gray's Teacher, Ur" is in your memory, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Ice Geyser" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 1 or lower characters, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Ice Make--

name: "A New Goal" Gray

name: Childhood Wendy
text: 【ACT】 [(1)] Choose one of your 《Dragon》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Castle Wall of Ice, Gray
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card.

name: Magic Cards, Cana
text: 【CONT】 Assist During your opponent's turn, all of your characters in front of this card get +1 level and +500 power.
flavor: We need everybody on their feet to fight these guys!!!

name: "Ur's Teachings" Gray
text:
【CONT】 Memory If a card named "Gray's Teacher, Ur" is in your memory, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: Yeah, 'cause that's what Ur taught us. Single-handed spell casting is incomplete and unbalanced.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gray's Teacher, Ur
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if the number of 《Ice》 characters you have is two or more, you may choose a card named "Gray's Teacher, Ur" in your waiting room, and put it into your memory.
【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.)
flavor: I've freed you from the darkness, Gray. I've sealed it away forever.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Maiden in Love, Juvia
text: 【CONT】【CLOCK】 Alarm When this card is the top card of your clock, if the number of 《Love》 or 《Ice》 characters you have is four or more, at the beginning of your climax phase, search your deck for up to one 《Love》 or 《Ice》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: There must be something wrong with me. Why is my heart beating so fast?
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gray's Determination
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a character from your hand into your memory] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do not, put this card into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Ice Cannon" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
flavor: I'll seal the demon myself!!!!
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: "Ur's Tears" Ultear
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【ACT】 [Put one of your other characters from your stage into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Draw up to two cards, choose two cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room.
flavor: They took down an entire guild with a handful of wizards. That is quite a feat.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Phantom Wizard, Juvia
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Water Lock" is in your climax area, choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters. That character cannot 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: Drip drip drop..
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: "Healing Spell" Wendy
text:
【CONT】 If the number of your other 《Magic》 characters is three or more, this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 two of your characters] Put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Well, that should do it. I got rid of all the venom. Now all we have to do is wait.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Juvia of the Great Sea
text:
【CONT】 If you would pay the 【ACT】 cost for one of your characters in your hand or stage, you may put a marker from underneath this card into your waiting room instead of a card from your stock.
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 two of your 【STAND】 characters] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Juvia is a part of Element 4, as well as the rain woman.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Cold Emperor, Lyon
text: 【AUTO】 [(2) Put this card into your memory] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one card named "Fairy Tail Wizard, Gray", reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: That's why I'm resurrecting Deliora. To prove that I am more than Ur's star pupil.
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Cana Alberona
text: 【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: Elfman can hold his own against Phantom....
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Cait Shelter Master, Robaul
text: 【ACT】 [(1)] Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn. At the end of the turn, put this card into your memory.
flavor: And now.... My post can be vacated, for that person has been found.

name: Honest and Brave, Wendy
copyright: (c) Hiro Mashima・KODANSHA/Fairy Tail Guild・TV TOKYO. All Rights Reserved.

name: Moon Drip
text:
Search your deck for up to one level 3 or higher character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
You may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: While the Iced Shell is strong, it can still be melted using Moon Drip. Focused moon energy can break any magical spell.
