copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Badass Indomitable Leader, Kamina
text:
【CONT】 If you have another card named "Simon the Digger", this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: They're talking about ME, the mighty Kamina!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: The Brutal Surface, Yoko
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Team DAI-GURREN》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a cost 0 or lower character on your opponent's back stage, and put it into his or her stock.
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Team GURREN's Leader, Kamina
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Team DAI-GURREN》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: I'll be a man that won't be laughed at by that back.
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Who The Hell Do You Think I Am??!!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Combining is all about one fighting spirit slamming into another!!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Chibi Pig-Mole, Boota
text:
【CONT】 All of your other cards named "Giha Village Youth, Simon" get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Giha Village Youth, Simon" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named “Giha Village Youth, Simon” in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Bwi!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Simon the Digger
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, if you have another character with "Kamina(カミナ)" in its card name, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, draw up to one card.
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: LAGANN
text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your 《Team DAI-GURREN》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Heaven-Piercing Drill, LAGANN
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Team DAI-GURREN》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "Bust Through the Heavens with Your Drill!!" is in your climax area, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Woooaaaaahhhhhhhhh-------!!!

text:
【CONT】 If there are no markers underneath this card, this card gets -4000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose a card named ""Bro" Kamina" or "Team GURREN's Leader, Kamina" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: GURREN
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to two cards in your waiting room named "Combine! GURREN LAGANN", and put them at the bottom of your deck in any order.
【ACT】 Fusion [Put a card named "LAGANN" from your stage face up underneath this card as a marker] Search your deck for up to one card named "Combine! GURREN LAGANN", put it on this card's stage position, put this card and all markers underneath this card face up in any order underneath the card named "Combine! GURREN LAGANN" as markers, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Dumbass! What else would I be talking about?! We're gonna combine!!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Save My Bro! Simon
text: 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to two times per turn. When your other 《Team DAI-GURREN》 character is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Team DAI-GURREN》 character, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Brooo---!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Combine! GURREN LAGANN
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by a "Fusion" effect, draw up to two cards, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal one damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: A combining of courage that sets a man's soul on fire!! GURREN LAGANN!!!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Cross Counter
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your cards named "Combine! GURREN LAGANN" in battle, and until end of turn, that character gets +3000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may deal four damage to your opponent." (This damage may be canceled)
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Bust Through the Heavens with Your Drill!!
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Kamina: "Farewell, Giha Village! We're off to the surface! Off to the surface I saw as a kid!"
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: There's A Surface, All Right!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: This big mug fell from the surface! It fell from above!
copyright: © GAINAX, KAZUKI NAKASHIMA / Aniplex, KONAMI, TV TOKYO, DENTSU

name: Baking Diligently! Makina
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose 1 card from among them, put it on the top of your deck, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, you may return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Today's a special treat fer my favorite curry fanatic. I baked us some curry bread!

name: Towards the Shimmering Sea, Michiru
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Grisaia》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Dangerous Air Mattress" is in your climax area, and you have another 《Grisaia》 character, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to 1 level X or lower 《Grisaia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Kittymeow, let's get out of here!

name: The Fruit in God's Grasp, Kazuki
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the level of that card +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Don't worry, I'm not going to die... We'll definitely meet again someday, okay?

name: Farewell and Promise, Kazuki
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 Memory If this card is in your memory, when your card or your opponent's card in the clock is put into the waiting room due to respective card effects, that player may choose 1 card in their hand, and put it into their waiting room. Otherwise, that player puts the top card of their deck into their clock.
flavor: I'm saying that I'll be the decoy...

name: Afterschool Sunset, Makina
text:
【CONT】 Memory This card gets +1000 power for each "Feeding" in your memory.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Memory When this card attacks, if "Full-Scale Combat Training" is in your climax area, you may choose 1 level X or lower 《Grisaia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the number of cards in your memory.
flavor: ...What about Onii-chan?

name: Together with Meowmel, Michiru
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and return it to their hand.
flavor: It's not like I'm lonely or anything, for your information.

name: Fruit of Remorse, Michiru
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, if this card is in your center stage, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +4000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Afterschool Sunset, Michiru" in your waiting room, and put it in the stage position that this card was in.
flavor: How pathetic, you guys!

name: Fruit of Remorse, Makina
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if "Sleepy Eyes" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal the same damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Hnn... nnnnn...

name: Summer Festival Sniper, Makina
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, move this card to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: ...Hunfh!!

name: Atop the Hill Facing the Sea, Michiru
text: 【CONT】 If your stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: Who...? What's that supposed to mean?

name: Superb Team, Makina & Sachi
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Feeding" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Makina: "Sacchin, if ya'd be so kind!"

name: “Ichigaya” JB
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Grisaia》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: We don't have tax money to spend on malfunctioning national defense equipment.

name: Annoying Tsundere, Michiru
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +4500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or waiting room, you may choose 1 "Natural Born Tsundere, Michiru" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Natural Born Tsundere, Michiru" in your waiting room, and put it in the stage position that this card was in. (This ability does not activate if this card is not in the stage at the beginning of the climax phase)
flavor: ...Shaddup, stuuuupid.

name: A Summer Memory, Amane & Makina
text: 【CONT】 Memory This card gets +1500 power for each "Feeding" in your memory.
flavor: Makina: "...I'm kinda interested, but... I've never really played with fireworks before."

name: “Swimsuit” Michiru
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you cannot use "【AUTO】 Encore" until end of turn. (You cannot use the "【AUTO】 Encore [(3)]" rule either)
flavor: Here we are! The beaaach!

name: The Meaning of a "Kiss", Michiru
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, this card gets +2 soul until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
flavor: It's fine! You have my authorization! Just do it!

name: Overwhelming Difference in Skill, Yuuji
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Bread》 characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is 2 or higher, this card gets +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]"."
【CONT】 Your other level 0 or lower character in the middle position of your center stage gets +1000 power.
flavor: Nice shirt. Where'd you buy it?

name: An Abrupt Visit, JB
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +1500 power for each of your other "Surprise Attack, Yumiko & Yuuji".
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Grisaia》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Surprise Attack, Yumiko & Yuuji", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Heyo! Enjoying your school life?

name: Pretend Lover, Michiru
flavor: Pretend is fine, but... I wanna kiss.

name: Riding Tandem, Makina & Yuuji
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
【AUTO】 Change [(1) Put 1 《Grisaia》 character from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose this card and 1 "I'm Not a Child, Makina" in your level, and exchange them. (The character is placed on your stage as 【STAND】)
flavor: Makina: "You're a pretty good driver, Papa, aren't ya?"

name: Naïve and Innocent, Makina
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +4000 power.
flavor: M'keh! Perfection!!

name: I'm Not a Child, Makina
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by "Change", you may choose 1 of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, and put it into their stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
flavor: ...Well? I'm not... a child, right...?

name: Feeding
text:
Choose 1 《Grisaia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
Put this card into your memory.
Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Eat it all up and get nice an' plump, yeah?

name: Fresh-Fish Superman Tunafish Man
text: Choose up to 5 of your characters, put them into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of characters put into your waiting room by this effect. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: As long as there are saltwater fish crying out for a savior... The tuna of justice will appeaaar!

name: Dangerous Air Mattress
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Oh geez, it's kinda wobbly after all.

name: Full-Scale Combat Training
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Roger that, safety on...

name: Sleepy Eyes
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Derived Answer, Yuuji
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Grisaia》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have another 《Grisaia》 character, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: If anyone else comes to kill her, I'll eliminate them one by one...

name: Lone Wolf Disposition, Yumiko
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Thundering Roar Under the Bridge" is in your climax area, put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock, and reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return the revealed card to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: W-Wait!

name: During the Peaceful Days, Kazuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Grisaia》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, if "Clinging Wish" is in your climax area, choose up to 2 《Grisaia》 characters in your waiting room, and put them into your stock in any order.
flavor: A debt is always more profitable when you postpone the collection.

name: Innocent Heart, Makina
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Grisaia》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 Memory If your memory has 2 or more cards, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Papa! Lookit me, lookit me!!

name: Assertive Stance, Amane
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. At the end of this card's attack, if "Ticket to Heaven" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at the top card of your opponent's deck, put it on the top or at the bottom of their deck, and 【STAND】 this card.
flavor: Hey, Yuuji...

name: Afterschool Sunset, Yumiko
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Grisaia》 character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: I see... Yes, I understand.

name: Blazing Clutches, Makina
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +1000 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to 1 《Grisaia》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: ...Papa... It's burning... The bakery's... burning...

name: During the Peaceful Days, Amane
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Grisaia》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3)] Choose 1 "Clinging Wish" in your waiting room, and put it into your climax area.
flavor: Over here, Kazuki.

name: Psychology Test, Kazuki
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Grisaia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: So, who shall we save first? I'll let you decide.

name: Yuuji Kazami
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Grisaia》 characters among those cards ×1000.
flavor: ...I guess it's a little difficult, turning into something like that all of a sudden.

name: Will to Confront, Yumiko
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it into their waiting room.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: To cut myself free of you.

name: The Worst Outcome, Makina
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 2 or higher, you may 【REST】 this card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor: ...No way... This can't be happenin'...

name: Raison d'Être, Yumiko
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Grisaia》 characters you have.
【ACT】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +7000 power until end of turn.
flavor: ...Not as many clouds as before. Bit of a different feeling…

name: Withering Heart, Makina
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each other 《Grisaia》 character in your back stage.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your "Yuuji Kazami" is put into your waiting room from the stage, if this card is in your waiting room, you may pay the cost. If you do, put this card in any position of your stage as 【REST】.
flavor: ...Papa... you liar...

name: Overly Caring Wife, Amane
text:

text:

【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Dengeki Bunko》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 2 level 2 or lower characters in your opponent's center stage. If you chose 2 characters, choose 1 of the following effects, and perform it. "Choose the character with the lowest power from among those cards, and put it into your opponent's waiting room." "If all of the characters from among those cards have the same power, put all of the characters from among those cards into your opponent's waiting room."
flavor: Matthew: "How's it going?"

name: Cold-Calling Hero, Emi
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 《Dengeki Bunko》 character in your waiting room at the bottom of your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 level 1 or lower character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: ...Why am I doing something like this?

name: Demon Army of a Single Room, Maou
text:
【AUTO】 When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [TREASURE] in its trigger icon, if there are 1 or less markers underneath this card, you may look at the top card of your deck. If you do, put that card face down underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [Put 2 markers from underneath this card into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +9000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I will show you that I can become a full-time employee in this world!

name: Bridge Between the Two Worlds, Suzuno & Chiho
text:
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets 《Udon》 and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose 1 card from among them, put it on the top of your deck, and put the rest into your waiting room."
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor: Chiho: "Because you told me that you believe in me."

name: Demon Army of a Single Room, Urushihara & Ashiya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your other characters get the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Urushihara: "That's why I said we should go buy winter clothing for me!"

text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +4000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Dengeki Bunko》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)

text:

flavor: Aiwass: "Those who committed major mistakes in the past and try to walk down the right path while in anguish from that mistake."

name: Espers from Tokiwadai, Shokuhou and Mikoto
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if you have 3 or more other characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if there is a climax in your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Shokuhou: "Oops, sorry, Misaka."

name: Important Existence, Takitsubo & Hamazura
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's memory."
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Aiwass: "Those who did not get chosen by anyone, possess no hero-like qualities, and yet become a hero for the sake of a single person."

name: Pure Sister, Index
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Dengeki Bunko》 or 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: My name is Index, you know?

text:
【CONT】 This card gets -3 level while in the stage. This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects, and the character facing this card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

"【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, perform the following action 2 times. "Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.""
flavor: Aiwass: "Those who aren’t told what to do but try to move forward by following the feelings that well up from within themselves."

name: Magicians of the United Kingdom, Lesser & Index
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 level 1 or higher card from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Lesser: "It's ok to think of waiting for instructions as free time right?"

text:

Return the revealed card to its original place)

name: Golden Dream, Giorno & Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Golden Wind》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: I'll wager on your golden dream, Giorno Giovanna.

name: Seeker of Truth, Giorno
text:
【ACT】 [(1)] Choose 1 cost 0 or lower character on your opponent's center stage, and return it to his or her hand.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Can you avoid destruction, Boss?

name: Path Within the Darkness, Mista
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Giorno! I see the path I need to take through the darkness!

name: The Path Ahead, Giorno
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 1 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Resolve doesn't mean sacrifice!

name: Final Form, G.W.R
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by the 【ACT】 ability of "The One Chosen by Fate, Giorno", you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card frontal attacks, if "The World's "Truth"" is in your climax area, this card gets the following ability until end of turn.
"【AUTO】 [(3)] At the beginning of your encore step, you may pay the cost. If you do, perform the following action 2 times. "Deal 1 damage to your opponent."" (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: You will never arrive at the "truth" that is going to happen!

name: Embodiment of Justice, Giorno
text:
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, choose 1 of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters, 【REST】 it, and move it to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: I can't say I feel blessed at all, even though I'm looking at you. Because I've been winning against you from the start.

name: Simmering Fury, Fugo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Rampant Death" is in your climax area, and you have another 《Golden Wind》 character, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to 1 level X or lower 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: It's not something that's spoken. He has true loyalty within him!

name: The One Chosen by Fate, Giorno
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Golden Wind》 characters in front of this card get +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Final Form, G.W.R" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [(2) Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] If you are level 3 or higher, choose 1 "Final Form, G.W.R" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.

name: Heavy Gunshots, Mista
text:
【CONT】 If "Path Within the Darkness, Mista" is in your clock, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Therefore, we can shoot them into you!

name: Angry Lunatic Tendencies, Fugo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, search your deck for up to 1 "Savage Smoke, P.S", put it face up underneath this card as a marker, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] If you are level 1 or higher, choose 1 "Savage Smoke, P.S" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 level 1 or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: After that, Fugo underwent Polpo's test and gained Purple Smoke.

name: Closing in on Death, Mista
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [Reveal 1 "6 Together as 1, S.B" in your hand & Put it face up underneath this card as a marker] Draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] If you are level 1 or higher, choose up to 5 "6 Together as 1, S.B" markers underneath this card, and put them on separate positions of your stage.
flavor: Bucciarati: "Mista, you're going to take that ice and defeat the enemy…"

name: Harbinger of Hope, Polnareff
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 "Room in the Turtle" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Where did the one you brought here go?!

name: Bizarre Investigation Request, Koichi & Reverb Act 3
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot move to another position of the stage.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1 level and +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Act 3!

name: Abundance of Life, G.W
text: 【CONT】 All of your opponent's characters get the following ability. "【AUTO】 Accelerate [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2500 power until end of turn."
flavor: Useless!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: He's all pale and screaming!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: That fishing-rod-looking thing is his Stand!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: Mista----!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: Waaaaah! We have to aim lower or else the ice won't get blown out of the glass!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: A bit lower! Aim a bit lower!

name: 6 Together as 1, S.B
text:
【CONT】 You can put up to 6 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 soul for each of your other "6 Together as 1, S.B".
flavor: Over here! Blast right into it!

name: Savage Smoke, P.S
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by the 【ACT】 effect of "Angry Lunatic Tendencies, Fugo", this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Golden Wind》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Abbacchio: "Stay back. When Purple Smoke uses its fists, no one can stay nearby."

name: Smoke of Death, Fugo
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Golden Wind》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] During your turn, when this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 2 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: You'll be the one dying when you witness my ability!

name: Silent Dance, C.R
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 2 of your opponent's characters, exchange them as 【STAND】, and those characters get +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Mista: "It's going to pick up the arrow! It's going to pick it up!"

name: A New Power, G.W
flavor: Giorno: "Bring it back, Golden Wind!"

name: Determination of Life, Giorno
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", put the top 3 cards of your deck into your waiting room.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: I hate repeating myself when I shouldn't have to.

name: A New Power, Giorno
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +7500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "A New Power, G.W" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: I'll do it! You're not getting way.

name: Unexpected Clean Freak, P.S
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +2500 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
flavor: Abbacchio: "It's really high strung, and really cares about being clean."

name: Determined Stand, S.B
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if ""The Path" to Resolution" is in your climax area, choose up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, put it into your stock, search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Mista:"He can't get past me!"

name: Ladybug Brooch
text: 【COUNTER】 Search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your deck, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】."
flavor: Spicy Lady: "You and I are going to protect 'Giorno's left hand'!"

name: The "Arrow" of Hope
text: Choose 1 of your characters, and put it into your stock. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card has 1 or more of the same trait as the character put into your stock by this effect, put that card on any position of your stage. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Diavolo: "The 'arrow'… The 'Stand'…"

name: The World's "Truth"
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Useless! Useless! Useless! Useless! Useless! Useless!

name: "The Path" to Resolution
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I'm still conscious! I can still shoot him!

name: Rampant Death
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Abbacchio: "And once the virus spreads, it doesn't matter who's nearby, be they friend or foe."

name: Fear of Shrinking, Formaggio & T.F
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all characters on your opponent's center stage get -500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: This bottle is gonna be the ring, Narancia!

name: Crucial Compability Check, Melone & Bh
text:
【AUTO】 When your characters' trigger check reveals a climax, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose 1 level X or lower 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: And that's so perfect!

name: Grand Teachings, Prosciutto
text:
【CONT】 Memory This card gets +2000 power for each "Grand Teachings, Prosciutto" in your memory.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if you have 2 or less cards in your memory, you may put this card into your memory.
flavor: You're a damn mammoni, Pesci. You freaked out.

name: Grand Teachings, Pesci & F.M
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【CONT】 Memory This card gets +1500 power for each "Grand Teachings, Prosciutto" in your memory.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Grand Death" is in your climax area, put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock, choose up to 1 "Significance of Resolution, Prosciutto & T.D" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Once we think of killing someone, Bro, the deed has already been done!

name: Freezing World, Ghiaccio & W.I
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: My ability, White Ice, freezes the moisture in the air to an extremely low temperature, which I then wear like armor.

name: Flipped World, Illuso & M.M
text: 【AUTO】 [(5) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of the counter step during your opponent's turn, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 level 1 or higher battle opponent facing this card, and put it at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Not even viruses can enter this Mirror Man's world!

name: Unavoidable Assassination, Risotto
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 2 characters from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your opponent's deck, choose up to 3 cards from among them, put them into your opponent's waiting room, return the rest to your opponent's deck, and your opponent shuffles his or her deck.
flavor: I won't get closer to you.

name: Man in the Mirror, Illuso
text: 【CONT】 All of your opponent's characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
flavor: Fugo: "I saw him in this mirror!"

name: Conception of the Two, Bh
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(3) Put 1 character from your stage into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 event card or climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Simple is best. I'm going to kill this bastard exactly how I want to kill him!

name: A Traitor's Dignity, Risotto & Mt
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Controller of Magnetism" is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor: I can't wait to see what your face will look like once you die!

name: Resourceful Assassin, Formaggio
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 character from your stage into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, put it into your opponent's waiting room, your opponent chooses up to 1 level 0 or lower character in his or her waiting room, and puts it on the stage position that character was on.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: What determines if something worthless or not is how you use your brain.

name: Significance of Resolution, Prosciutto & T.D
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all characters on your opponent's stage get -X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's level ×1000.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "Grand Death" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 4 damage to your opponent, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -3000 power until end of turn. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Defeating me, even if it costs the lives of your crew, to protect the girl… Isn't that your mission?

name: Mammoni, Pesci & F.M
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a level 0 or lower character among those cards, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, if your memory has 2 or less cards, you may choose 1 "Grand Teachings, Prosciutto" in your waiting room, and put it into your memory.
flavor: Uwaaaaaaaaaaah what do you think you're doingggg---!

name: Targeting the Hidden Treasure, Zucchero & T.M
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Golden Wind》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Targeting the Hidden Treasure, Sale & A&C", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Targeting the Hidden Treasure, Sale & A&C" in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage as 【REST】.
flavor: Stay back, Bucciarati! I'll kill your friends!

name: Targeting the Hidden Treasure, Sale & A&C
flavor: I can easily deflect a bullet from a puny little pistol.

name: Gently Weeps, Ghiaccio & W.I.G.W
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and 【REVERSE】 this card's battle opponent.
flavor: Gases turn to liquids, and liquids turn to solids!

name: The Disappearance of Sorbet and Gelato
text: Choose 1 of your 【STAND】 《Golden Wind》 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, choose up to 2 of your opponent's characters, and those characters get -1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Illuso: "They're two crazy bastards."

name: Controller of Magnetism
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 character with level equal to or lower than your level in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose up to 2 of your characters, and those characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Because you are already complete.

name: Grand Death
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Bro! Prosciutto! You're so awesome!

name: Remnant of the Past, Diavolo
text:
【CONT】 If this card is in your center stage, all of your 《Golden Wind》 characters get +1500 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from the effect of "Eternal Ruler", you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card. (This ability can also be used when this card is placed on the stage by the 【STANDBY】 effect of "Eternal Ruler" that was revealed during trigger check)
flavor: What's important, Polnareff, is what you were trying to tell Bucciarati and his men!

name: Erased World, E.C
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by the 【ACT】 effect of "Pride of a King, Diavolo", you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(4) Put 3 《Golden Wind》 characters from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, terminate the attack and proceed to the next attack declaration step. ("Trigger, Counter, Damage, and Battle Step" are skipped)
flavor: Diavolo: "Within Emperor Crimson's ability, this world's time disappears…"

name: Predator of the Waters, Cr
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】 ability, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: Narancia: "There's an enemy nearby!"

name: "Movements" in the Future, Doppio & Eu
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, you may return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Diavolo: "You have Emperor Crimson's arms and Eulogy!"

name: Spinner of Lies, T.M
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may choose 1 character on your opponent's center stage, and move it to an open position of his or her center stage.
flavor: Kekeke!

name: Sowing Seeds of Despair, Cioccolata & G.T
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Return this card to your hand] When "Cioccolata and Secco" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters, and 【STAND】 it.
flavor: Now they're cornered.

name: Pride of a King, Diavolo
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power. 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Erased World, E.C" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker. 【ACT】 [(2) Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] If you are level 3 or higher, choose 1 "Erased World, E.C" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: I'm so glad I didn't run away!

name: He Who Sinks Into the Ground, Secco & Sa
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Golden Wind》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Cioccolata and Secco" is in your climax area, and your waiting room has 3 or more characters, you may choose 3 characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand. If you do, choose 3 cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room.
flavor: I'm not going to strangle you. I'll bury you alive.

name: Tyrant Residing in Jail, Polpo
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: What do you think is the most important thing when it comes to choosing someone?

name: 10 Hours Ago, Pericolo
text:
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 level 1 or higher card from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into the waiting room. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: We mustn't leave any kind of evidence.

name: Harmonized Teamwork, Tiziano
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Golden Wind》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: We should stop Giorno's breathing immediately.

name: Harmonized Teamwork, Squalo
text: 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】 ability, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."
flavor: Quit being so pushy. I know, Tiz.

name: Restless Pursuer, N.C
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each marker underneath it.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may look at the top card of your deck. If you do, put that card face down underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Giorno: "Is this thing getting bigger by consuming my body?"

name: Leaky Eye Luca
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, you may put the top card of your opponent's deck into his or her waiting room. If you do, choose 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of his or her deck.
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may put this card into your stock.
flavor: You're finished!

name: Eternal Ruler, E.C
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of characters your opponent has.
flavor: Diavolo: "It's a gift granted to me by fate because I was able to defeat my past!"

name: Treat Time, Cioccolata
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Treat Time, Secco & Sa" get +1 soul.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You got the footage, didn't you, Secco?

name: Split Personality, Diavolo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Split Personality, Doppio" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on. (This ability does not activate if this card is not on the stage at the beginning of the climax phase)
flavor: Emperor Crimson!

name: Split Personality, Doppio
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "10 Seconds Into the Future" is in your climax area, this card gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, you may return this card to your hand."
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Split Personality, Diavolo" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on. (This ability does not activate if this card is not on the stage at the beginning of the climax phase)
flavor: He-Hey!

name: Revenge of the Dead, Carne
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Golden Wind》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Restless Pursuer, N.C" in your waiting room, and put it on any stage position as 【REST】.
flavor: Hehehe...

name: Treat Time, Secco & Sa
flavor: Uheh-?

name: Observer From the Shadows, S.S
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Golden Wind》 characters you have ×1000.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When a climax is placed on your opponent's climax area, if there is a climax in your opponent's waiting room with the same card name as the climax placed, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your opponent's deck into his or her waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that card's level. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: I'll give you one more chance. You have two possible paths.

name: Miraculous Public Telephone
text: 【COUNTER】 Return all cards from your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Doppio: "Click"

name: Polpo's Entry Test
text:
Put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 Memory When you level up, if this card is in your memory, put this card into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 Memory At the beginning of your main phase, if this card is in your memory, choose up to 2 《Golden Wind》 characters in your waiting room, put them in any order into your stock, and all of your characters get 《Passione》 until end of turn. Put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Polpo: "Now, take the lighter!"

name: Eternal Ruler
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, perform the [STANDBY] effect.
flavor: I, Diavolo, will be king, just like I've always been!

name: 10 Seconds Into the Future
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: B…Boss! I just saw it!

name: Cioccolata and Secco
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, perform the [STANDBY] effect.
flavor: 3, you say? You want 3 sweet ones? You little glutton.

name: Guiding Fate, Trish
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Golden Wind》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: The arrow is forever Giorno's!

name: Noble Resolutions, Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "The Sound of Farewell" is in your climax area, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're going to fail, no matter what, when you're a piece of shit.

name: Soul's Will, Bucciarati
text: 【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand. 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room. 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: I've accepted this as "fate".

name: Replaying the Past, Abbacchio
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put the top card of your stock on the top of your deck & Put this card into your waiting room] At the end of this card's attack, if "Under the Falling Sky" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Playback Investigation, M.J" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.
flavor: Well, we're talking fifteen years ago.

name: Beacon Dispelling the Darkness, Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, search your deck for up to 1 "The One Who Opens, Z.M", put it face up underneath this card as a marker, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] If you are level 1 or higher, choose 1 "The One Who Opens, Z.M" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: The most repulsive form of evil is to exploit innocent people who don't know anything, and to use others merely for one's own gain!

name: Choosing His Own Path, Narancia
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 2 or more other 《Golden Wind》 characters, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Trish is me! She's me!

name: Awakened Power, Trish
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Golden Wind》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Indestructible Flexibility, S.L" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 "Indestructible Flexibility, S.L" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Spicy Lady: "Trish! If we're able to protect it…"

name: Pursuer of Information, Abbacchio
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Playback Investigation, M.J" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [Put 2 《Golden Wind》 characters from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 "Playback Investigation, M.J" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: I'll use my Stand to solve this "mystery"!

name: Aerial Hunter, Narancia
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 5 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax among those cards. (Damage may be canceled)
【ACT】 [(1)] Choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're not getting away, Formaggio!

name: Determination to Uncover Truth, M.J
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When your opponent levels up, Playback.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 cost 0 or lower character in your waiting room, and put them on separate positions of your stage.
【REPLAY】 Playback You may choose 1 "Under the Falling Sky" in your climax area, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Abbacchio: "Oh hell."

name: Awakened Power, S.L
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 《Golden Wind》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: I've always been by your side.

name: The One Who Opens, Z.M
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Golden Wind》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Bucciarati: "You're there--!"

name: Indestructible Flexibility, S.L
text:
【CONT】 All of your opponent's characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Determination to Awaken" is in your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Golden Wind》 character, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Making things "softer"... Means they become harder to break than diamonds!

name: Rebelling Against Fate, Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, put it into your opponent's memory, at the beginning of the encore step, your opponent puts that character from your opponent's memory on any position of his or her stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent has level higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Prosciutto: "Are you trying to die?! You bastard!"

name: Rebelling, Trish
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 1 card, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, you cannot play "Backup" or event cards from hand."
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to 2 cards in your opponent's waiting room, return them to your opponent's deck, and your opponent shuffles his or her deck.
flavor: Arrivederci. (Goodbye)

name: Agile Aeroplane, L.B
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Golden Wind》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 500, Level 0 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Narancia: "It might be worth it to shoot the shit out of fatty there!"

name: The Right Path, Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
【AUTO】 [(1)] During your opponent's turn, if this card becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: I did this because I believe I'm right.

name: Transforming Path, Z.M
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to the open middle position of your center stage.
flavor: Bucciarati: "He's moving faster than me!"

name: Overwhelming Mental Strength, Narancia
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Destructive Tempest, L.B" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】 ability, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] If you are level 2 or higher, choose 1 "Destructive Tempest, L.B" marker underneath this card, and put it on any position of your stage. At the end of the turn, you may put that character face up underneath this card as a marker.

name: Heart of Justice, Abbacchio
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power and 《Tea》 until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""Key" to the Safe "Vehicle"" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: So he's inside the mirror...

name: Destructive Tempest, L.B
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Unflinching Spirit" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Golden Wind》 character, perform the following action X number of times. "Choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn." X is equal to the number of 《Golden Wind》 characters you have. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Narancia: "You know, if I can't shoot…"

name: Playback Investigation, M.J
text:
【CONT】 This card gets -2 level while on the stage.
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
flavor: Abbacchio: "That's the end of the conversation."

name: "Key" to the Safe "Vehicle"
text: Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to 1 level X or lower 《Golden Wind》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: The sixth platform… The drinking fountain with the turtle… This has to be the spot!

name: Room in the Turtle
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose 1 of your characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: It's creating this space and making the key itself the entrance so that we could hide inside.

name: The Sound of Farewell
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: ARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARIARI

name: Determination to Awaken
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: If I do something as lame as moving slow, it's going to catch up to me anyway!

name: Under the Falling Sky
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Abbacchio left us this at the very end! This is the boss's true face!

name: Unflinching Spirit
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: You're the guy who dragged Giorno away!

name: Pioneer of Fate, Mista
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Considering my skills… I'd say I'm next in line to become capo.

name: Pioneer of Fate, Giorno
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Some of them might want to follow you.

name: Pioneer of Fate, Fugo
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character on your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: I understand your reasons, and what you did was right, Bucciarati.

name: Pioneer of Fate, Narancia
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: I'll go! I'll go, too! I'm coming with you!

name: Pioneer of Fate, Bucciarati
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】 ability, choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1)] Draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: This is what true happiness is…

name: Pioneer of Fate, Abbacchio
text:
【CONT】 You cannot play "Backup" or event cards from hand.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
flavor: The only time I'm ever at ease is when I'm with you, Bucciarati.

name: Pioneer of Fate, Trish
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card’s battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: I've already known that... For a while...

name: Carrying on the Bloodline, Giorno
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your 《Golden Wind》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(2)]When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Golden Wind》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

flavor: The time for heaven has arrived at last.

text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)

text:

( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: Pale Snake: "It doesn't matter! You lost! Accept your fate and die!"

name: A New World
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: The true purpose of this ability is to guide the masses of humanity towards everlasting happiness.

text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, search your deck for up to 1 "Inherited Stand, W.F", put it face up underneath this card as a marker, and shuffle your deck.

【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Here I come.

name: To Save Her Father, Jolyne & S.O
text:
【AUTO】 Experience At the beginning of your climax phase, if the total level of the cards in your level is 3 or higher, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for 1 character with the same card name as a character on your stage, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: I have to come to terms with the fact that the sticker comes out of my hand.

name: Entrusted "Hope", Emporio Alnino
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose this card and 1 of your other characters, and put them into your memory. At the beginning of your next draw phase, put those characters from your memory in separate positions of your stage.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] If you have another character with "Experience", choose 1 card in your level and 1 card in your waiting room, and exchange them.

text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.

text:
【CONT】 If you have another 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

name: Inherited Stand, W.F
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.

If you do, choose 1 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Emporio Alnino: "I'm not the one in control here. This is Weather Forecast's hidden ability."

text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. name: Battle of Wits, F.F.
text:
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, if your stock has 3 or less cards, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
