flavor: What's a priest like you doing at this prison?

text:
【CONT】 If your stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Restructuring Manipulation" is placed on your climax area, if you have 2 or more other 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 characters, you may choose 1 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 marker underneath this card into your waiting room] When your other character is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to its previous stage position as 【REST】.
flavor: All right, stand up and get your ass in the driver's seat.

name: Will to Fight, Jolyne
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I don't understand it one bit, at least that's what I... come to realize.

text:

text:

flavor: Oh, how embarrassing, but I'll give them to you! The actual pair I'm wearing right this second.

name: Splitting and Fusing, Ermes Costello & Smc
text:
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: I need to see her. I've got questions, Jolyne Cujoh.

text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of the following effects, and perform it. "Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order." "This card gets +3000 power until end of turn."
flavor: Stone Ocean!!

name: The Weakness He Loves, Narciso Anastasia & D.D
text:
【CONT】 Experience During your turn, if the total level of the cards in your level is 2 or higher, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn."
【AUTO】 [【REST】 1 of your other 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 characters] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 card in your level and 1 card in your waiting room, and exchange them.
flavor: Since I broke out of prison, I've managed not to die somehow.

text:

【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Experience When this card attacks, if "The Resolve to Move Forward" is in your climax area, and the total level of the cards in your level is 2 or higher, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Stand User》 or 《Stand》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. If the character chosen is level 3 or higher, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: If he's the assassin sent to eliminate me...

text:

text:

flavor: I think that alone is enough for me to enjoy this whole summer vacation.

name: Miraculous Compatibility, Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

name: Subservient Relationship, Ai
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each other character with "Kaguya(かぐや)" in its card name in your back stage.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Brief Respite" is in your climax area, search your deck for up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: In other words, think of your account as your house.

name: Serious Showdown Between Geniuses, Ai
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Shuchiin》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, this card gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play event cards from their hand."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

name: First Phone Call, Kaguya
text:
【ACT】 Resonate [(1) Reveal 1 "Incident of the Century" in your hand & 【REST】 this card] Search your deck for up to 1 "Subservient Relationship, Ai", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 Resonate [(1) Reveal 1 "Incident of the Century" in your hand & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 "Subservient Relationship, Ai" in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: Ai Bestowing Courage
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Misfortunes never come singly. When you're dejected, you really go all out.

name: Bewitching Pose♪ Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, return all cards from your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)

name: At the School Gates, Ai
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "A Rainy Day" is in your climax area, and you have 2 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, this card gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn, and perform the following action 2 times.
"Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room."
flavor: If it works, how am I supposed to get home?

name: Smart Proposal, Kaguya
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Shuchiin》 characters you have.
【AUTO】【CXCOMBO】[(3) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. At the end of this card's attack, if "Delightful and Embarrassing First Mail" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other characters, and 【STAND】 it.
flavor: That's it! I'll protect my account, too!

name: Reminder, Herthaka
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Shuchiin》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When your opponent's character is placed on their stage by the [STANDBY] effect revealed during your opponent's character's trigger check, if you have another 《Shuchiin》 character, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: You mustn't do anything inappropriate.

name: Fearless Smile, Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand and 1 card in your level, and exchange them.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: It has to be a place with no one else. Just you and me.

text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Shuchiin》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Incident of the Century", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

text:

text:

flavor: Karen: "Everyone, look!"

name: About a Friend, Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal 1 "Ai Bestowing Courage" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: He's being too irresponsible, right?

name: Psychological Test, Kaguya
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [ICON:DRAW] in its trigger icon, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I-I suppose I'd take enough to make a lovely bouquet.

name: Smithee A. Herthaka
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Shuchiin》 characters.
flavor: Human actions are determined by one's desire, the id, and one's reason, the ego.

text:

text:

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by "Change", if you have 4 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, you may choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: It is you, Shirogane!

name: Regrettable Failed Plan, Kaguya
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 other 《Shuchiin》 character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, choose up to 1 card from the remaining cards, put it into your stock, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Shuchiin》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Miss Fujiwara... Would you like some tangerines?

name: Daring Present, Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you do not have another character in your back stage, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put it in any position of your back stage.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, at the beginning of your climax phase, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Your present is me.

name: For Her Master, Ai
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Mission Begins" is placed on your climax area, if you have 2 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Asking Nonchalantly, Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your 《Shuchiin》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Incidentally, what kind of underwear do you prefer?

name: True Love, Nagisa
text:
【CONT】 This card gets -1 level while in the stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card at the bottom of your deck.
flavor: She said "true love"!

name: Kaguya Who Wanted to Be Visited
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Shuchiin》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return the revealed card to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

name: Afraid of Her Master, Ai
text: 【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Shuchiin》, this card gets the following 2 abilities. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck." "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn."
flavor: After being tainted by a man, my lady has developed a strange fetish.

name: Maid's Counterattack, Ai
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Shuchiin》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "At the School Gates, Ai" or "Anti-Shirogane Fashion, Herthaka Ver. 2" or "Failed Strategy, Ai" in your waiting room, and put it in the stage position that this card was in. (This ability does not activate if this card is not in the stage at the beginning of the climax phase)
flavor: If you really want me to do it, Lady Kaguya, I will.

name: Failed Strategy, Ai
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +2000 power for each other 《Shuchiin》 character in your back stage.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] If this card is the top card of your clock, at the beginning of your main phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, return all cards from your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: I never said I could do it in one day!

name: On a Day of the Full Moon
text:
【COUNTER】 If you do not have a character with "Kaguya(かぐや)" or "Miyuki(御行)" in its card name, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Shuchiin》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
If you do not have a blue card in your memory, you may put this card into your memory.

name: Event at the Gym Storeroom!!
text:
If you do not have a 《Shuchiin》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. Put this card into your memory.
Choose in your waiting room 1 character with "Kaguya(かぐや)" in its card name and 1 other character with "Miyuki(御行)" in its card name, put them into your memory, at the beginning of your next draw phase, return those cards from your memory to your hand, and put this card into your waiting room.

name: Sudden Wedding Event
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Memories of the Student Council
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Mission Begins
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Petit Yu
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《Shuchiin》 characters, you may choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Shuchiin》 characters you have ×500.

name: Petit Chika
text:
【AUTO】 [Return 2 《Shuchiin》 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your 《Shuchiin》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.

name: Petit Miyuki
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +7500 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card.

name: Petit Miko
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or put into your waiting room from the stage, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Petit Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)

name: Brains of a Genius? Kaguya
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.

name: Brains of a Genius? Miyuki
text: 【CONT】 Experience During your turn, if the total level of the cards in your level is 1 or higher, this card gets +2500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn."

name: Holy Night's Gift, Chika
text:
【AUTO】 When you level up, put this card into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 yellow climax from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. If you put 1 card into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: On a Special Day, Miko
text:
【CONT】 If this card is in your stage, this card's card name will also be regarded as "Honor Student with High Morals, Miko(品行方正な優等生 ミコ)".
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 character with "Miko(ミコ)" or "Chika(千花)" or "Kobachi(こばち)" in its card name among those cards, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: Bond of the Student Council, Miyuki & Yu
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 event from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 event in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When you play an event, you may put this card into your stock.

name: Bond of the Student Council, Kaguya & Chika & Miko
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 "Words of Parting" or "Student Council Election" or "Photoshoot" from your memory into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Words of Parting" or "Student Council Election" or "Photoshoot" or "On a Day of the Full Moon" in your waiting room, and put it into your memory.
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 《Shuchiin》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Happy New Year, Kaguya
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Shuchiin》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you play an event, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [GATE] in its trigger icon, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: Daughter of a Back-alley Doctor, Mako
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put a card named ""Rampage" Ryuko" from your stage into your memory] When a card named "So now it's my turn!" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 character in your hand, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor: When people die of blood loss, that means they die!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Mako Can't Stop for Any Reason
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on stage from your hand, when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that card's level +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. This damage may be canceled)
flavor: My life's traffic lights are always yellow.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Worrying Mako
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters get +500 power.
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
flavor: If I was allowed to be her assistant, I'd be right there looking after her.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Fight Club President, Mako
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]"
flavor: I can't, not when we finally have a life of luxury!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Osaka Sightseeing, Mako
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of other 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters you have.
flavor: That's the newest Osakan spot, the Naniwa Sky Tower!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Second Year Class K, Ryuko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's stock.
flavor: *snore*…
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Fight Club Member, Ryuko
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card's level 2 or higher battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: Idiot! Snap out of it!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Ryuko in Pajamas
text:
【AUTO】 Bond／"Fight Club President, Mako" ［Put the top card of your deck into your clock］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Fight Club President, Mako" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
【ACT】 [(1)] This card gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: My Kamui's in the laundry!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Motionless Mako
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to two times per turn. When your character is put into clock from your hand, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Ryuko: "You bastard! What did you do to Mako!"
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Mako Eating Croquettes
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose one of your yellow characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room］ (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.)
flavor: Yummy, huh?
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: "Uber" Own Pace Mother, Sukuyo
text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] Choose one of your 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 characters, and until end of turn that character gets +1 soul and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
flavor: I know it's nothing fancy, but eat all you like.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Guts 'cause He Eats With Gusto
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Woof!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Mako with Glasses
flavor: It's enough to put a twinkle in anyone's eye, isn't it?
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Out of Place Rascal, Mataro
text: 【ACT】 [(2)] Choose one of your opponent's characters, until end of turn that character gets -500 power, and this card gets +3000 power.
flavor: You were totally bad-ass, swinging that scissor around half-naked.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Ryuko Living with the Mankanshoku Family
text: 【AUTO】 When a card named "Let's Eat!" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a 《Clothes》 or 《Family》 character, all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn. (The revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: Mako: "Don't just sit there, eat!"
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Back-alley Doctor, Barazo
flavor: Don't worry about it. The dead ones don't sue you.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Suspicious Croquettes
text: Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn. At the end of turn, put that character into your stock.
flavor: Sukuyo: "Oh, you. I use only non-poisonous ingredients."
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Classic Trap
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Ryuko: "Mako! Look out!"
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: So now it's my turn!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Don't!～～～
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Let's Eat!
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Mako: "It's like my fatigue's been alleviated, my diseases have been cured, and I'm full of vim and vigor or something!"
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Ragyo Plots Cocoon Sphere Birth
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +2000 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put a marker from underneath a card named "Great Spirit, Satsuki" underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Shinra Koketsu, Absolute Submission!" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Clothes》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: This shows that Satsuki was never worthy to be a vessel of the Life Fibers.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Spinning Wheel of Fate, Nui
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Clothes》, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it into your opponent's waiting room. If you do, your opponent will choose up to one level 0 or lower character from your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the stage position that character was on.
flavor: Go all-out when you play. Life's no fun if you don't.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership First Appearance: Monthly Newtype January 2014 issue

name: Nui Pulling Thread
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, if the number of characters in your opponent's center stage is one or less, choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, and that character gets -3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'm just dying to see you naked!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Owner of Scissor Blade, Nui
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, this card gets -1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When a card named "Surprise Confession" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on your center stage, search your deck for up to one card named "Owner of Scissor Blade, Nui", and put it on any position of your stage. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Didn't you see, I defeated that Goku Uniform just now.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Dodging Nui
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named "Spinning Wheel of Fate, Nui" in your hand, and put it on this card's stage position as the defending character.
flavor: Ooh.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: CEO of REVOCS, Ragyo
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +3000 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other cards named "Secretary to Ragyo, Hououmaru", and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock & Reveal a card named "Ready-made Nui" in your hand and put it face down underneath this card as a marker] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Sorry I'm late, Hououmaru.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Grand Couturier, Nui
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [Put a card named "Disguise" from your hand into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose a character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: How wonderful! I can't believe he was hiding something like that! That sly old dog.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Head Steward of Kiryuin Family, Kuroido
text:
【AUTO】 When you have refreshed your deck, you may put this card into your stock.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose a card in your clock, return it to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your clock.
flavor: Lady Satsuki, your mother has expressly forbidden the removal of that outfit.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: "Mind Stitching" Ragyo
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose one of your characters with marker, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You may have expected her to fight for you, but if I do this, she becomes my pawn.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Ready-made Nui
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Clothes》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore ［Put the top card of your deck into your clock］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Mon mignon pret-a-porter!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Secretary to Ragyo, Hououmaru
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Clothes》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Impossible, she broke free of your Mind Stitching…
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Whimsical Nui
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Clothes》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: You're in my way.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Head of Trap Development, Ogure
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is level 1 or higher, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0. The revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: Thank you, Matoi.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Satsuki's Mother, Ragyo
text: 【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters on your center stage, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: Well done.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Tennis Club President, Hakodate
flavor: So, you're saying that you want to face me, Tennis Club Captain Omiko Hakodate, in a tennis match!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Boxing Club President, Fukuroda
text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 ［Put this card from your hand into your waiting room］ (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.)
flavor: To boxers, these gloves and trunks are our uniform!
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Mysterious Girl, Nui
flavor: Satsuki: "Why have you come here， Nui Harime."
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Disguise
text: Choose one of your characters, and put that character into your waiting room. If you do, choose a level 2 or lower 《Clothes》 character in your clock, put it on any position of your stage, and put this card into your clock.
flavor: Ta-dah.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Surprise Confession
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Yep! It was me. I was the one who killed your father.
copyright: (C) TRIGGER, Kazuki Nakashima/Kill la Kill Partnership

name: Shinra Koketsu, Absolute Submission!
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

text:

text: 【AUTO】 Accelerate [Put 1 《Rent-A-GF》 character from your waiting room at the bottom of your clock] At the beginning of your opponent's climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card."

name: "I Can't Take it!" Ruka
flavor: You introduced Chizuru to your grandma as "girlfriend" but only called me friend!

text:

"【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, search your deck for up to 1 《Rent-A-GF》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck."

text:

text:
If you have 1 or less characters with "Ruka(瑠夏)" in their card names, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Put the top card of your deck into your clock, deal 79 damage to your opponent, search your deck for up to 2 ""I'm an Adult" Ruka", put them on separate positions of your stage, shuffle your deck, and those characters get +1000 power and +1 soul until end of turn. (Damage may be canceled)

text: Your opponent chooses 1 climax in their waiting room, returns all cards except that card from their waiting room to their deck, shuffles their deck, you choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Devil King Army Invades!" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name you have ×500.
flavor: Seems like you've got some kind of scheme in mind.

name: "Supportive Magic" Aqua
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", perform the following action. "You may choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. If you do, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room." You may perform this action as many times as you like.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Blessing. Blessing. Blessing. Blessing.

name: "Droopy Temptation" Sylvia
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put 2 《Devil King Army》 characters from your waiting room face up in any order underneath this card as markers]
When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""Synthesis With the Mage Killer" Sylvia" in your waiting room, put it on the position that this card is on as 【REST】, and put this card and all markers underneath this card face up in any order underneath that ""Synthesis With the Mage Killer" Sylvia" as markers.
flavor: Kazuma: "See, Sylvia-san here... She actually appreciates me."

name: "Beauty in a Yukata" Aqua
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 2 of your 《Adventurer》 or 《Goddess》 characters] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: It worked out all right!

name: "Surprise Blow" Aqua
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put 2 cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a level 0 or lower character among those cards, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: Sacred Exorcism!

name: "Chasing Down" Sylvia
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot move to another position on the stage.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: How unlucky for you. If you were cute boys, I might've spared you… But your people have made a mockery of us for too long.

name: "Composed Retreat" Sylvia
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 During the attack phase, you cannot return characters from your waiting room to your hand by your cards' effects.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, if this card is on the middle position of your center stage, move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: Let's meet again. When we do, we'll see who comes out on top.

name: "Close to Tears" Aqua
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put 2 cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Adventurer》 or 《Goddess》 characters among those cards ×1000.
flavor: Ow! Why'd you scratch me?!

name: "Burn to Nothingness" Sylvia
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【CONT】 All of your other 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name get +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] Choose 1 of your 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, and that character gets +2500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Burn! Burn! Let this village of lunatics be reduced to ash!

name: "Menacing Pose" Aqua
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Look, I'll let you walk away this one time, so scram. Go on, get!

name: "Discerning Eyes" Sylvia
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Devil King Army》 characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name you have ×1000.
flavor: I think I like you!

name: Devil King Army Invades!
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: Choose 1 of your 【STAND】 《Devil King Army》characters or characters with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, and 【REST】 it. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Devil King Army》 character or character with "Kazuma(カズマ)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your deck, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.

name: Protection of a Goddess
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Quest Failed
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Hey, are we in debt again now? What are we gonna do?!

name: Invasion of the Crimson Demon Village
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: You can stand there and watch as I wipe this village off the map!

name: Because Something Is!
expansion_raw: KONOSUBA -God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Legend of Crimson
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Kazuma: "Sylvia-san! Sylvia-san! Why do I feel something pressing into my butt?"

name: "A Knight's Duty" Darkness
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room.
flavor: That's a knight's duty, right?

name: "Mattress at Home" Megumin
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character on your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.

name: "Appearance of the Main Star" Yunyun
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 characters you have.
flavor: I can't abandon my friends.

name: "Magical Academy Field Trip" Aqua
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Kazuma always gets prickly when the subject of school comes up.

name: "With Great Vigor" Yunyun
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You really are worried about everyone! Aren't you?

name: Beach Angel, Marielle
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, put this card into your stock.
flavor: It's summer in the Elder Tales world! And summer is all about the beach.

name: Assassin, Akatsuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [【REST】 one of your characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Thanks for that! Going in! One more hit…… and we're done with this!

name: Lord's Ninja, Akatsuki
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Waltz for Two" is in your climax area, until end of turn, this card gets +4000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may deal one damage to your opponent."(This damage may be canceled)
flavor: So my…… My Lord…… do you have plans for the festival?

name: Crescent Moon Alliance, Serara
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: I need to look after all the new players we have, now, so…… Um……

name: Isuzu
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: I'm Isuzu and I am a bard class.

name: Dislikes Fashion? Akatsuki
text:
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
【ACT】 [【REST】 one of your 《Magic》 characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Look I-I am My Lord's personal ninja! I can’t wear such frilly things!

name: Adventurer, Rundellhaus
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【CONT】 This card cannot become 【REVERSE】 from your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects.
flavor:
I am, Rundellhaus Kode!
The Adventurer―――!

name: Serara
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 When another of your characters becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'm a level nineteen druid, and my subclass is maid.

name: Maiden's Heart, Akatsuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place.)
【AUTO】Change [(2) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Lord's Ninja, Akatsuki" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Hey, it's gonna fall off.

name: Rudy's Owner? Isuzu
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Rundellhaus(ルンデルハウス)" in its card name get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: He really is amazing…… But he's a dog.

name: Waltz for Two, Akatsuki
text: 【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +1500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
flavor: Weird? Really? I'm trying better…… I am.

name: Henrietta
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you do not have any other 《Magic》 characters, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: When it come to planning, nothing's too complicated for the amazing, masterful mind of Dark Shiro.

name: Reliable Accountant, Henrietta
text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Cleric, Marielle" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Cleric, Marielle" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Maybe, but she looks like she needs someone to throw her a life preserver……

name: Silent Worker, Akatsuki
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Milord, may I inflict great pain upon Naotsugu's face?

name: Sorcerer, Rundellhaus
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters.
【AUTO】 [(3) Put two cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal five damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: Let's do this, a little more elegantly this time!

name: Rundellhaus
text: 【AUTO】Change [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Adventurer, Rundellhaus" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: My graceful yet devastating techniques will annihilate our enemy. All you have to do is stand back and support me, okay?

name: Loves Nyan-ta, Serara
flavor: Wait a second, this isn't really so much like a maid…… This is more like…… being a housewife……?

name: Crescent Moon Shopowner, Marielle
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Why, we oughta have that five million gold in no time if we keep doing this business……

name: Shoryu
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another character with "Marielle(マリエール)" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Miss Marielle…… is this…… gonna help the kitchen any?

name: Petit Akatsuki
flavor: Do not call me "pip squeak"!

name: Cleric, Marielle
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card attacks, if a card named "Crescent Moon Alliance" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to two characters in your waiting room, return them to your hand, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: At a time like this, the more people on your side, the better!

name: Bard, Isuzu
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power and "【AUTO】Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
flavor: Come on. It wasn't worth any applause, was it?

name: Dolled Up Akatsuki
text: Choose up to two characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: Henrietta: "Ah…… My exhaustion is flying away……"

name: Waltz for Two
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
Akatsuki: "Milord, I'm really not that good…… I'm kinda clumsy."
Shiroe: "I saw you practicing."

name: Crescent Moon Alliance
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: You're okay, right……!? I-I'm like so glad, you made it back from Susukino sweetie～…

name: Nyan-ta
text:
【AUTO】 When another of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters, 【STAND】 that card and move it to another open position on your opponent's stage, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Show me a cat-man who doesn't talk like this and I'll set him straight, hmmmm.

name: Field Monitor, Minori
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When a card named "Simplified Full Control Encounter" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, until end of turn, all of your other characters get +2500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the bottom of your opponent's deck."
flavor: If I'm too scared to say it, nothing will change…… I've gotta say something!

name: Log Horizon's Representative, Shiroe
text:
【CONT】 You cannot take damage from your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects.
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] During your turn, when another of your character's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card is 【STAND】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -2 soul."
flavor: ……If you can't help them both, then don't. Focus on what you can, it'll help.

name: Full Control Encounter, Shiroe
text:
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1000 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, draw up to one card.
flavor: Naotsugu: "If I were to hazard a guess, I'd say he was fighting by looking thirty seconds ahead."

name: Waltz for Two, Shiroe
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is four or more, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Care to dance?

name: Log Horizon, Nyan-ta
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your characters is being frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to your hand.
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your 《Magic》 characters] Until end of turn, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking.
flavor: This is what I call a time to shine.

name: Determination to Change the World, Shiroe
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] When your other character attacks, if a card named "Log Horizon" is in your climax area, and this card is 【STAND】, you may pay the cost. If you do, until end of turn, that character gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw a card."
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Give me your assistance. Help me, and my guild.

name: Reliable Buddy, Naotsugu
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, your opponent may draw a card. If your opponent does, your opponent chooses a card from your opponent's hand, and puts it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: I've been watching you lately, man. And you need to lighten up some.

name: Guardian, Naotsugu
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters.
【CONT】 Great Performance (When your opponent attacks, if this card is in the middle position of your center stage and not 【REVERSE】, your opponent frontal attacks this card instead)
flavor: ……Toya, the job of a front-line tank is to absorb all the enemy hits, and to trust his companions to back him up when he needs it.

name: Guildmaster, Shiroe
text:
【AUTO】 Bond/ "Reliable Buddy, Naotsugu" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Reliable Buddy, Naotsugu" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
【ACT】 [(1)] Draw a card, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: And instead of losing your patience, you waited for me to figure it out just like that?

name: Rayneshia
text:
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your characters is put into the waiting room from the stage, if this card is on the back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to its previous stage position as 【REST】.
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Well a real gentleman wouldn't say something like that.

name: Sojiro
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, if the number of characters your opponent has is three or less, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: Master Shiro, Master Nyan-ta, it's been quite a while.

name: Everyone's Group Leader, Nyan-ta
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if the number of other 《Weapon》or 《Magic》 characters you have is one or less, put this card into your clock.
flavor: It's everyone's favorite, curry, myah.

name: Krusty
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: You have to want it and work for it.

name: Minori
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Samurai, Toya" and "Toya" get +1000 power.
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters get +1000 power.
flavor: We know we're not as strong as the rest of you are but we really wanna learn……

name: Maiden's Heart, Minori
text: 【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose one of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Say Ahhh!

name: Petit Naotsugu
text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] This card gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: I really need you to tell me before you do it next time!

name: Samurai, Toya
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card.
flavor: I didn’t forget, Master Naotsugu!

name: Toya
text:
【CONT】 If you have another character with "Minori(ミノリ)" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, if this card is on your center stage and not 【REVERSE】, all of your other characters get +1000 power.
flavor: If you've made a guild, we want to be in it.

name: Petit Shiroe
flavor: All of a sudden…… there I was.

name: Scribe, Shiroe
text: 【CONT】 If the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +3000 power.
flavor: I don't know what effect this magic will have on this world.

name: Isaac
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do not, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: You and your guild obviously put this thing together, so let's go over every little detail and work it all out.

name: Mind Shock
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +3500 power until end of turn.
flavor: It's a little risky, but we don’t have a choice.

name: Log Horizon
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Yeah, that's right, a name……

name: Simplified Full Control Encounter
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Naotsugu: "All these facts she's tracking has her fighting just like Shiro!"

name: Nureha
text:
【CONT】 When this card is in the stage, this card's card name is also regarded as "Dariella(ダリエラ)".
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other characters get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.

text:

"Ready Shiroecchi?"

text:
