【AUTO】 [Put 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Café LycoReco, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: That’s it!

name: Shrewd Accountant, Takina
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters.
【CONT】 【CXCOMBO】 Experience If "Business Crisis for Café LycoReco" is in your climax area, this card is in your center stage, "Time for Work♪ Chisato & Takina" is in your level, and you have another 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, all of your other "Drunk? Waitress, Mizuki", "Walnut's Identity, Kurumi", "Café LycoReco, Chisato", and "Café LycoReco, Mika" in all of your zones get [CHOICE] in the trigger icon.
flavor: Mizuki, um, I just finished coming up with a new parfait.

name: Grand Stunt, Mizuki
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character is put into your waiting room from the stage, if this card is in your back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to its previous stage position as 【REST】.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Café LycoReco, Mizuki" in your waiting room, and put it in any position of your stage as 【REST】.
flavor: Ohh man! And I totally had this

name: Café LycoReco, Takina
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Time for Work♪ Chisato & Takina" get +500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters in front of this card get +1500 power.
【ACT】 [(3) 【REST】 this card] Choose up to 1 "Time for Work ♪ Chisato & Takina" in your hand and put it in any position of your stage.
flavor: Alright everyone! Chisato needs to get changed before she can help you all.

name: Poster Girl, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【CONT】 During this card's attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: Now open wide!

name: Let's Game! Kurumi & Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, you may choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the level of that card +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Kurumi: "Hehehe!"

name: Café LycoReco, Kurumi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of the following effects, and perform it. "Your opponent returns all cards from their stock to their deck, shuffles their deck, and puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock." "You may choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and return it to their hand."

name: Unwavering Pride, Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Bold Lie" is placed on your climax area, if you have 4 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, draw up to 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your stock.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or a 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Why, that expensive bar from yesterday!

name: Complacent Smile, Kurumi
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 other character from your stage into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, move this card to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: Mizuki: "And what the hell are you so happy about?"

name: Café LycoReco, Mika
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, your opponent declares 0 or 1 or 2 or 3. Reveal the top card of your deck, and if that card is a character of the level that your opponent declared, put it in any position of your stage. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may put this card into your stock.
flavor: That’s right… She’ll be back home soon.

name: Sulking, Takina
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When your climax with [CHOICE] in its trigger icon is placed on your climax area, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: We need to stop making that parfait…

name: Thoughts on the New Dish, Chisato
text: 【CONT】 If you have 1 or less other characters, this card gets +1 level and +2500 power.
flavor: …cr- creamy goodness!

name: Genius Hacker, Kurumi
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: If you rely on computers you can forget to think for yourself.

name: Drink After Work, Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: She asked if we could give her a place to stay!

name: Figure of Speech, Chisato & Takina
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from your stage into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1 soul until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Chisato: "That's not what I mean! I’m sorry, Takina."

name: Café LycoReco, Mizuki
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters in front of this card get +500 power and +1 soul.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: Happy Halloween, Takina
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Be good now. Happy Halloween!

name: Trick or Treat, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, this card gets +1 soul until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, your opponent may put 2 cards from the top of their stock into their waiting room. If they do, this card cannot frontal attack until end of turn.
flavor: Trick or Treat!

name: Sudden Shot, Takina
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
flavor: What?

name: Drone Support, Kurumi
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +2500 power for each other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your back stage.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Great Achievement" is in your climax area, choose up to 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and this card gets +X power until the end of your opponent's next turn. X is equal to the number of 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Well, I guess I’ve got no choice…

name: Seeking the Truth Behind the Message, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor: Takina: "Is something the matter? You’re acting very strange today."

name: Ex-DA, Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×1000.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Mika: "This is Mizuki. She was also in DA. Intelligence Division."

name: Hot New Dish
text: Choose 1 of your 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When this card attacks, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
flavor: Now that it’s getting colder, I thought of the perfect ingredient. A swirl of tasty hot chocolate!

name: Whatever Your Order Is, Leave It All up to Us ♪
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: Chisato: "C’mere! Teach, Mizuki, squeeze in!"

name: Business Crisis for Café LycoReco
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: Then it must be done. From this moment on, our finances are my duty!

name: Bold Lie
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: 2- years old!

name: Great Achievement
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)
flavor: Kurumi: "Mr. Majima!"

name: My Definition of Justice, Majima
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: One fighting for the balance of Japan and one, for the status quo… But which is the real hero of justice?

name: Protecting Livelihood, Takina & Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Welcome to LycoReco" is in your climax area, and you have 2 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 "Their Time Together and the Future They Choose" or 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot move to another position of the stage."
flavor: Chisato: "And we’re the ones who make it possible!

name: Place to Return To, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if "Chosen Place of Belonging, Takina" is in your waiting room, this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Takina… Pretty cute, right?

name: Days That'll Continue On, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. At the end of this card's attack, if "Days Spent Together" is in your climax area, and you have 2 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card.

name: Close Shave, Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, move this card to an open position of your back stage.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other characters, put it face up underneath this card as a marker, at the beginning of your next draw phase, choose 1 character from the markers underneath this card, and put it in any position of your stage.

name: Naturally Gifted, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a level 2 or higher card among those cards, you may return this card to your hand. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: They mean everything to me. The state of the world? I really don’t care.

name: Captured, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot move to another position of the stage.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.

name: Valuing People’s Lives, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have a climax in your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: I’m leaving her to you for a while!

name: Before the End, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] During your climax phase, when "Persisting With Her Thoughts" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to 1 "Chosen Path, Chisato" in your hand, and put it in the stage position that this card was in.
flavor: I wanna know the honest truth! Like it?

name: Chosen Path, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose up to 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top or at the bottom of their deck.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: As a Senior, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 cost 0 or lower character in your waiting room, and put it in separate positions of your stage.
flavor: You really can’t get a read on people, can you? I’m surprised you can be a 1st like that.

name: Touring Tokyo, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [ICON:COMEBACK] in its trigger icon, your opponent puts the top 4 cards of their deck into their waiting room.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, perform the following action. "Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room."
flavor: I did it!

name: Invitation for an "Outing", Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 "Close Fight" or 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Takina: "Chisato, did you make that costume yourself?"

name: Reunion With Her Daughter? Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card at the bottom of your deck] Choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Flight Attendant: "Your daughter, separated at birth… She found you! She’s here!"

name: Alan Children, Majima
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if your stock has less cards than your opponent's stock, you may put this card into your stock."
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Why don’t you tell me what your mission is?

name: Unpredictable Attack, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 【CXCOMBO】 If "Desperate Opposition" is in your climax area, this card in all of your zones gets [STANDBY] in the trigger icon.
【CONT】 If you have 3 or more other characters, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: To New Lands, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's memory."
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Sheesh, Miss Saori… Someday you’re gonna take a picture of an alien or something…

name: Place to Meet, Mizuki
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, your opponent chooses 1 climax in their waiting room, returns all cards from their waiting room except that card to their deck, and shuffles their deck.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: I’d be all alone without a place to meet single men!

name: Words of Encouragement, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "My Decision, Takina" get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) 【REST】 this card from 【STAND】] When your other character is put into your clock from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

name: Father Figure, Shinji
text:
【CONT】 If you have another "Father Figure, Mika", all of your other characters with "Chisato(千束)" in their card names get the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card."
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: Meeting Her Savior, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If you have another "Father Figure, Shinji" and "Father Figure, Mika", this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your hand and put it into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Father Figure, Shinji" or "Father Figure, Mika", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Mr. Savior! Say cheese!

name: At the Old Radio Tower Once More, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or a 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 [Return 2 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Hey! Nice one! Hang on a little longer!

name: Father Figure, Mika
text:
【CONT】 If you have another "Father Figure, Shinji", all of your other characters with "Chisato(千束)" in their card names get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Fun Times, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If you have 1 or less other characters in your center stage, this card gets +4000 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your attack phase, if this card is
【STAND】, and you have 1 or less other characters in your center stage, put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock, look at the top card of your deck, choose up to 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Life Expectancy Announcement, Chisato
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your encore step, put this card into your waiting room, and reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 2 or higher, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Before the End, Chisato" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Even before this, I didn’t have much time left.

name: Panty Check, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +10500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Panty Check, Takina" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Takina: "If we’re discussing what would suit me, this isn’t my style, right?"

name: Infiltration Mission, Chisato
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 characters, you may choose 1 《LycoReco》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock

name: Close Fight
text:
【COUNTER】 If you do not have a character with "Chisato(千束)" in its card name, this card cannot be played from your hand. Perform the following action 4 times. "Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room."
Put this card into your memory.

name: Welcome to LycoReco
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [ICON:COMEBACK] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Chisato: "Takina! Wait, have we met?"

name: Days Spent Together

text:

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: So make a contract with me and become a magical girl!

text:
【AUTO】［(2)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

flavor: And, I am one who has made a contract with Kyubey, a magical girl.

text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, if the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets +1 soul.
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, this card gets +1000 power until end of your next turn.

name: Mami is "No Longer Alone"
text: 【AUTO】 When this card frontal attacks, if a card named "I'm not afraid of anything anymore" is in your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a climax, this card gets -4500 power until end of turn. If it is not, this card gets +4500 power until end of turn. （The revealed card is returned to its original place.）
flavor: I feel so light today. This is the first time I've felt so happy during a fight.

name: Mami's Wish in Order to Live
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Change ［(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Mami Endures Her Fate" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: It isn't a good thing…… to be a magical girl.

name: Mami's Bind Magic
text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] （Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.）
flavor: Akemi, go for it!

name: Mami Enjoys Tea
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】［【REST】 this card] Choose one of your characters with "Madoka" in its card name, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Yes, often at the risk of my life. That's why you two should think very carefully before deciding to become magical girls.

name: Mami's Advice
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: - Then take care to ensure that our paths will never cross again.

name: Veteran Magical Girl, Mami
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When you have refreshed your deck, you may put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: I'm fine. As though I could let myself look so uncool in front of my future magical girl juniors!

name: Mami Passes on Hope
flavor: You're becoming hope itself. The hope of us all.

name: Mami Watches Over Quietly
flavor: Oh, goodness…… Some role model I'm supposed to be…… I'm really no good at this, am I…

text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the number of 《Magic》 characters you have.

name: In an Instant
text: Choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it into your opponent's memory.
flavor: - Huh?

name: I'm not afraid of anything anymore
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: --Because, I'm not alone anymore.

text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

【AUTO】【CLOCK】 Shift, Level 2 (At the beginning of your main phase, you may choose a green card in your hand and this card in your clock, and exchange them.)

【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Don't tell anyone else in class, okay?" is in your climax area, choose up to one of your other characters, put that character into your memory, and at the beginning of your next draw phase, put that character in your memory on any position of your stage.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Don't tell anyone else in class, okay?" is in your climax area, this card gets +2000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.

text:
【AUTO】［Return two characters in your waiting room to your deck. Shuffle your deck afterwards.] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】【CLOCK】 Shift, Level 0 (At the beginning of your main phase, you may choose a green card in your hand and this card in your clock, and exchange them.)

text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm ［(1) 【REST】 two of your characters］ Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: She is the one person I absolutely cannot allow to make the contract.

text: 【CONT】 If the number of 《Magic》 characters you have is two or less, you cannot play this card from your hand.
flavor: How can I tell you what I’m really feeling.

text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is four or more, this card gets +1000 power.

Even then--
I'm a magical girl. I have to protect everyone.

text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.

【AUTO】［Put a 《Magic》 character from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your memory] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, at the beginning of your next draw phase, choose a card named "Magical Girl of Time, Homura" in your memory, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor: No one will accept the truth about the future. Then I--

text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When you have refreshed your deck, you may put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Kyubey: "Even I can't completely gauge how large the Soul Gem you'd create would be."

name: Ultimate Madoka
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】［Put this card into your memory］ When a card named "Madoka's Wish" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one card named "Homura "Fights On"", and put it on the stage position that this card was on. Shuffle your deck afterwards, and that character gets +3000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: My wish was to erase all witches.

name: Madoka's Bond with Homura
text:
【AUTO】［(2)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Magic》 character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
【AUTO】 Bond／"Homura's Hidden Feelings" ［(1)］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Homura's Hidden Feelings" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: I'm going to become a magical girl.

name: Madoka's Battle with Walpurgisnacht
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other characters you have is two or less, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: Good-bye, Homura. Take care.

name: Madoka Protects Hope
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose one of your green characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] （Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.）
flavor: If someone like me can help people and live my life with pride, that would be my greatest dream.

name: Homura's Determination
text:
【AUTO】 Change ［(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Magical Girl of Time, Homura" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
【ACT】［【REST】 this card］ Choose one of your 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: No one…… will believe me about the future……

name: Time Regressor, Homura
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck, choose one of your characters named "End of Karma for Madoka", put up to two cards from the top of your deck underneath that character as a marker, and all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
--I'll do it over.
--As many times as it takes, I'll keep going back.

name: Homura "Fights On"
text:
【CONT】 Memory If a card named "Ultimate Madoka" is in your memory, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
flavor: Your complaining isn't going to help. --Come on, let's go.

name: Madoka Kaname
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】［(1)] This card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: If any rule or law stands in the way of that, I will destroy it, I will rewrite it.
copyright: Illust: Naoto Nakamura  Finishing: Shaft  Background: Studio Tulip

name: Homura Akemi
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is four or less, this card gets +500 power, and "【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.
flavor: If reasoning with a fool won't work, I will turn to more drastic measures.
copyright: Illust: Naoto Nakamura  Finishing: Shaft  Background: Studio Tulip

name: Transfer Student, Homura
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: M-m-my name is Homura Akemi. P-p-pleased to meet you.

name: Homura, Girl Who Embraces the Bond
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Madoka's Swaying Feelings" ［(1)］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Madoka's Swaying Feelings" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: You're blaming yourself too much for this, Madoka Kaname.

name: Homura Cares for Madoka
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Madoka" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: I will finish every last witch myself.

name: Madoka: "In order to protect everyone"
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose another of your 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: But the more witches we slay, the more people we can save. So it's worth the effort, right?

name: Nurse's Aide, Madoka
text: 【AUTO】［(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Girl from the Dream" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: Homura: "Miss Madoka Kaname. You are the Nurse's Aide for this class, are you not?"

name: Hitomi Shizuki
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, all of your other characters get +1 level until end of turn.
flavor: Like Madoka's mom, if only I could make up my mind to reject a boy so easily……

name: Dark-haired Girl, Homura
flavor: My name is Homura Akemi. Pleased to meet you.

name: Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Madoka
text:
【AUTO】【CLOCK】 Shift, Level 1 (At the beginning of your main phase, you may choose a green card in your hand and this card in your clock, and exchange them.)
【ACT】 Brainstorm ［(1)］ Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I-I was called to him. I heard his voice inside my head.

name: Best Friends, Madoka & Homura
text: 【AUTO】［(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "My very best friend" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your 《Magic》 characters get +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Homura: "This is still the place that she once tried to protect."

name: Madoka of the Blue Skies
flavor: That is what I aspire to be some day.

name: Junko Kaname
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Madoka" in its card name get +1000 power.
flavor: A woman's appearance is the one thing she can't afford to get looked down at.

name: Homura's Lonely Battle
text:
【AUTO】［(2)］ When a card named "Time Manipulation" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets the following ability until end of turn." 【CONT】 If this card would attack, you may instead choose a character on your opponent's back stage, and have this card frontal attack with the chosen character as the defending character."
【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: Kyubey: "Because she still hasn't given up hope."

name: "Stage-constructing Witch", Walpurgisnacht
text: 【ACT】［(2)] This card gets +5000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Homura: "'Walpurgisnacht' will descend upon this city."

name: Madoka's Fluffy Skirt
flavor: I-I thought maybe I should at least start thinking about costume ideas……

name: Law of the Cycle
text: Search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: I won't let your prayers end in despair.

name: Meaningless Chain
text: Look at up to three cards from the top of your opponent's deck, choose up to one card from among them, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck. Put the rest on top of your opponent's deck in any order.
flavor: Madoka: "……so you're saying that as long as she continues to hope, she can't be saved?"

name: Madoka's Wish
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Then even I--should have no reason to despair, ever.

name: I won't rely on anyone anymore
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: My battlefield lies elsewhere.

name: Time Manipulation
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I'm not, even living in the same time as you are, Madoka.

name: My very best friend
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I remember that. And I will never forget it.

name: Don't tell anyone else in class, okay?
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Kyubey: "They're magical girls."

name: Girl from the Dream
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, put the top card of your deck into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Homura: "Madoka Kaname, Do you treasure the life you currently live?"

name: Aggressively Hostile Kyoko
text:
【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
【ACT】［【REST】 one of your 《Magic》 characters] This card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Sure, seems like an easy win to me, she won't even know what hit her.

name: Kyoko Sakura
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, you may choose a 《Magic》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】［(1) 【REST】 two of your characters］ Until end of turn, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability."【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on top of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Wouldn't that be something? It'd be like one of those stories where love and courage triumph over all.
copyright: Illust: Naoto Nakamura  Finishing: Shaft  Background: Studio Tulip

name: Kyoko Shares an Apple
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters named "Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Sayaka" get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Bond／"Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Sayaka" ［(1)］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Sayaka" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: Want one?

name: Kyoko's Multi-segment Spear
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of characters you have with "Assist".
【AUTO】［(2)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Magic》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Who the hell are you? Whose side are you on, anyway?

name: Egoist, Kyoko
text: 【AUTO】［(2)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Sayaka VS Kyoko" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to two characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: Seriously, what were you thinking killing the goose before it laid its golden eggs.

name: Howling Kyoko
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Sayaka" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: What the heck are you!? What have you done to Sayaka!?

name: Supporting Role, Kyubey
text: 【CONT】 If this card is on your center stage, your other 《Magic》 character in the middle position of the center stage gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock]".
flavor: I just don't get it. Why are humans so touchy about the placement of their souls?

name: Kyoko Confesses Her Past
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, if the number of climax in your waiting room is three or more, put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: It got to the point where our entire family didn't even have food to eat.

name: Kyoko Wishes for a Miracle
text: 【AUTO】［Put a card from your hand into your waiting room］ When a card named "It sure is lonely, being the only one left" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on the center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters on the center stage, put it into your opponent's waiting room, and at the end of turn, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Please, God…… Look at the life I've lived…… Please, let me have a happy dream, for once in my life……

name: Kyoko in the Alley
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Change ［(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Kyoko Sakura" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: We need to talk. Will you come with me?

name: Kyoko's Red Soul Gem
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: You got a problem with that?

name: Kyoko Parts at the Subway Platform
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: How long were you planning to go on being stubborn like this?

name: New Magical Girl, Kyoko
flavor: Kyubey: "I didn’t think you would come."

name: Kyoko Arrives
text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 ［Put this card from your hand into your waiting room］ （Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.）
flavor: I find the idea of handing such prime territory over to some rookie hatchling to be pretty annoying.

name: Extraterrestrial Lifeform, Kyubey
flavor: It's we who've had such a hard time understanding humans and your values system.

name: Magical Girl of Spears, Kyoko
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: Hmph! Annoying jerks sure attract annoying friends.

name: Kyoko's Resolution
text: All of your 《Magic》 characters get +1500 power until end of turn.

name: Magical Girl Appears
text: Choose up to two characters in your waiting room, return them to your hand, and choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: I'll put the new girl out of commission. Permanently.

name: Sayaka VS Kyoko
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: The way you're butting into this and acting like it's a game…… It kinda ticks me off.

name: It sure is lonely, being the only one left
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I know you don't want to be alone…… It's okay. I'll be here with you. Sayaka……

name: Rookie Magical Girl, Sayaka
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get "【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
【AUTO】 Change ［(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Sayaka's Blank Stare" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: From here on, I will keep this city safe.

name: Sayaka Miki
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Magic》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card into your memory.
flavor: I didn't wish for this power just so I could fight witches, I wanted the strength to protect those I love.
copyright: Illust: Naoto Nakamura  Finishing: Shaft  Background: Studio Tulip

name: Sayaka Fights for Others
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters named "Howling Kyoko" get +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: I don't regret making my wish for someone else's sake.

name: Sayaka Looks Up to Mami
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a 《Magic》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to is its original place.)
flavor: Sayaka: "Maaan, you are so cool, Mami!"

name: Sayaka's Healing Prayers
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top card of your deck into your clock, and 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Kyubey: "It's because she made her contract wishing for someone to be healed."

name: Sayaka's Blank Stare
text:
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】［(1) Put this card into your waiting room］ When a card named "I was stupid, so stupid" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named ""Mermaid Witch"" or "Sayaka Getting Hurt in the Fight" in your waiting room, put it on the stage position that this card was on, draw a card, and that character gets +1500 power until end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Stay out of my way……

name: Classmate, Sayaka
text: 【CONT】 If this card is on your center stage, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
flavor: Your mom is just too cool, Madoka.

name: Sayaka Finds Her Wish
text: 【AUTO】［(1) Put this card into your waiting room］ When a card named "Miracles and magic are real" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named "Sayaka's Blank Stare" in your hand, put it on the stage position that this card was on, and choose a level 0 or lower character with "Kamijo" in its card name in your waiting room, and put that character on any position of your stage.
flavor: After all, I found something I truly wished for.

name: Ally of Justice, Sayaka
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: From here on, I - Magical Girl Sayaka -, will keep Mitakihara City super-duper safe and sound!

name: "Mermaid Witch"
text: 【AUTO】［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do not, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Madoka: "Please, Sayaka, go back to your old self! Go back to the Sayaka I used to know!"

name: Sayaka's Confrontation
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Kyoko Wishes for a Miracle" ［(1)］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Kyoko Wishes for a Miracle" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: What about the people it'll attack……? Are you just going to sit back and let them get killed!?

name: Kyosuke Kamijo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Sayaka: "If you make a wish, does it have to be for yourself?"

name: Childhood Friend of Kamijo, Sayaka
flavor: - whew.

name: Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Sayaka
flavor: ……picking up where you left off yesterday?

name: Magical Girl of Swords, Sayaka
text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] （Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.）

name: Sayaka Getting Hurt in the Fight
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top card of your deck into your clock, and 【REST】 this card.
【ACT】［【REST】 one of your 《Magic》 characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: If I just detach myself…… I really don’t feel any pain……

name: Incubator
text: Choose one of your 【STAND】 《Magic》 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, draw up to two cards, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: I have countless spares, of course, but making me use them up for no reason like this is a waste

name: Sayaka's Wish
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your characters with "Sayaka" in its card name, and put it into your waiting room. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your hand, and put this card into your memory.
flavor: There's no way I'll ever regret it.

name: I was stupid, so stupid
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: My heart became filled with resentment and hatred, so much so that I even hurt my dearest friend……

name: Miracles and magic are real
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: This is the end for you---!

name: Battle with Walpurgisnacht, Homura
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, choose a card from among them, and put it on top of your deck. Put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: This time, I'll put an end to you.

name: Common Wishes, Sayaka & Kyoko
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Magic》 characters.

name: A Lonely Fight, Homura
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
【AUTO】【CLOCK】 Shift, Level 0 (At the beginning of your main phase, you may choose a green card in your hand and this card in your clock, and exchange them.)
flavor: I can do it on my own.

name: Smiling Sayaka
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this unit get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of characters you have with "Assist".
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: After all, I did pretty well for my first time out, didn't I?

name: Ordinary Girl, Madoka
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: I wish I could get a love letter from someone too.

name: Fighting Against Fate, Homura
text: 【ACT】[1] This card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: That is the inescapable fate of all who become magical girls.

name: Fighting Against Fate, Sayaka
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, choose one of your 《Magic》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'm going to be a different kind of magical girl from all of you. That's what I've decided.

name: Fighting Against Fate, Mami
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: You were just having a bad dream, that's all.

name: Fighting Against Fate, Kyoko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: If there weren't, were you just going to leave her like that?

name: Swimsuit Mami
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, all of your characters get +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: This isn't a magic show, you know.

name: Dark-haired Girl, Homura
flavor: My name is Homura Akemi. Pleased to meet you.

name: Nurse's Aide, Madoka
text: 【AUTO】[(1)] When this character attacks, if a card named "The Girl from the Dream" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: Homura "You are the Nurse's Aide for this class, are you not?"

name: Madoka of the Blue Skies
flavor: That is the ideal image of what I one day wanted to become.

name: Madoka Kaname
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】[(1)] This card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: That's why, I'm really glad in the end that I chose to become a magical girl.

name: Homura Akemi
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is four or less, this card gets +500 power, and gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.
flavor: SECRET

flavor: I won't let your prayers end in despair.

name: I won't rely on anyone anymore!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I won't rely on anyone anymore! I don't need anyone to understand me, either!

name: The Girl from the Dream
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, put the top card of your deck into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor:
Madoka "Um… Miss Akemi?"
Homura "You can call me Homura."

text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.
