text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Key》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: New Life! Chitoge
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if a card named "But It's All About You" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Oh, right…...
I'm in love with someone now.

name: Great Style! Chitoge
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you use 【ACT】, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.

name: But It's All About You
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
What…... kind of relationship
do I want with him, exactly…… ｛詰めてください、キャラクターの顔を隠すのが避けるように｝

name: Neighbor, Haru
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Sweets》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Huh……?

name: New Life! Haru
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Someday My Prince Will……" is in your climax area, until the end of your opponent's next turn, your opponent cannot play event cards from hand.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Someday My Prince Will……" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, until end of turn, this card gets +3000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a card in your clock, and return it to your hand. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your clock."
flavor:
I'm somehow getting the feeling that
I'm about to embark on a splendid romance……!

name: Tsugumyaa
text:
【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your 《Weapon》 or 《Heiress》 characters] This card gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Then should I assume my human form?

name: Swimsuit Haru
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Sweets》 character, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Paula, you can't swim?

name: Pajama Party, Haru
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room. If the number of 《Sweets》 characters among those cards is one or more, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn. If the number of 《Sweets》 characters among those cards is two or more, put up to one card from the top of your clock into your waiting room. If the number of 《Sweets》 characters among those cards is three or more, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's clock."
flavor: …… Did you see?

name: New Life! Seishiro
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose a green card in your clock, and return it to your hand. Choose a card in your hand, and put it into your clock.
flavor:
……If you ever get stuck again,
I might be inclined to help you out…….

name: Haru's Friend, Fuu
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Sweets》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 Bond/"New Life! Haru" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "New Life! Haru" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: ……What? A prince……?

name: Clue, Haru
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Sweets》 characters get +500 power.
【CONT】 Memory This card gets the following ability for each card named "Promised Pendant" in your opponent's memory. "【CONT】 All of your other 《Sweets》 characters get +500 power."
flavor: My prince……!

name: Paula McCoy
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, search your deck for up to one 《Weapon》 or 《Heiress》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
……Don't give me that "chan" treatment, it's creepy.
I'm here because the Black
Tiger summoned me.

name: From Here On, Seishiro
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Weapon》 or 《Heiress》 character, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: ……Or do you have a problem?

name: Haru Onodera
text:
【AUTO】 When another of your 《Sweets》 characters attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a card from the top of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: You are an upperclassman, aren't you…...?

name: Beehive's “White Fang” Paula
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Weapon》 or 《Heiress》 characters.
flavor:
Or have you fallen
in love with someone? ｛１行に詰めてください｝

name: Someday My Prince Will……
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor:
You know…… I think he looks like
the guy from this morning…… But…... No way, right?

name: Magical Police Marika
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Police》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: Magical Police Marika, is here☆

name: Marika's Dress Look
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Raku(楽)" in its card name, this card gets +3000 power.
flavor: The operation was a resounding success.

name: New Life! Marika
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [(1)] Until end of turn, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the top of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Good morning to you~~!!

name: Draw of the Shop, Haru
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, search your deck for up to one 《Sweets》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: You know, I really love their daifuku, too……!

name: Freshman, Haru
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Sweets》 character.
flavor:
As of today, I'm a first-year
student in high school……! ｛詰めてください｝

name: Magical Patissiere, Kosaki
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When a card named "Contract Concluded☆" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named "Pajama Party, Kosaki" in your hand, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Yes, I understand! Rurin!

name: Pajama Party, Kosaki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Contract Concluded☆" is in your climax area, and all of your characters are 《Sweets》, search your deck for up to one 《Sweets》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck, and this card gets +2500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, if this card is in your center stage, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +4000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
…… But…… it's a slightly
special kind of obligatory.

name: Sisters Taking a Bath, Kosaki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in the original order.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Draw of the Shop, Haru" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Draw of the Shop, Haru" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor:
Well…… I'm not sure
that I can explain what it is……

name: Rurin
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1 level and +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Oh☆ My hand somehow slipped～☆

name: Fuu's Prank, Haru
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card.
flavor: I will never let・you…… get your hands on my sis?｛＿でわありません-です。｝

name: Sisters Taking a Bath, Haru
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have another character with "Kosaki(小咲)" in its card name, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
{小と咲の間のスペースを消してください}
flavor:
I don't get it. What makes
you think he's a good person?

name: 1/10000 Miracle, Kosaki
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is not a 《Sweets》 character, put it into your clock. (If it is, return the revealed card to its original place.)
flavor: Huh!? Delicious!

name: New Life! Kosaki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets -1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor:
But I'm so glad that we all
got to be in the same class.

name: Head Tilt Haru
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if all of your characters are 《Sweets》, and the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: New Life! Ruri
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is six or more, this card gets +1500 power. ｛詰めてください｝
flavor:
The day they announced what class we'd be in,
this one was so happy she was in tears.

name: Contract Concluded☆
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: ……Is that really a magical girl's job……?

name: Scouting for a Magical Girl, Magical Patissiere, Kosaki
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor: What? You mean there are other magical girls besides me!?

name: Good Luck Charm, Nadeko Sengoku
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of 《Strange》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card's level 2 or higher battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Strange》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: I think Lala and the others are up to something.

name: Master-servant Relationship, Shinobu Oshino
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is six or higher, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by a "Change" effect, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: My master hasn't lost to you yet.

name: The Way Back, Shinobu Oshino
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other 《Strange》 characters get +1 level and +500 power.
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is five or higher, this card gets "【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card with "Experience" get +1000 power."
flavor: But perhaps we are not, my master――

name: Blessing of the Moon, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is two or higher, this card gets +500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power."
flavor:
I like the "tsuki," from "moon," part.
The sun is my enemy―― but the moon has been quite good to me.

name: Words of "Courage", Mayoi Hachikuji
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is not a 《Strange》 character, put it into your clock. (If it is, the revealed card is returned to its original place)
flavor: So cool! So cool, I'm tempted to have the courage to show you my panties as you wish!

name: Serious Mode, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Encounter in the Ruins" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, until end of turn, this card gets +6000 power and your opponent cannot use "【AUTO】 Encore". （Your opponent cannot use the "【AUTO】 Encore ［(3)］" rule either.)
flavor:
We can fight there to our hearts content.
I'll show you the difference that years of experience make.

name: Sake of Cooperation, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other characters you have is one or less, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor:
Oh, no... Oh, no, what cruel fate forces me
to obey the orders of a lesser being like this human.

name: Primp and Proper, Nadeko Sengoku
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Strange》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When a card named "Welcome" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2500 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I-I definitely didn't work up the courage to change my hairstyle because you were coming over to my house for the first time.

name: Vampire's Dignity, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I will not allow any more of this.

name: Resident of the Shadows, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【AUTO】 Change [(2) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your encore step, if this card is 【REST】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Master-servant Relationship, Shinobu Oshino" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.
flavor: See you soon, then, bye.

name: Flower Garden Shinobu Oshino
text: 【AUTO】 If the number of 《Blood》 characters you have is one or less, this card cannot be played from your hand.
flavor: Wah-!

name: Sudden Attack, Koyomi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Flower Garden Shinobu Oshino" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Flower Garden Shinobu Oshino" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: Ooh――

name: Shinobu Oshino in the Shadows
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: Very true――

name: First Visitor, Nadeko Sengoku
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Eh!?
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Megami Magazine 2012 February issue

name: Shinobu Oshino in a Good Mood
flavor: I suppose I could tell you about the posed look one.

name: Blond with Gold Eyes, Shinobu Oshino
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

name: Being Bashful, Mayoi Hachikuji
flavor: I was bashful!

name: Ritual One Level Higher
text: Search your deck for up to two 《Strange》 characters, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: That isn't enough, I request a ritual one level higher.

name: Encounter in the Ruins
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: You're a minor Far Eastern monster, lacking even extant texts about her. I'll see to it that you can't ever have a posed look again.

name: Welcome
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Come in, Big Brother Koyomi.

name: “Fire Sisters” Karen Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one character with "Experience", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Oh, it's you, Big Brother. I thought it was an enemy.

name: As Lovers, Hitagi Senjyogahara
text: 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "Sandy Beach for Two" is in your climax area, choose up to one of your other characters, 【REST】 it, move it to an open position of your back stage, and this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Combat Role, Karen Araragi
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Animedia 2012 June issue

name: Benefactor's Advice, Tsubasa Hanekawa
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Girl Who Knows Anything" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Strange》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
The real problem in a fight comes after you've made up.
――Keep that in mind.

name: Girl Who Was Given a Bee, Karen Araragi
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is three or higher, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card attacks, if a card named "KAREN Bee" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your characters get +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: We're not playing at anything. We ARE heroes of justice, Big Brother.

name: Someone to Protect, Hitagi Senjyogahara
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is five or higher, this card gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn."
【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
flavor:
If you want to get past me, you'll have to defeat me――
Can you do that?

name: “Wreathe-fire Bee” Karen Araragi
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your other characters and this card, exchange them as 【STAND】, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're my pride.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Animedia 2012 January issue

name: Bigger of the Sisters, Karen Araragi
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, all of your other characters with "Tsukihi(月火)" in its card name get +500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Immortal Strange, Tsukihi Araragi" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Immortal Strange, Tsukihi Araragi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: So get back to your room and study.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2012 May issue

name: “Fake” Deishu Kaiki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, you cannot play event cards and "Backup"from your hand."
flavor: Come to think of it, I didn't actually apologize.

name: Sharp Intuition, Hitagi Senjyogahara
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is two or higher, this card gets +1000.
【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] Choose one of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."
flavor: Or maybe it's five? The number of girls you've played with today.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2012 February issue

name: Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Teeth Brushing Time" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Light-hearted, Karen Araragi
flavor: It's a lot lighter-

name: Playing With Cards, Suruga Kanbaru
text: 【CONT】 During this card's battle, all players cannot play "Backup"from hand.
flavor: Boo……

name: A Morning Sight, Karen Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 Change [(2) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your encore step, if this card is 【REST】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Wreathe-fire Bee” Karen Araragi" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.
flavor: Brother! Hey, it's morning!
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2011 December issue

name: Tutor, Tsubasa Hanekawa
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: Get this solved tonight. You have to start studying again tomorrow――

name: Pride of an Elder Brother, Koyomi Araragi
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Karen(火憐)" or "Tsukihi(月火)" in its card name get +500 power.
flavor: That way of thinking is dangerous. It's about as far from justice as you can get.

name: Celebrity of Tsuganoki 2nd Middle School, Karen Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
……sometimes, Big Brother, you're hotter than fire.
I'm in love.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2012 January issue

name: “What is Justice” Karen Araragi
flavor: And the good guys always win, so you can't lose――

name: Family Bond, Karen Araragi
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor:
I could. With a smile on my face.
She's my little sister――Of course I could.

name: Innocence, Suruga Kanbaru
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 one of your characters] Choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Now I have no choice but to prove my innocence――!

name: Mischievous Nature, Tsubasa Hanekawa
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: So I just made a small request. "If you won't be a good girl, I'll ask Araragi to be my boyfriend."

name: Teeth Brushing Time
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Big Brother……

name: Sandy Beach for Two
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.

name: Girl Who Knows Anything
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Yeah, it's fine. I was just doing some afternoon studying.

name: KAREN Bee
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: B-Big Brother.

name: Cuckoo Girl, Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if you have a card named "Platinum Mad" in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to two 《Japanese Clothes》 characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: We're not heroes of justice, we're justice itself, Big Brother.

name: Immortal Strange, Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: See you.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2012 May issue

name: Farewell to the Past, Hitagi Senjyogahara
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, perform the following action. "Choose a 《Strange》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room."
flavor: Be gentle to me tonight.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Animedia 2012 February issue

name: “Phoenix” Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your draw phase, deal one damage to yourself. (This damage may be canceled)
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Animedia 2012 June issue

name: Sense of Liberation, Suruga Kanbaru
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is two or higher, this card gets +1000.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 one of your other 【STAND】 《Strange》 characters] When a card named "Handling Memories" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: No matter how liberated I feel when naked, I only go outside naked occasionally――

name: Celebrity of Tsuganoki 2nd Middle School, Tsukihi Araragi
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Do you have any regrets, Big Brother?
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2012 January issue

name: Usual Parting, Mayoi Hachikuji
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your clock] When this card attacks, if a card named "I flubbed it!" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal five damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: Yeah, let's meet again.

name: Promise Exchange, Mayoi Hachikuji
text: 【AUTO】 Experience When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the total level of the cards in your level is four or higher, choose a 《Strange》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: If I'm ever in really bad trouble again, would you help me?

name: Accelerator, Suruga Kanbaru
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: Suruga Kanbaru. Primary weapon, accelerator.

name: Matters of Younger Sisters, Koyomi Araragi
text:
【AUTO】 Bond/"Girl Who Was Given a Bee, Karen Araragi" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Girl Who Was Given a Bee, Karen Araragi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
【AUTO】 Bond/"“Fire Sisters” Tsukihi Araragi" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Fire Sisters” Tsukihi Araragi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor:
……she got what was coming to her.
It's her fault for getting involved with someone like you.

name: “Fire Sisters” Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the number of your other 《Japanese Clothes》 characters is two or more, and this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character in battle.
flavor: Don't just grow up and leave us behind.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: aoharu

name: Advisor Role, Tsukihi Araragi
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +3000 power.
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: Don't bother coming home. There's no home for you!

name: Passionate Personality, Tsukihi Araragi
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is 5 or higher, this card gets the following ability."【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card’s battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.".
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named “TSUKIHI Phoenix” is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a level 2 or lower character in your opponent’s center stage and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: Big Brother, how long will you be taking that bath?

name: Loves Kimono, Tsukihi Araragi
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You know how I always say I'm "platinum" mad? It was originally "pretty" mad, so it doesn't mean that I'm so mad, the word "platinum" comes to mind.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Megami Magazine 2012 February issue

name: Smaller of the Sisters, Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: Mm?

name: Tea Ceremony Club, Tsukihi Araragi
flavor: Big Brother. Heading out again?

name: A Morning Sight, Tsukihi Araragi
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose one of your red characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: You really need to get up now!
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Newtype 2011 December issue

name: Unexpected Words, Hitagi Senjyogahara
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Koyomi(暦)" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: ……Oh, no. That's really cool.
copyright: © NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Lis Ani vol.08

name: Secret Conversation, Mayoi Hachikuji
flavor: Really, it's nothing but a secret!

name: “Pervert” Suruga Kanbaru
flavor: Huh.

name: Usual Occurrence
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your 《Japanese Clothes》 or 《Sports》 characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: No!

name: TSUKIHI Phoenix
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: "Any wound heals instantly, any illness vanishes immediately, it lives out its lifespan. And then it dies―― and is reborn."

name: I flubbed it!
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I bit you!

name: Handling Memories
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: My memories are always in my heart.

name: Platinum Mad
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Don't get cocky, just because you have some muscle now!

name: Koyomi Araragi Heading for Battle
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Family Matters" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, until end of turn, this card gets +3500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the top of your opponent's deck."
flavor: Hah… hah…

name: Hairband, Nadeko Sengoku
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
flavor: The word of Life is law.

name: Sisters' Helper, Tsubasa Hanekawa
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Strange》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: That's true.

name: Shikigami, Yotsugi Ononoki
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
Devilish big brother. You seem to have a knack for finding yourself
in the company of immortal apparitions.

name: Unlimited Rulebook, Yotsugi Ononoki
flavor: "Unlimited Rulebook."――I said, with a posed look.

name: Way Back, Tsubasa Hanekawa
flavor:
You haven't been slacking at all.
I know that very well.

name: Playing Together, Nadeko Sengoku
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Then let's play the Game of Life, Big Brother Koyomi.

name: Onmyoji, Yozuru Kagenui
text: 【ACT】 [(2)] This card gets +2500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Even if you don't allow us, what can you do to stop us?

name: Loser's Bravado
text: Look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to two cards from among them, and put them into your hand. Put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Strange》 characters you have.
flavor: I was about to make my big comeback. Don't worry about me when you don't have to, Big Sister――

name: Family Matters
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: They aren't "other people". They are my family.

name: Vanpire's Bond, Shinobu Oshino
flavor:
I've told you a bunch of times that the bonds of a vampire are
bonds of the soul, right?

name: Heroes of Justice Game, Karen Araragi & Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【AUTO】 If the number of 《Sports》 or 《Japanese Clothes》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: "My prides. My little sisters I'm so proud of. Fakes, but because of that, closer than anything to the real thing. The Fire Sisters rushed out of the house to do battle like a lit firecracker."

name: “Hero of Justice” Karen Araragi
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: "The older of my sisters, Karen Araragi. A third-year in middle school, had a birthday at the end of June, turning fifteen――"

name: “Hero of Justice” Tsukihi Araragi
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)
flavor: "And the younger of my sisters, Tsukihi Araragi. A second-year in middle school, her birthday falls in early April, which makes her fourteen now――"

text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, 【REST】 all of your other 【STAND】 characters.
copyright: (C) NISIOISIN/KODANSHA, ANIPLEX, SHAFT　First Appearance: Otona Anime vol.23

flavor: Karen: "Seems I'll have a heroic tale to tell tonight."

text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

……sometimes, Big Brother, you're hotter than fire.
I'm in love.

text:

(Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Twenty-four... Was my age, until this spring.
copyright: ©Aka Akasaka x Mengo Yokoyari/Shueisha, "OSHI NO KO" Partners

name: Road to JIF, MEMcho
text:
【CONT】 You may choose 1 "First Stage" in your waiting room by the [CHOICE] effect.
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other 《Show Business》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When a climax with [CHOICE] in its trigger icon is placed on your climax area, all of your characters get +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Yeah, the producer I worked with on Love Now has a connection. If we're interested, he says he can squeeze us into the lineup.

text:

name: Ecstatic Respect and Affection, Albedo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into his or her waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Overlord, Ainz" [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is played and placed on the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Overlord, Ainz" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: And when all of the others had left us behind. He mercifully stayed with us.

name: Absolute Loyalty, Demiurge
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room."
flavor: Everyone in this world will know of your greatness, and fear your undying wrath.

name: Elder Sister of the Battle Maids, Yuri
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +4500 power and the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, all players cannot play "Backup" from hand."
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's memory.
flavor: I agree with Albedo on this, Sir.

name: Assault Maid, CZ2128・Δ
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power and 《Sticker》 until end of turn.
flavor: I’ll cover you.

name: Command Mantra, Demiurge
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "As a Warrior, Cocytus" get +1500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 Bond/"As a Warrior, Cocytus" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "As a Warrior, Cocytus" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Do try to enjoy your last few hours, okay?

name: Sadist with a Smile, Lupusregina
text: 【AUTO】 When your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I actually get along pretty well with them, too.

name: Financial Management, Ainz
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is cost 0 or lower, this card cannot become 【REVERSE】.
【AUTO】 When your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Dammit all. Why is there never enough money?

name: Oval Battle Maid, Narberal
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's memory.
flavor: I don’t know, she’s a rodent. Why would I care what other rodents call her?

name: As a Warrior, Cocytus
flavor: Demiurge: "We could have sent in minions in case this is a trap. If all the Guardians fought together, there isn’t a force that could overtake us."

name: Freezing Spell
text: 【COUNTER】 Brainstorm Flip over the top 2 cards of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. If there is a climax revealed among those cards, choose 1 of your opponent's characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot deal damage to a player."

name: Benevolent Pure White Demon
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: My lord. We, the Guardians. pledge our fidelity.

name: A Woman's Nature
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Floor Guardian Twins
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Mare: "I apologize for making you wait, Lord Momonga."

name: Crimson Red Battle Maiden, Shalltear
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Aah… My Lord…!!

name: Infinite Loyalty, Albedo
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
flavor: Lord Ainz…

name: Overlord, Ainz
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Return this card to your hand] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "〈Grasp Heart〉" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put that character on the top of your opponent's deck, choose 1 "Death Knight" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Well, I’m here now. You’ll help me test my power whether you want to or not.

name: Strongest Magic Caster, Ainz
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Shooting Star" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "〈Fallen Down〉" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: The Goal of All Life is Death!

name: Defender of the Throne, Albedo
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Is everything all right?

name: Cute Blunder, Albedo
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Overlord, Ainz" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Overlord, Ainz" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your "Overlord, Ainz", and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Ah!!

name: Ability of a Floor Guardian, Shalltear
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Ability of a Floor Guardian, Shalltear", put it on any position of your stage, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if "Pipette Lance" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets the following ability. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is not canceled, choose up to 3 cards in your clock, and put them into your waiting room."
flavor: I love watching you try to play tough. It is absolutely adorable.

name: 8th Floor Guardian, Victim
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I will take my leave and return to my duties in the Great Tomb.

name: Vampire Bride
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 of your 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Shalltear: "Our unfortunate prey finally took a bite of the bait?"

name: Reason for the Handicap, Ainz
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I guess there’s no point hiding it.

name: A Woman's Battle, Shalltear
text: 【CONT】 If your opponent's stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: The supreme beings made me what I am.

name: True Vampire Ancestor, Shalltear
text:
【AUTO】 When your other character's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, choose 1 of your 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [Put 1 "Vampire Bride" from your waiting room into your clock] This ability can be used up to 3 times per turn. Draw 1 card.
flavor: My, my. It appears I’m the first to arrive.

name: 4th Floor Guardian, Gargantua
text:
【CONT】 This card gets -2 level while on the stage.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters.

name: Leader of Pleiades, Sebas
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, at the beginning of your climax phase, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: By your command, my lord.

name: Assistant Butler, Eclair
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 card in your opponent's clock, and put it into his or her waiting room. If you do, your opponent puts the top card of your opponent's deck into his or her clock.
【AUTO】 When you refresh your deck, you may put this card into your stock.
flavor: Lord Sebas is away on business, so I must work twice as hard to make up for him.

name: Nature of a Floor Guardian, Albedo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, and that character gets +1 soul for each [SOUL] in the trigger icon of the card put into your waiting room until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When a climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: I will personally make sure these fools regret their folly.

name: True Power, Ainz
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters.
flavor: Haaa!!

name: Crazed Bloodlust, Shalltear
text: 【AUTO】 When your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Maaaaaain dissssssh!

name: Resurrection Ritual, Ainz
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Shalltear's Resurrection" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may choose 1 of your other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, and 【STAND】 it.
flavor: I’m sorry, Shalltear. This was all because of my mistake.

name: Diversionary Tactics, Sebas
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I’d like to see the spell and cantrips list, if you please.

name: Shooting Star
text:
Choose 1 of the following effects and perform it.
"Deal 2 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
"Choose up to 2 cards in your clock, and put them into your waiting room. Put this card into your memory."
"Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +8000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn."
flavor: Shooting Star! Now, ring. I command you!

name: 〈Fallen Down〉
text:
If you have a card in your memory, you cannot play this card from your hand. Put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 Memory At the beginning of your draw phase, if this card is in your memory, put the top card of your deck face down into your memory. If you have 4 or more face down cards in your memory, put all cards from your memory into your waiting room. If you put 5 or more cards into your waiting room, deal 2 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Here I come, Shalltear!

name: 〈Grasp Heart〉
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Shalltear's Resurrection
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the climax area from your hand, perform [STANDBY] .
flavor: Ainz: "All that’s left is to begin Shalltear’s resurrection."

name: Pipette Lance
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Ainz: "Gaah!!"

name: "Blue Rose" Evileye
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "5th Tier Magic Caster" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, choose 1 of the following effects and perform it. "If you have another blue or 《Raven Black》 character, choose up to 3 cards in your opponent's waiting room, return them to your opponent's deck, and your opponent shuffles his or her deck." "Choose 2 cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room. If you put 2 cards into your waiting room, deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax in your opponent's waiting room." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: This one is stronger than you two. That said. I’m stronger than her.

name: The Golden Princess, Renner
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to 1 blue or 《Raven Black》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Let’s see. Which face am I supposed to wear, again?

name: A Maiden's Heart, Evileye
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your blue or 《Raven Black》 characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event, or a blue or 《Raven Black》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Not at all. That’s just the kind of man he is.

name: White-Scaled Beauty, Crusch
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During your turn, when you play an event, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your opponent's 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: Zaryusu: "I refuse to let the female I love die like that."

name: "Blue Rose" Lakyus
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other blue or 《Raven Black》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 blue or 《Raven Black》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Always happy to have you along.

name: Honorable Warrior, Cocytus
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 4 or higher, this card gets +1000 power for each of your opponent's characters at 【REST】.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Subhuman Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "Ruler of the Frozen Lake" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 5 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Normally, I would face you with a weapon in each hand…

name: A New Legend, Momon
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] During your turn, when this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters. That character does not 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 1 of your 【STAND】 characters] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, at the end of this card's attack, you may pay the cost. If you do, put 3 cards from the bottom of your opponent's deck into his or her waiting room. If there are no climax among those cards, 【STAND】 this card.
flavor: Pathetic.

name: Battle to Protect a Kingdom, Momon
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's trigger check reveals a card with [SOUL] in its trigger icon, if "Raven Black Hero" is in your climax area, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 blue or 《Raven Black》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Frost Pain Modified!

name: Grotesque Hydra, Rororo
text:
【CONT】 If you have 5 or more cards in your hand, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Strongest Lizardman Warrior, Zaryusu" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Iguva: "Insufferable brute!"

name: Strongest Lizardman Warrior, Zaryusu
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 2 or higher, this card gets +500 power for each of your opponent's characters at 【REST】.
【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Frost Pain" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Bad move. Now there’s no way I’ll lose.

name: Invisibility Magic, Evileye
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your blue or 《Raven Black》 characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck."
flavor: I've returned.

name: Kingdom's Head Warrior, Gazef
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other blue or 《Raven Black》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Run ‘em through!

name: "Blue Rose" Tina
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 during battle, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: What now, evil boss?

name: Extreme Love, Renner
text: 【CONT】 All of your other "Struggles of the Untalented, Climb" get +1500 power and the following 3 abilities. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects or become 【REVERSE】 by your opponent's 【AUTO】 effects." "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play event or "Backup" from their hand." "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's memory."
flavor: Renner: I’ll kill her. Just like the rest.

name: "Blue Rose" Tia
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 ""Blue Rose" Tia", put it on any position of your stage, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card at the bottom of your deck.
flavor: It devours the vocal chords of its human victims and perfectly imitates their voice.

name: "Green Claw" Cheftian Shasuryu
text: 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you play an event, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."
flavor: That’s a damn shame, isn’t it?

name: Struggles of the Untalented, Climb
flavor: Gazef: "But while he’s limited by his ability, he’s not limited by experience."

name: Brain
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is a higher level than this card, this card cannot frontal attack.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may declare the name of this card.
flavor: My name is Brain Unglaus.

name: "Blue Rose" Gagaran
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of blue or 《Raven Black》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor: This is bad. I don’t think we have the slightest chance of winning.

name: Berserker with a Giant Fist, Zenberu
text: 【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 3 or higher, this card gets +1000 power for each of your opponent's characters at 【REST】.
flavor: Martial Art. Iron Natural Weapon.

name: Frost Pain
text: Choose 1 of your opponent's level 1 or lower characters. That character does not 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase. Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return the revealed card to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: You’re finished!

name: Adamantite-Class Adventurer
text: 【COUNTER】 If you have 4 or more blue or 《Raven Black》 characters, choose 1 《Blue Rose》 character in your clock, and return it to your hand. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: Do you actually believe he’s the same level as the strongest adventurers in the world?

name: 5th Tier Magic Caster
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Introductions? How courteous of you.

name: Raven Black Hero
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Ruler of the Frozen Lake
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Nazarick's Loyal Retainer, Demiurge
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: I can only repay you, by humbly offering an even deeper devotion to your will.

name: Unique Speech Mannerisms, Shalltear
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2500 power and +1 soul until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: You know what, I am not even mad about it. Not one little bit!

name: To the Most Beloved One, Albedo
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Welcome home, Lord Ainz.

name: Supreme in a Weapons Battle, Cocytus
text: 【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
flavor: I admit they were weak. But I also cannot deny they possessed the brilliance of true warriors.

name: Bashful Effeminate Boy, Mare
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into his or her waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Grotesque Race》 or 《Nazarick》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Your ring. Thanks again.

My name is Shalltear Bloodfallen.
I hope you will entertain me well before you perish.
