name: Shinjiro Aragaki: Hierophant Arcana
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: ...Never woulda guessed I'd wind up here again.

name: Akihiko & Polydeuces: Reload
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 climax from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. If you put 1 card into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Do it, Polydeuces!

name: Koromaru: Member #8
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters among those cards ×1000.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Awooo!

name: Koromaru: S.E.E.S.
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: Arf! Arf!

name: Ken Amada: Member #9
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it into their waiting room.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: I'll be a better fighter with this!

name: Junpei Iori: Member #5
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "THAT'S THE GAME!" is in your climax area, and you have 2 or more other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to 1 level X or lower 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. If X is 2 or higher, this card gets +1 soul until end of turn. X is equal to the total level of the cards put into your waiting room by this effect. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Damn, I'm gettin' jacked!

name: Koromaru & Cerberus: Reload
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Awooo!

name: Shinjiro Aragaki: Member #2
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot move to another position of the stage."
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character into your opponent's memory.
flavor: Huh. This might actually be useful.

name: Jin: Strega
text:
【AUTO】 When your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: You guys don't have the slightest clue what'll happen if the Dark Hour disappears... do you?

name: Shinjiro & Castor: Reload
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's memory."
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your memory] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Come on out, Castor!

name: Akihiko Sanada: Member #1
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +10000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card's level 2 or higher battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: Looks like I'm getting even stronger!

name: Junpei Iori: Magician Arcana
text:
【CONT】 Memory If "Chidori: Strega" is in your memory, this card gets +4500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor: A hero's got to have a sword, yeah? Check out these mad skills!

name: Koromaru: Strength Arcana
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When your opponent uses "Brainstorm", if a climax is put into the waiting room by that effect, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Woof, woof!

name: Akihiko Sanada: S.E.E.S.
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put up to 1 card from the top of your clock into your waiting room. If you have 4 or more other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, you may put that card into your stock instead of into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "ON TO THE NEXT BOUT." is in your climax area, and all of your characters are 《Reload》, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 3 damage to your opponent. Put all level 1 or higher cards revealed by this damage into your opponent's clock in the revealed order, even if this damage is canceled. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: I think we're about ready.

name: Takaya: Strega
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(3) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 2 damage to your opponent, choose up to 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of their deck. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: We are known to some as Strega.

name: Junpei & Hermes: Reload
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Go for it, Hermes!

name: THAT'S THE GAME!
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [ICON:COMEBACK] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Did ya see that!?

name: ON TO THE NEXT BOUT.
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [ICON:COMEBACK] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: This is over!

name: Yukari Takeba: S.E.E.S.
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, and you have 4 or more 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, at the beginning of your climax phase, draw up to 2 cards, choose 2 cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room.
flavor: I'm glad to hear you're on board.

name: Mitsuru & Penthesilea: Reload
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's back stage with level higher than your opponent's level. That character cannot 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Do it, Penthesilea!

name: Mitsuru Kirijo: Empress Arcana
text:
【AUTO】 When your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to your hand.
flavor: As expected... My abilities are much better suited for the front lines.

name: Fuuka & Lucia: Reload
text:
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Come to me, Lucia!

name: Yukari Takeba: Lovers Arcana
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: The Dark Hour is just full of unsolved mysteries, isn't it...?

name: Fuuka Yamagishi: Priestess Arcana
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, all of your characters get the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card's trigger check reveals a climax, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
flavor: I have to get stronger, too... I have to be a better support for the team!

name: Mitsuru Kirijo: Member #0
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "KNEEL BEFORE ME." is in your climax area, and you have another 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Good, this'll make me more effective in battle.

name: Fuuka Yamagishi: Member #6
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I've gained a new power!

name: Mitsuru Kirijo: S.E.E.S.
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if your deck has 6 or less cards, you may return all cards from your waiting room to your deck. If you do, shuffle your deck.
flavor: What he's trying to say is, we want you to join us.

name: Fuuka Yamagishi: S.E.E.S.
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.

name: Yukari & Io: Reload
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Reload》 or 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
flavor: Time to shine, Io!

name: Yukari Takeba: Member #4
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "THERE YOU HAVE IT." is in your climax area, and all of your characters are 《Reload》, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal either 2 or 4 damage to your opponent, choose up to 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, put it on the top of their deck, and this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: I think I'm getting stronger!

name: Between Mind and Matter
text: 【COUNTER】 Your opponent may choose 1 of your characters, and return it to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: Welcome... to the Velvet Room.

name: Student of Gekkoukan High School
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and 【REST】 it.

name: KNEEL BEFORE ME.
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [GATE] ：When this card triggers, you may choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Perfect coordination.

name: THERE YOU HAVE IT.
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [GATE] ：When this card triggers, you may choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: And that's how it's done!

name: Protagonist: Memento Mori
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot be returned to hand or put into memory."
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.

name: Protagonist(P4)
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Glasses》 character and up to one character with "&" in its card name, reveal them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Izanagi!!

name: Yosuke in Yukata
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, return your opponent's battle character into your opponent's hand, your opponent chooses a card in his or her hand and puts it into your opponent's waiting room.
flavor: …We fail, huh? An epic fail…

name: Protagonist & Izanagi-no-Okami
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +X power. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the level of the character facing this card.
flavor: Izanami-no-Okami: "Impossible… Can the will of so few surpass the will of all mankind!?"
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 副島成記

name: Loves Junes! Nanako
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
flavor: Huh? We can buy one? At Junes?

name: Store Manager's Son, Yosuke
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is one or more 《Junes》 characters among those cards, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. If there are two or more 《Junes》 characters among those cards, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room. If there are three or more 《Junes》 characters among those cards, you may choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it into your opponent's stock.
flavor: Welcome, one and all! Choice salmon, 59 yen a slice, just as advertised!

name: Nanako Dojima
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Protagonist(P4)" [(1)] （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Protagonist(P4)" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: My school's on the way, so… let's go together.

name: Liquor Store's Daughter, Saki Konishi
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Junes》 characters get +1000 power.
flavor: He doesn't have too many friends, so I hope you two get along good.

name: Friendly Siblings, Protagonist & Nanako
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the level of the character facing this card.
flavor: But I'm not lonely… You're here with me.

name: Leader, Protagonist
text: 【AUTO】 [(4) Put a climax from your waiting room into your memory] This ability activates up to one time per turn. When this card attacks, if a card named "Never More" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card.
flavor: Margaret: "Get up. You are not someone allowed to fall here."

name: Signs of a Family, Dojima
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Friendly Siblings, Protagonist & Nanako" [(1)] （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Friendly Siblings, Protagonist & Nanako" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: So, I'll fill yours and Nanako's mugs anytime.

name: Declaration of Marriage, Nanako
text: 【CONT】 All of your other characters with 《Brave》 or "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name get +500 power.
flavor: When I grow up, I want to marry you, Big Bro.

name: WILD Power, Protagonist
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, choose another character, and that character gets +1 level until end of turn.
flavor: Teddie: "I'm sure together, we can do things that no one could do alone…"

name: Prince of Disappointment, Yosuke
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If you do, choose another of your characters with 《Junes》, for each 【SOUL】 trigger icon on the card put into your waiting room, that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: An eloquent heiress of the noble Junes, she's pure disappointment from the moment she opens her mouth!

name: Ryotaro Dojima
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, choose one of your characters with 《Brave》 or "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name, and that character gets +3000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: So long as you're here, you're part of the family, so make yourself at home.

name: Junes
text: Search your deck for up to one character with 《Junes》 or "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Everyday's great at your Junes♪
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 安達洋介

name: Midnight Channel
text: Choose one of your 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 characters, 【REST】 it, choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it into your opponent's stock.
flavor: I am thou…, thou art I… thou art the one… who opens the door…

name: Myriad Truths
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Dispelling Thousand Curses, an ultimate mantra to define the truth.
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: タカヤマトシアキ

name: Emerged Izanagi
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: I am thou…, thou art I… open thine eyes and call forth what is within.

name: Never More
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, put the top card of your deck into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Yosuke: "Distance doesn't matter to us! Even if we are separated, we are still friends-!"

name: "Yasogami's Steel Council President!" Labrys
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: "Don't break the rules, or you'll get chain-knuckled!"

name: Kung Fu Club, Chie
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, search your deck for up to one 《Sports》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your stock. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Y'know, for training!

name: "The Raging Bull of Destruction" Shadow Labrys
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Now, are you ready to die?

name: Show Biz People, Rise
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "King's Game" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Wait here. I'll go reserve the area upstairs for us.

name: "The Heartless Armed Angel" Aigis
text: 【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: "Her fingers are GUNS, her eyes are sights."

name: Rise & Himiko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, choose another of your characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Ch-Chie! Quick, someone heal her!

name: Fox of Tatsuhime Shrine
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is five or more, all of your other characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: *Yip!*

name: Destined Confrontation, Labrys
text: 【AUTO】 [(3) Put this card into your memory] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one card named ""The Raging Bull of Destruction" Shadow Labrys" in your hand, put it on any position of your stage, at the beginning of your next draw phase, choose a card named "Destined Confrontation, Labrys" in your memory, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor: Doing it alone… Not just you, it's the same for me…

name: Chie & Suzuka Gongen
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "God's Hand" is in your climax area, choose a card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and this card gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Don't think, feel!

name: Reliable Prince, Chie
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Yukiko & Amaterasu" [(1)] （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Yukiko & Amaterasu" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: But it was me who needed you.

name: P-1 Grand Prix Host! General Teddie
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one level 2 or higher character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards
flavor: May the manliest of all men come on down--!!

name: Chie in Yukata
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks or is frontal attacked, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, this card gets +1 level and +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Whaddya mean, "actually"!

name: Rise Kujikawa
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your level 2 or higher characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
flavor: There's extra tofu in there for everyone. A little thank-you for worrying about me.

name: Future Policewoman, Chie
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: I'll need an extra-

name: Special Friends, Chie & Yukiko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks or is frontal attacked, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a level 1 or higher character, this card gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Chie: "Yukiko-"

name: Unit #024
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: It would be wonderful if I could go with you

name: Chie Satonaka
flavor: This is it-!

name: P-1 Grand Prix Exclusive Commentator! Rise
text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your characters] This card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Are you ready for the next round!?

name: Golden Right Leg, Chie
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Chie's Pursuit" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn, and if your opponent does not have any 【STAND】 characters, choose one of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1000 power for that turn.
flavor: He just came in and then, and then… h-he fainted all of a sudden.

name: Rise's True Self
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: …I was thinking of returning to show biz next spring.

name: Sisters' Reunion, Aigis
text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room］ (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.)
flavor: Let's go back for now, Rise, Labrys. Everyone is waiting for us.

name: Rise & Kanzeon
text: 【AUTO】 When a card named "Full Analysis" is placed on your climax area, all of your characters get +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Fire is its weakness, I know you can win!

name: Chie & Tomoe
text: 【CONT】 When this card is played from your hand, you may choose one of your cards named "Chie Satonaka", and put it into your waiting room. If you do, you may play this card with 0 cost.
flavor: You're outta there!

name: King's Game
text: Choose a character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor: Times like this, adults play the King's Game. It's the law… *hic*

name: Fishing for the River Guardian
text: Put the top card of your deck into your stock. Search your stock for up to one character, reveal it to your opponent, and return it to your hand. Shuffle your stock afterwards.
flavor: >You caught the Guardian!
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 前河悠一

name: Labrys's Wrath
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: I made her a promise!

name: Arrival of Asterius
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Shadow Labrys: "Now, I can be myself!"

name: God's Hand
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Go, Suzuka Gongen!

name: Full Analysis
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: That was so cool!

name: Chie's Pursuit
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Ooh ooh! Can I have this one?

name: Active Teen Idol
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +3 soul until end of turn.
flavor: You've come so far, that makes Risette sooo happy!

name: Yukiko in Yukata
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Fan》 or 《Japanese Clothes》 characters get +1000 power.
flavor: Oh, n-not at all. You're probably just used to seeing me in one…

name: Young Okami, Yukiko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a 《Fan》 or 《Japanese Clothes》 character, deal one damage to your opponent.
flavor: Then… we'll always be together…

name: Promise with Allies, Yukiko
text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waitimg room. For each climax revealed, choose up to one character in your waiting room and return it to your hand.
flavor: Don't worry, we're behind you too.

name: "The Bloodcurdling Beefcake Emperor" Kanji Tatsumi
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When a card named "Bond with Fists" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on the center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's cost 0 or lower characters, put it into your opponent's waiting room, and this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: "Blooming roses and bulging muscles!"

name: “The Unconquerable Snow Black” Yukiko Amagi
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Fan》 or 《Japanese Clothes》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: "Please escort me to the ring, my prince!"

name: Yukiko & Konohana Sakuya
text: 【CONT】 When this card is played from your hand, you may choose one of your cards named "Yukiko Amagi", and put it into your waiting room. If you do, you may play this card with 0 cost.
flavor: "I want to run away"… "I want someone to save me"… You're right, those feelings are part of me too.

name: Yukiko's Laughing Fits
text: 【AUTO】 When your opponent's 【STAND】 character becomes 【REST】, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: I-I can't stop… laugh--

name: Brains of the Station, Adachi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: We'll hear your story down at the station… Ohh, how I've waited to use that line!

name: Totally Wrong, Miss Kanji
text: 【AUTO】 [(3)] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do so, choose one of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it into your opponent's waiting room.
flavor: She's a runaway express train who's Inaba born and bred, and can kill with both her fists and her looks!

name: Reliable Princess, Yukiko
text: 【AUTO】 Bond／"Chie & Suzuka Gongen" [(1)] （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Chie & Suzuka Gongen" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor: Y-You shouldn't believe that, okay? It's not true that I'm popular or that I've never had a boyfriend!

name: Yukiko Amagi
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When a card named "Scoring a Hot Stud" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Yukiko & Konohana Sakuya"in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Let's attack with all our strength!

name: Gas Station Attendant
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +X power. X is equal to 2000 multiplied by the level of the character facing this card.
flavor: Welcome-

name: Finish with a Single Blow, Yukiko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 cards, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: Yukiko: "Should we… taste this?"

name: Like a Game, Adachi
text: 【AUTO】 [(3)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Will of the World" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it on the top of your opponent's deck.
flavor: C'mon… All I did was put people in here. I didn't murder them.

name: "The Two-Fisted Protein Junkie" Akihiko Sanada
text: 【CONT】 The character facing this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: "The man who lusts for power returns!"

name: Inedible Curry
text: Choose one of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is lower than or equal to the level of this card, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: Curry's supposed to be like "really spicy" or "kinda mild"! This just stinks!

name: One Strike
text: Choose one of your 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 characters, 【REST】 it, and deal one damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: Rise: "Y-Yukiko!?"
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 安達洋介

name: It's my turn!
text: Choose one of your 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it. If you do, choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 characters, 【REST】 it, choose one of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it into your opponent's waiting room.
flavor: Here goes, Persona!

name: Scoring a Hot Stud
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Tonight, Princess Yukiko has a big surprise, I'm going to score myself a hot stud.

name: Will of the World
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: The world is about to change, your existence won't belong here.

name: Bond with Fists
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: If you're really me, you should already know... Fists never lie!

name: Naoto & Yamato Takeru
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Male Impersonator》 or 《Female Impersonator》 character, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Now is the time! Let's go!

name: "The 2000-IQ Killjoy Detective" Naoto Shirogane
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Male Impersonator》 or 《Female Impersonator》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's level 2 or higher battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw a card."
flavor: "The body of a child, the brain of a genius!"

name: Full Power Follow Up, Naoto
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your characters is being frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to your hand.
flavor: Try not to overdo it. There is a limit to how much I can follow up.

name: Middle of a Long Journey, Elizabeth
text: 【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is five or more, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: I now have a wish of my own…

name: Infinite Possibilities, Naoto
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Megidolaon" is in your climax area, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw a card."
flavor: This potential… was still dormant within me…

name: Paper Thin Teddie
text: 【AUTO】 [(4)] At the beginning of your opponent's encore step, if this card is on the back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your characters get the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】."
flavor: Wh-What in the world!? Nooo… My fine, silky fur… I was so proud of it! Waaaah…

name: Naoto Shirogane
text: 【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose one of your characters with 《Police》 or "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Your "game" will soon reach its end…

name: One who Wields Power, Margaret
text: 【AUTO】 [(3)] This ability activates up to one time per turn. When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, put three cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, put up to one card from the top of your clock into your waiting room. If there is an event among those cards, put all cards in your stock into your waiting room, and 【STAND】 this card.
flavor: As the one who rules over power… I will fight with the utmost deference to you.

name: Detective Prince, Naoto
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Male Impersonator》 or 《Female Impersonator》 characters get +500 power.
flavor: My name is Naoto Shirogane. I'm investigating the multiple murders that have occurred here.

name: Teddie in Yukata
text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other characters get +500 power.
flavor: A couple walking together at a festival… Unused to wearing it, the girl's yukata comes loose… Summer has begun.

name: "The Beast in Heat" Teddie
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When another of your characters is put into your waiting room from the stage, if this card is on the back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.
flavor: "The void that swallows all!"

name: "Assertion of Youth" Teddie
text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, each player returns all cards in the waiting room to his or her deck. Each player shuffles his or her deck afterwards.
flavor: The splattering fruit juice! Bursts of joy! One night of love… The bitter sweetness of those days is the essence of youth!!

name: Companion on a Journey, Margaret
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your level 2 or higher characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
flavor: Hence, Block Fro……… I didn't mispronounce it.

name: Undercover Investigation, Naoto
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power or each of your other 《Male Impersonator》 or 《Female Impersonator》 characters.
flavor: I will stop her... no matter what!

name: Teddie
text: 【CONT】 All of your other 《Glasses》 characters get +500 power.
flavor: Of course I've prepared glasses for everyone.

name: Teddie & Kintoki-Douji
text: 【AUTO】 Change [(3) Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Teddie & Kamui" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.
flavor: …what's wrong with being a shadow! There must be something that only I can do!

name: Naoto & Sukuna-Hikona
flavor: But you are me… and I am you. You've always been inside me.

name: Miss "Teddie"
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, put a card from the top of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, this card gets +4 soul until end of turn.
flavor: "Calling herself 'King of the TV World,' She's a cute, sexy little number!"

name: Investigation Team, Teddie
text: 【CONT】 Assist During your opponent's turn, all of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
flavor: But I had friends who

name: New Legend of Teddie
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Mabufudyne" is on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and put that card on top of your deck.
flavor: I have a powerful attack, an unbeatable defense, and a winning smile! Today begins the New Legend of Teddie!

name: Sailor Uniform Naoto
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with "Protagonist(主人公)" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: So I figured I should look more like a girl…

name: Teddie & Kamui
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each card in your hand.
flavor: Teddie is climbing up the stairs to adulthood!

name: "The Imperious Queen of Executions" Mitsuru Kirijo
text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: "Punishing evil from her lonely throne!"

name: Aria of the Soul
text: Choose one of your characters, and until end of turn that character gets +3000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw a card."
flavor: Welcome… to the Velvet Room.

name: Maggie's Tarot Reading
text: 【COUNTER】 Your opponent may choose one of your characters, and return that character to your hand. Choose one of your opponent's characters, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: Ai: "I challenge you read one fortune, no time limit! If I win, which I will, I'm going to destroy this stand!"

name: Megidolaon
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Come, Yamato Takeru!
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 高屋未央

name: Mabufudyne
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Here goes! Kamui!

name: Charging into the Announcement Room!
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: Kujikawa!

name: My Christmas Eve
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I know this is what all the girls wear, but, um... Isn't the skirt too short...?
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 月本てらこ

name: "Contract Key" Protagonist
text: 【CONT】 If you have a character chosen by this card's effect, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: Igor: "There is but one price for this assistance…"
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. First appearance: Dengeki Maoh September 2009 issue

name: Investigation Team, Yosuke
text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
flavor: It's fun to have everyone around the table. More so if they are all friends.

name: Yosuke Hanamura
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: Let's go, partner!

name: Nanako Helping Out
text: 【CONT】 If the number of other characters you have is one or less, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]"
flavor: I'll help out too!

name: Beauty Pageant? Miss Protagonist
flavor: Presenting our transfer student who's been breaking hearts in the second-year class 2, Miss Protagonist!
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 一夜人見

name: Protagonist's Partner, Yosuke
text: 【AUTO】 Change [(3) Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your draw phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Yosuke & Susano-O" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: The powe to protect what's dear to me, huh… Heheh, just what I wanted.

name: Investigation Team, Yu
text: 【CONT】 If this card is on the stage, this card's card name will also be regarded as "Investigation Team, Protagonist".
flavor: Right, Let's do this.

name: Yosuke & Jiraiya
text: 【CONT】 When this card is played from your hand, you may choose one of your cards named "Yosuke Hanamura", and put it into your waiting room. If you do, you may play this card with 0 cost.
flavor: You're me… and I'm you. When you get down to it, all of this is me.

name: Yosuke & Susano-O
text: 【AUTO】 When a card named "Brave Blade" is placed on your climax area, if all of your opponent's characters are 【REST】, this card gets +4000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: That's my true strength!

name: "Sister-Complex Kingpin of Steel" Yu Narukami
text: 【CONT】 If this card is on the stage, this card's card name will also be regarded as ""Sister-Complex Kingpin of Steel" Protagonist".
flavor: "Nobody touches his precious Nanako!"

name: P-1 Grand Prix Begins!
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Rivals, they are "friends", yet powerful "foes"!

name: Brave Blade
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Let's go, Susano-O!
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 増田幹夫

name: Kanji Tatsumi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: Underestimate me, and this is what you get.

name: Real Strength, Kanji
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may choose one of your opponent's 【STAND】 characters, and 【REST】 it.
flavor: Now I can say it straight out… That "other me" is me.

name: Kanji & Take-Mikazuchi
text: 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you use "Backup", choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

name: Kanji & Rokuten Maou
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Mighty Swing" is in your climax area, until end of turn, this card gets the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character."
flavor: We can smash 'em all! Let's do it!

name: Yukiko & Amaterasu
text: 【CONT】 If your opponent does not have any 【STAND】 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
flavor: Please come again… Heeheehee.

name: Musha Training
text: Choose up to two characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: In fact, my body is craving for "that" right now.

name: Mighty Swing
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters gets +2 soul.
flavor: Crush 'em, Rokuten Maou!

name: Salvation
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Hear me, Amaterasu!
copyright: (c)ATLUS (c)SEGA/All rights reserved. Illust: 那知上陽子

name: "Another Self" Protagonist & Izanagi
text: 【AUTO】 Encore ［(2)］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: Igor: "It seems you will encounter a misfortune at your destination, and a great mystery will be imposed upon you."
copyright: ©ATLUS ©SEGA/All rights reserved. First appearance: Play Magazine December 2008 issue

name: Idol on a Break, Risette
text: 【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a climax from your hand into your waiting room］ （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)
flavor: So sorry that I'm not working as an idol right now!

name: Final Break! Aigis
text: 【AUTO】 Accelerate [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +4500 power until end of turn.
flavor:
This is farewell!
Here goes, Final break!

name: Protagonist as JOKER & Arsene
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Thief》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(3) Put a 《Thief》 character from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your encore step, if your opponent does not have any characters in his or her center stage, or if all characters in your opponent's center stage are 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, for each 《Thief》 character in your center stage, perform the following action. "Reveal the top card of your deck, put it on the bottom of your deck, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that card's level." Shuffle your deck afterwards. (Climax are regarded as level 0. This damage may be canceled)
flavor:
Igor: "...Do you have the resolve
to challenge the distortion
of the world?"

name: Ryuji as SKULL: All-out Attack
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to three cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When a card named "FREAKiN' BoRiNG" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to one of your opponent's characters, return it to his or her hand, choose one of your 《Thief》 or 《Sports》 characters, and until end of turn, that character gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal one damage to your opponent." (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: This is it!

name: Protagonist: The Will of Rebellion
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 two of your characters] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, search your deck for up to one 《Thief》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
I am thou, thou art I...
Thou who art willing to perform all sacrilegious acts for thine own justice!
Call upon my name, and release thy rage!

name: Ryuji as SKULL: The Phantom Vanguard
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Thief》 or 《Sports》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When damage dealt by your direct attacking character is not canceled, choose a face down card in your opponent's memory, and put it into his or her waiting room. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Thief》 or 《Sports》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
This effin' rocks!
Now that I got this power, it's time for payback…

name: Ryuji Sakamoto
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Thief》 or 《Sports》 characters.
flavor:
I'm Ryuji Sakamoto.
I'll come talk if I see you around.
Don't ignore me, all right?

name: Protagonist as JOKER: All-out Attack
text:
【CONT】 If the number of 《Thief》 characters you have is four or more, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "THE SHOW'S OVER" is in your climax area, and the number of other 《Thief》 characters you have is four or more, draw a card, search your deck for up to one level 1 or lower character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

name: Ryuji as SKULL & Captain Kidd
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.

real good stuff.

name: Swimsuit Ann
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the number of other 《Thief》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: Morgana as MONA: Identity Unknown
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)

name: Morgana as MONA: For the Sake of the Team
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 1000 multiplied by the number of 《Thief》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 When a card named "Where I Belong" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, and your waiting room has 3 or more characters, you may choose three characters in your waiting room, and return them to your hand. If you do, choose three cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room.
flavor: In this world, there are tons of things that money and fame can't buy!

name: Calling Card
text:
If there are no face down cards in your opponent's memory, your opponent chooses a card from your opponent's hand, puts it face down into his or her memory, and draws up to one card.
Choose up to one of your opponent's level 1 or lower characters in the center stage, put it into his or her waiting room, choose one of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
flavor: Kamoshida: "Come... Steal it, if you can!"

name: Mementos
text:
Put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 Memory [Put this card into your waiting room] When the damage you received is not canceled, if this card is in your memory and that damage is three or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to two characters in your waiting room, return them to your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your stock.
flavor:
Instead of many individual
Palaces, the "general public" has
one gigantic shared Palace.
That's where we are now...
Mementos.

name: omg!! We are SO awesome
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: How's that!? *giggle*

name: For My Best Friend
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Let's go, Carmen!

name: MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Game over!

name: Where I Belong
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor:
Nobody could replace these guys, period!
You know what that means? Your offer was a no-go from the start!

name: Futaba as ORACLE: Navigation Duty
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 characters get +1500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card named "I'll Never Forgive Them!" from your hand into your waiting room] When another of your characters is being attacked, if the number of other 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 characters you have is three or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot deal damage to a player."
【AUTO】 During your opponent's turn, when the damage you received is not canceled, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
flavor: Support's on the way!

name: Yusuke as FOX & Goemon
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a 《Thief》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if you have another 《Thief》 character, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's draw phase, if this card is in your center stage, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +4000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
I am thou, thou art I...
The world is filled with both beauty and vice...
It is time you teach people which is which!

name: Caroline
text:
【CONT】 If you would pay the cost for an event in your hand, you may put a marker from underneath this card into your waiting room instead of a card from your stock.
【AUTO】 [【REST】 this card] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When a climax is put on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Thief》 or 《Twins》 character or character with "Igor(イゴール)" in its card name from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor:
Hmph, try and struggle
as hard as you like.

name: Futaba Sakura
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor:
Futaba: "I knew the Medjed members in
Japan weren't anything special,
so I wasn't worried."
Ann: "How do you know that?"
Futaba: " 'Cause I'm the founder."

name: Yusuke as FOX: The Phantom Artist
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Calling Card" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you play an event, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
I thank you, Madarame...!
Every reason for me to forgive
you has disappeared without a
trace at this very moment!

name: Futaba as ORACLE & Necronomicon
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 characters you have.
flavor:
I am thou, thou art I...
The forbidden wisdom has been revealed.
No mysteries... No illusions shall deceive you any longer.

name: Yusuke Kitagawa
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Thief》 character, draw up to one card, choose a card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, and put up to one card from the top of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 Change [(1) Put two 《Thief》 characters from your hand into your waiting room & Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Yusuke as FOX & Goemon" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor:
An artist and a Phantom Thief...
It seems I'll be engaging in
two trades from here on...
Very well. You only
live once, after all.

name: Justine
text:
【CONT】 If you have another card named "Caroline", this card gets "【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Thief》 characters in front of this card get +1 level and +500 power.".
【AUTO】 Bond/"Caroline" [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Caroline" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor:
The duty of wardens is to protect inmates.
We are also your collaborators.
...That is, if you remain obedient.

name: Swimsuit Futaba
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When damage dealt by your direct attacking character is not canceled, choose a face down card in your opponent's memory, and put it into his or her waiting room. If you do, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

name: Igor: Imposer of Rehabilitation
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Execution" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
The time has come... Your
rehabilitation will soon begin.

name: Futaba as ORACLE: The Phantom Hacker
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor:
Whoa! What in the world!?
Ooh! It's totally skin-tight!

name: Tae Takemi
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor:
I guess high school kids have
it tough nowadays too, huh?
Well, fine. I'll prescribe
you some medication.

name: Sojiro Sakura
text:
【CONT】 All of your other cards named "Futaba: Hacking in Session" get +1 level and +500 power.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Futaba: Hacking in Session" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Futaba: Hacking in Session" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
flavor:
I know it's cliche, but more than
anything I want Futaba to be happy
like a normal person.

name: Yusuke: First Encounter
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Thief》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When your other character in the middle position of the center stage attacks, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.

text: 【CONT】 If this card is in the middle position of your center stage, this card gets +1 level and +2500 power.
flavor:
I was the one who was able
to bring it to life, all thanks
to your assistance.
You have my sincerest gratitude.

name: Futaba: It's a Deal
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your stock for up to one 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 character or event, reveal it to your opponent, return it to your hand, and shuffle your stock.

Please, be my key item!
I'll try and get better
at navigation if you do!

name: Futaba: Hacking in Session
text: 【CONT】 If the number of 《Thief》 or 《Coffee》 characters you have is two or less, this card cannot be played from your hand.

flavor:
I must inherit my mother's wishes...
and improve myself even further.

text:

text:

flavor:

doing, isn't it?
Well, it means nothing... They'll
only be able to do as they please
until this exhibit is over…"

text: Choose up to four of your characters, and put them into your waiting room. Search your deck for up to one 《Thief》 character with a total level and cost of X or lower, put it on any position of your stage, and shuffle your deck. X is equal to the total level and cost of the characters put into your waiting room by this effect while they were on the stage.

a "fusion" of Personas."

name: Velvet Room
text: Choose one of your characters, and put it into your waiting room. If you do, search your deck for up to one event, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
Igor: "This place exists between dream and reality, mind and matter.
It is a room that only those who are
bound by a "contract" may enter."

name: IT WAS FUN WHILE IT LASTED, GOODBYE.
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

That's gotta go!

text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 two of your 《Thief》 characters] Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: Makoto: Phantom Thief of Hearts

text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When your other character is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: Mishima: Volleyball Team Member
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor:
I can't apologize enough
for what I did to you.
...I swear I'll make it
up to you someday.

name: Protagonist (P5)
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Thief》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of other 《Thief》 characters you have.

power of Persona, which
you have awakened to."

All you think about is using
people... You're the real
scumbag, Kamoshida!

name: Ryuji as SKULL: The Skull of Rebellion
flavor:
Even if you apologize now...
I ain't forgivin' you...!

text:

just let that go…"

text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

Sometimes bold moves have
the greatest payout.

I wonder if running away
will solve all my problems…

flavor:

Why're you wrapping this up like
everything's all hunky-dory!?

name: Ann as PANTHER: First Infiltration

Come...!
Zorro!

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Meiji Romantic Story》 character, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 card in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.

name: Cross-Shaped Scar on the Cheek, Kenshin Himura
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Meiji Romantic Story》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the level of the character facing this card is 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.

name: Disturbing Sight, Kaoru Kamiya
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if your hand has 4 or more cards, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax card revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Wait, that's...

name: Fighter for Hire, Sanosuke Sagara
text: 【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Meiji Romantic Story》 characters, this card gets +2500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1《Meiji Romantic Story》 character from your waiting room at the bottom of your clock]".

name: Worthy Rival in Swordsmanship, Yutaro Tsukayama
text:
【CONT】 If you have another character with "Kaoru(薫)" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 During your turn, when this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor:
Looks like I'll have to settle the score
with you at some point.

name: Instructing Her Student, Kaoru Kamiya
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if all of your characters are 《Meiji Romantic Story》, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)

name: Greatest Wish He Can't Give Up, Tsunan Tsukioka
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Meiji Romantic Story》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 "Beacon of a Revolution" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [Put 1 marker underneath this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 cost 0 or lower character on your opponent's center stage, and put it into their waiting room.
flavor:
Ridiculous!
I haven't done anything meaningful yet!

name: Beauty on the Run, Megumi Takani
text:
【AUTO】 [(2)] When your other character with "Sanosuke(左之助)" in its card name is placed on the stage from your waiting room, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

text:

【ACT】 [Put 1 《Meiji Romantic Story》 character from your hand into your waiting room & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 ""Shinko-ryu" Master, Raijuta Isurugi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Sir!

name: Good-Natured, Kaoru Kamiya
text:

【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 5 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax with [SOUL] [SOUL] in its trigger icon, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

text:
【CONT】 If "Beacon of a Revolution" is in your marker area, and you have another 《Meiji Romantic Story》 character, this card gets the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, you may 【REVERSE】 this card's battle opponent."
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Meiji Romantic Story》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Beacon of a Revolution", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor:
They explode and ignite fires, so are
efficient incendiary bombs.

Not only is he an excellent master of kenpo,

last name Sagara, Captain?"

name: Beacon of a Revolution
text:
If you do not have a character with "Tsunan(津南)" or "Sanosuke(左之助)" in its card name, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Choose 1 of the following effects and perform it.
"Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest on the top of your deck in any order."
"Choose 1 of your opponent's cost 0 or lower characters, and put it in their waiting room."

I made it with the knowledge of firearms I gained
in the Sekiho Army. They're bombs.

text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [CHOICE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 character with [SOUL] in its trigger icon in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock)

be angered. Anger will return him to the

【CONT】 If your opponent has a level 3 or higher character, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +4500 power and the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, all players cannot play "Backup" from their hands."

name: The Last Line, Karen Aijo
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your main phase, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or at the bottom of your deck.
【AUTO】 When your other character's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, choose 1 of your 《Revue》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your "The Stage of Fate, Karen Aijo", and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room."

name: Gambling Den, Claudine Saijo
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Kaoruko: "It's your fault. That we..."

name: Greetings, Karen Aijo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Revue》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Um, good morning.

name: Futaba Isurugi Taken Aback
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if your opponent's waiting room has 3 or more climax, 【REST】 this card.
【AUTO】 [Put 1《Revue》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
flavor: Huh?

name: The Devil's Sweet Talk, Claudine Saijo
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Revue》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose the bottom card of your clock and 1 《Revue》 character in your waiting room, and exchange them.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "【RIVAL】 Claudine Saijo" in your waiting room, and put it in the stage position that this card was in. (This ability does not activate if this card is not in the stage at the beginning of the climax phase)
flavor: A playwright and philosopher. I heard you've stood on every stage in the world. So I thought I'd show you. The greatest brilliance nobody has ever seen before.

name: Interrupting, Futaba Isurugi
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Revue》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: The butterfly's selfishness and flower's nonsense must have troubled many.

name: After "Starlight" Is Over, Karen Aijo
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, choose 1 of your 《Revue》 characters , and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When your climax with [ICON:COMEBACK] in its trigger icon is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability. "【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot be returned to hand, move to another stage position, or be put into memory."
flavor: Once Starlight is over.

name: Everyone's Future Path, Claudine Saijo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: No thanks.

name: Skills on the Board, Claudine Saijo
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 "Noble Will, Claudine Saijo" or "Brave Readiness, Maya Tendo" from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Revue》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Gosh, you're weak.

name: Why? Futaba Isurugi
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put X cards from the top of your deck into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Revue》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 [Return 2 《Revue》 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your 《Revue》 characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: It's not fair!

name: Seeking Understanding, Futaba Isurugi
text:
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal 1 ""Our Flower Path" Kaoruko Hanayagi" in your hand] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor: I have to change. For me. And for you.

name: Unable to Find a Reason, Karen Aijo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: What does the stage mean for me?

name: Lines That Betray Your Thoughts, Karen Aijo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all players perform the following action. "If your memory has 5 or more cards, choose 4 cards in your memory, and put all cards in your memory except those cards into your waiting room."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《Revue》 characters, you may choose 1 《Revue》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor: "I jumped aboard to follow you. What am I to aim for now?"

name: Day Before the Field Trip, Futaba Isurugi
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Revue》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Remnant》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Sun: Awkward Smile" in your waiting room, and put it in any position of your stage.
【AUTO】 When your other 《Remnant》 character attacks, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Won't be needing this.
