name: James: Making a Point
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", put the bottom X cards of your opponent's deck into their waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Remnant》 characters you have.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: She's the only one making sense around here.
copyright: © 2024 ROOSTER TEETH PRODUCTIONS, LLC, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

name: Weiss: Determined
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put up to 1 card from the top of your clock into your waiting room, and this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if you have another 《Remnant》 character, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your opponent's deck, choose up to 2 cards from among them, put them on the top of their deck in any order, and put the rest into their waiting room.
flavor: Ruby: "We'd never have a chance to see what beautiful things the future might have waiting for us."
copyright: © 2024 ROOSTER TEETH PRODUCTIONS, LLC, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

name: Blake: Determined
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] During your main phase, when this card is placed on the stage from your hand or from your deck, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 "Blake: Determined", put it in any position of your stage, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "A Trustworthy Partner" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal 2 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Ruby: "We'd never have the strength to change; whether it's ourselves, or the world around us."
copyright: © 2024 ROOSTER TEETH PRODUCTIONS, LLC, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

name: A Trustworthy Partner
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [GATE] : When this card triggers, you may choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Sun: "This is the part where you say it."
copyright: © 2024 ROOSTER TEETH PRODUCTIONS, LLC, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

name: Weiss: Let's Just Live
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Remnant》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
copyright: © 2024 ROOSTER TEETH PRODUCTIONS, LLC, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

name: Royal Election Candidate, Felt
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your stock, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal one damage to your opponent." (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: We'll talk later, Old Man Rom.

name: Former Sword Saint, Theresia
text:
【CONT】 All of your other cards named "Young Swordsman, Wilhelm" get +1 level and +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your memory] When you level up, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Hey... Have you grown to like flowers?

name: Head of House Karsten, Crusch
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1000 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Flip over four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: How goes the healing of your gate?

name: Young Swordsman, Wilhelm
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters on your center stage, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing it.

name: Declaration of War, Felt
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: Sure, I'm in. But let me just say one thing!

name: The Greatest Knight, Julius
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if all of your characters are 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 or 《Merchant》, this card gets +2000 power.
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 or 《Merchant》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: Forgive me for interrupting.

name: Sword Saint, Reinhard
text:
【CONT】 Great Performance
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is six or higher, and you do not have any other characters, this card gets +10000 power and the following five abilities. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects, and cannot become 【REVERSE】 by your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects." "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play event cards and "Backup" from hand." "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character into your opponent's memory." "【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal one damage to your opponent." "【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage." (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: If you've lost your weapon, I strongly suggest you surrender.

name: Expert Negotiator, Anastasia
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Merchant》 or 《Beast Man》 or 《Knight》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: So I figured it'd be easy to get all sorts of information from your mouth, eyes, and expressions!

name: Healer, Felix
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of the center stage with "Crusch(クルシュ)" in its card name gets +1500 power.
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Oh, come on. All I said was, "Maybe it'll be a drinking party."

name: White Whale Hunt, Crusch
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》, this card gets +4000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, choose a card from among them, put it on the top of your deck, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if a card named "Hundred Man Sword Strike" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your stock, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: You greatly underestimate us, looking away so carelessly.

name: Felt's Knight, Reinhard
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: As you can see, the dragon gem has recognized Felt-sama as a priestess.

name: Old Man Rom
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have another character with "Felt(フェルト)" in its card name, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another character with "Felt(フェルト)" in its card name, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When your other character with "Felt(フェルト)" in its card name is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your characters in battle, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: ...Who's that?

name: Pride of the Slums, Felt
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put a card named "Mistral Maiden" from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of cards in your deck is five or less, you may pay the cost. If you do, return all cards in your waiting room to your deck, search your deck for up to one character with "Felt(フェルト)" or "Old Man Rom(ロム爺)" or "Reinhard(ラインハルト)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, search your deck for up to one card named "Royal Election Candidate, Felt", and put it on the stage position that this card was on. Shuffle your deck afterward, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Don't lump me in with those guys! They're all talk. They're not strong at all. They're just a bunch of stingy losers at life.

name: Wilhelm van Astrea
text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards named "Wilhelm van Astrea" in your waiting room is two or more, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》, this card gets +3000 power.
【CONT】 Memory If the number of cards named "Former Sword Saint, Theresia" in your memory is two or more, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."

name: Unseen Hand, Petelgeuse
text:
【CONT】 If this card is on the stage, this card gets 《Sloth》 and 《Diligence》, and the character facing this card gets 《Sloth》.
【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock & Put a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if the number of cards in your hand is five or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and deal one damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your encore step, if you do not have another character with "Subaru(スバル)" in its card name, choose one of your characters, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Complacency! Negligence! That is sloth!

name: Sloth Sin Archbishop, Petelgeuse
text:
【CONT】 If this card is on the stage, this card gets 《Sloth》 and 《Diligence》, and the character facing this card gets 《Sloth》.
【CONT】 This card cannot direct attack.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if the number of markers underneath this card is ten or less, put the top card of your stock underneath this card as a marker. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: If you really meant it, you would pay no heed to the gazes of others.

name: Thankful Feelings, Felt
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, your opponent may reveal his or her hand. If your opponent does, if there is a climax revealed among those cards, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: You saved my life, and I can't let a debt go unpaid.

name: Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Mimi
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Hetaro" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Hetaro" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Hetaro" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Hey, my lady, I wanna eat some more! Can I order?

name: Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Hetaro
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot become 【REVERSE】 by your opponent character's 【AUTO】 effects.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Mimi" [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Mimi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal a card named "Fang of Iron Vice-Captain, Mimi" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +4000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Sis! Together!

name: Priscilla's Knight, Aldebaran
text:
【CONT】 If you have another card named "Royal Election Candidate, Priscilla", this card gets +3000 power.
【CONT】 If this card is on the center stage, all of your other cards named "Royal Election Candidate, Priscilla" get +1 level and +1500 power.
flavor: Hey. That's where we're supposed to stand.

name: Royal Election Candidate, Anastasia
flavor: Which one of 'em issued the challenge?

name: Royal Election Candidate, Priscilla
text:
【CONT】 During this card's battle, if the level of this card's battle opponent is lower than the level of this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets the following ability. "【CONT】 If the character facing this card is a higher level than this card, this card cannot frontal attack."
flavor: I don't want drooling commoners following me around.

name: Negotiating An Alliance, Crusch
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +2000 power.
【ACT】 [Put two cards from your hand into your waiting room] This card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 If this card would attack, you may instead choose a character on your opponent's back stage, and have this card frontal attack with the chosen character as the defending character."
flavor: On what grounds do you know that the White Whale will appear?

name: Airs of a Queen, Priscilla
text:
【AUTO】 [(4) Put a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's characters, and 【REST】 it.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: So… I will give you an opportunity.

name: Bowel Hunter, Elsa
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +4000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, look at up to two cards from the top of your opponent's deck, and put it on the top of his or her deck in any order.
flavor: What's wrong? You don't have to be so scared. I won't do anything to you.

name: Fang of Iron Captain, Ricardo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if all of your other characters on the center stage are 【STAND】, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're takin' on the Witch's Cult, right?

text:

"A character with "Crusch(クルシュ) in its card name and a character with "Felix(フェリックス)" or "Ferris(フェリス)" in its card name"

name: Mistral Maiden
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one yellow card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Hehe…

name: Hundred Man Sword Strike
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Troops, get back!

name: Pink-Haired Maid, Ram
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to three cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When a card named "Subaru Natsuki's Decoy Tactic" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on your center stage, choose up to two cards in your opponent's waiting room, return it to your opponent's deck, your opponent shuffles his or her deck, and this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal one damage to your opponent. (This damage may be canceled)
flavor: I'm cute? Well, that much is obvious.

name: Cute Girl, Beatrice
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 Memory [(1)] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, if you have a card named "Forbidden Library" in your memory, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters and this card, exchange them as 【STAND】, and this card getes +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: No one interrupts Betty's time with Bubby, I suppose.

name: Roswaal Mansion Maid, Ram
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters have "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if a card named "As the Older Sister" is in your climax area, and all of your characters have "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to two characters in your waiting room with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, and return them to your hand.

name: Clairvoyance, Ram
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When your other character with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name or this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may look at the top card of your deck. (Return the card you saw to its original position)
【ACT】 [(1) Put a climax from your hand into your waiting room] Choose a character in your waiting room with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Barusu, I'm going to use my clairvoyance. Wait a moment.

name: The Maid Saw! Ram
text:
【CONT】 The card names of all of your other characters with "Subaru(スバル)" in its card name are also regarded as "Barusu(バルス)".
【AUTO】 Bond/"Dim Light Seen With Those Eyes, Rem" [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Dim Light Seen With Those Eyes, Rem" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to one character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Cover up that sorry thing.

name: Canopy-Piercing Sunlight, Rem & Ram
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
【ACT】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] Choose a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Sunset Knoll, Beatrice
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: Wait!

name: Forbidden Library Warden, Beatrice
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Breaking the Curse" is in your climax area, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, you may choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: You burst in here late at night, and that's what you say, I suppose?

name: Bathtime! Rem & Ram
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters have "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a character with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that character's level. (This damage may be canceled. The revealed card is returned to its original place)
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of his or her deck.

name: With Puck, Subaru
text:
【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Forbidden Library" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your memory] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Court Sorcerer, Roswaal
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects.
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by that character's level.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top three cards of your deck into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to one time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +500 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Draw a card.
【ACT】 [(1)] Choose a level 0 or lower character on your opponent's center stage and put it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: However, to guard him with your life, you must have taken quite a liking to him.

name: Forbidden Library Librarian, Beatrice
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: Oni Prodigy, Ram
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have another character with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" in its card name, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
【CONT】 If you have another character with "Roswaal(ロズワール)" in its card name, this card gets +1 level and +2500 power.

name: With Puck, Beatrice
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Mana Drain" is in your climax area, and if the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal one damage to your opponent, and this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put that character on the top of your opponent's deck." (This damage may be canceled)

name: Self-Praise, Ram
text:
【CONT】 If the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +4500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is four or more, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: I do believe my honesty is my most charming feature.

name: Sticking with Bubby, Beatrice
text:
【AUTO】[(1) Put a climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, your opponent chooses one of your opponent's characters, and puts it into his or her waiting room.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Great Spirit, Puck" [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Great Spirit, Puck" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Betty was only waiting for Bubby!

name: Innocent Child, Petra
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose one of your 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Hee♪

name: Door Crossing, Beatrice
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top two cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax revealed among those cards, you may choose a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: So now you can break through my Door Crossing like it's natural, I suppose.

name: Sulking Beatrice
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the number of climax in your opponent's waiting room is three or more, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Hmph.

name: A Flower in Each Arm, Ram
text:
【CONT】 All of your other cards named "A Flower in Each Arm, Rem" get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card named "A Flower in Each Arm, Rem" from among them, put it on any position of your stage, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have another card named "A Flower in Each Arm, Rem", this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: But I'm going with you. You'll have a pretty flower on each arm, Barusu.

name: Sister's Avenger, Ram
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if all of your characters have "Roswaal(ロズワール)" or "Ram(ラム)" or "Rem(レム)" in its card name, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Don't touch Rem... Don't touch my little sister!

name: Margrave Roswaal
flavor: Why not? That can be kept separate from our royal selection business. Subaru-kun should go to the capital to thank everyone, as well as to receive treatment.

name: Forbidden Library
text: Choose up to one card named "Cute Girl, Beatrice" in your hand, and put it on any position of your stage. Put this card into your memory.

name: Subaru Natsuki's Decoy Tactic
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: When this is over, take an objective look at what you just said until you wish you were dead!

name: As the Older Sister
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: What do you know about Rem and me?!

name: Mana Drain
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: It took you long enough to notice, I suppose.

name: Breaking the Curse
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Peaceful Life, Rem
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one level 1 or lower character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a climax, draw a card, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.

name: Silver-Haired Beauty, Emilia
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Starting Life in Another World" is in your climax area, and the number of other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters you have is three or more, look at up to four cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Thank you... for staying with me.

name: Blue-Haired Maid, Rem
text:
【CONT】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is two or less, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Thank you for waiting. Your Rem is here.

text:

If you do, choose a card named "Great Spirit, Puck" in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage.

text:

【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to one cost 0 or lower character in your waiting room, and put it on separate positions of your stage.
flavor: Please stop... You're both too funny... Haha... Ahahaha...

name: Happy Daydream, Rem
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 characters get +500 power.

flavor: Whether we have a boy or a girl, twins or even triplets, I know they would be adorable.

name: Pure Maiden, Emilia
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Magic》 or 《Weapon》 character, put it into your hand, choose a card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the number of other characters you have is one or less, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put that character on any position of your back stage.

name: Unconditional Trust, Rem
text: 【CONT】 If the character facing this card is a higher level than this card, this card cannot frontal attack.
flavor: But I think that is what's so wonderful about you.

If you do, put all cards from your clock into your waiting room, all players return all their characters to their hand, and return all cards in their waiting room to their deck. Search your deck afterwards for up to one card named "Subaru Natsuki", put it on the stage position that this card was on, and all players shuffle their decks.

text:

text: 【CONT】 You cannot play event cards and "Backup" from hand.

text:

flavor: My mouth, my throat, my heart all remember.

text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Anniversary》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.

【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.
flavor: Come on, let's go, Kirito!

name: Unbreakable Hope, Asuna
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other "The Power of Divine Authority, Kirito" get +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【ACT】 Resonate [(1) Reveal 1 "The Power of Divine Authority, Kirito" in your hand & 【REST】 this card] Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Anniversary》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Welcome back, Kirito.

name: Newbie Gamer, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 event from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. If you put 1 card into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Amazing... it's like the real thing!

name: Shout Echoing Across the Battlefield, Alice
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Anniversary》 characters.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Guardian of Human Realm" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, and you have 4 or more other 《Anniversary》 characters, choose up to 1 "Alicization" or character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose up to 1 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor: My name is Alice!

name: Together With You, Asuna
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other "Towards Tomorrow Together, Mito" get +1000 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play "Backup" from their hand."
【CONT】 All of your other 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 characters get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 character with level equal to or lower than your level in your hand, put it in any position of your stage, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Thank you.

name: Piling Up Emotions, Asuna & Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "《Mother's Rosario》" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top 11 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and deal 2 damage X times to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax among those cards." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Kirito: "Let's go, Asuna!"

name: Rising Expectations, Argo
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the level of that card +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "Reliable Information" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 3 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: So those two are the top players at this point?

name: Asuna's Commanding Strength
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Anniversary》 characters.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "The World of Swords" is in your climax area, and you have 4 or more other 《Anniversary》 characters, you may choose 1 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand or put it into your stock. If you put it into your stock, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'll protect you. So you protect me, okay?

name: Straight Path, Alice
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Anniversary》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [Return 2 《Anniversary》 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Flip over 3 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. If "Shout Echoing Across the Battlefield, Alice" is revealed among those cards, choose 1 "Shout Echoing Across the Battlefield, Alice" in your waiting room, and put it in any position of your stage.
flavor: Your heart can't be tainted by anyone.

name: Self-Sacrificing, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Anniversary》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Take your time eating, all right?

text:

【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)

text:

text:

flavor: This may be a game, but it's not something you play.

name: 《Aria of a Starless Night》 Asuna
text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Floating Castle Aincrad" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: We're already friends without doing that!

name: A New Promise, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: We are going to clear this game, aren't we?

name: 【Aria of a Starless Night】 Asuna
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
flavor: Sword Art Online.

name: Battle Stance, Asuna
text: 【CONT】 Experience During your turn, if the total level of the cards in your level is 5 or higher, this card gets +6000 power.
flavor: We have to surround the boss, or there won't be a range attack!

name: Game of Life or Death
text:
This card can be played from your hand without fulfilling color requirements.
Choose 1 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Asuna: "I don't want to lose to this game... to this world."

flavor: Kabaya: "I wish you luck, players."

text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: All those who stand before me, brace for my holy authority to vanquish every last one of you!

(Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: I was happy that I was able to help you in your world.

text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "《Mother's Rosario》" is in your climax area, and you have 3 or more other 《Anniversary》 characters, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 "Inherited Sword Technique" or 《Anniversary》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Thank you, Asuna

text:

If you do, choose this card and 1 of your "Together With You, Asuna" or "《Aria of a Starless Night》 Kirito", exchange them, and those characters get +1 soul until end of turn. (The cards' states do not change)
flavor: Asuna!!

text:

(Climax are regarded as level 0)

text:

If you do, choose up to 1 "Bewitching Smile, Yuna" in your hand, and put it in the stage position that this card was in.
flavor: Eiji, sorry to keep you waiting!

text: 【ACT】 [(1) Put this 【STAND】 card into your memory] Choose 1 "《Zekken》 Yuuki" or "Overcoming Fear, Asuna" or "Unbending Fighting Spirit, Asuna" or "Piling Up Emotions, Asuna & Kirito" or ""Mother's Rosario" Yuuki" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Hehe.

text:

【ACT】 [(1) Return 2 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Put this card into your waiting room & Shuffle your deck] Choose 1 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Don't be so nervous.

text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the cost of this card's battle opponent is 0 or lower, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Sometimes, you gotta fight to get your point across.

text:

flavor: Kirito, you must believe.

If you do, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Asuna: "And then we can sit and talk and you can tell me where you've been."

name: Leveling Up Together, Mito
text: 【CONT】 If you have 1 or less other characters, this card gets +1 level and +2500 power.

text:

【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

text:

text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Anniversary》 characters you have ×500.

"【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, you may return this card to your hand."
flavor: When I finish a sword I can be satisfied with, I'll tell him how I feel.

name: Top Class Blacksmith, Lisbeth
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of the following effects, and perform it. "Your opponent puts all of their stock into their waiting room, and puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock." "All of your characters get +4000 power until end of turn."
flavor: You'll always be welcome at Lisbeth's Smith Shop!

name: Cute Mischief, Silica
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, perform the following action 2 times. "Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room."
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you do not have another character in your back stage, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put that character in any position of your back stage.
flavor: Wah!

name: Irrepairable, Lisbeth
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 0 or lower characters in front of this card get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 0 or lower character, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Ugwahhh!

name: Spring Blooms, Rika & Suguha & Keiko
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: 《Death Gun》 Alongside Fear
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an 《Anniversary》 character, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -6000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.
flavor: You talk a good game, but...

name: Yearning, Silica & Lisbeth
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room & Put 1 other character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Mysterious Smile, Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 card in your level and 1 card in your waiting room, and exchange them.
【ACT】 [Put this card into your clock] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 level 1 or higher card from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Now, show me.

name: He Who Seeks, Steals, and Robs, Gabriel
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Souls.

name: Silica's Gratitude
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an 《Anniversary》 character, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -1 level until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's memory.
flavor: You're a good person! You saved me!

name: Heart's Warmth, Asuna & Lisbeth
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [ICON:COMEBACK] in its trigger icon, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Lisbeth: "You've found something important to you."

name: Twisted Love, Vassago
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +2500 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 red card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: How much I love that guy.

name: Hill of Memories
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Silica: "I'm so glad..."

name: Awakened Feelings
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I like you!

name: Flower Crown of Happiness, Yui
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Anniversary》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Anniversary》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Come on, Papa, hurry.

name: GGO's Strongest Sniper, Sinon
text:
【CONT】 Experience During your turn, if the total level of the cards in your level is 2 or higher, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 other 《Anniversary》 character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an 《Anniversary》 character, put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card at the bottom of your deck] Choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: You owe me a fight, so you better stay alive.

name: The Power of Divine Authority, Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Memory When this card attacks, if "Night-Sky Blade" is in your climax area, you have another 《Anniversary》 character, and "Alicization" is in your memory, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the cost of that card +1. (Climax are regarded as 0 cost. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: I definitely won't let your feelings,

name: 《Aria of a Starless Night》 Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
flavor: So we've got to go home alive today, okay?

name: "Stay Cool" Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 Memory If this card is in your memory, all of your "The Power of Divine Authority, Kirito" get the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character facing this card, and that character gets -2 soul until end of turn."
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Anniversary》 characters, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if your memory has 2 or less cards, you may put this card into your memory.
flavor: That's right, Kirito. Don't cry. Stay cool.

name: 2.5 Years of Memories, Eugeo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an 《Anniversary》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot move to another position of the stage."
flavor: Kirito...

name: Familial Love, Asuna & Yui
text:
【CONT】 This card can be played from your hand without fulfilling color requirements.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《Anniversary》 characters, you may choose 1 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Anniversary》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Anniversary》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor: Asuna: "We'll be together forever, Yui-chan."

name: 《Unlimited Flight Ability》 Sinon
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. Deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax among those cards. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Apparently, it's a unique power gifted to the Solus account.

name: Moonlit Night Swordsmen, Asuna & Kirito
text: 【AUTO】 [(2) Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Kirito: "SAO is no ordinary game."

name: Memory Fragment, Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if your memory has 2 or less cards, you may choose 1 ""Stay Cool" Eugeo" in your waiting room, and put it into your memory.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put that character at the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Right here forever.

name: Valuable Strength, Kirito
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 other 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character from your stage into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: You can become stronger.

name: Bullet of Determination, Sinon
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When ""Cold-Hearted Sniper"" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, and all of your characters are 《Anniversary》, choose 1 of the following effects and perform it. "This card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When this card attacks, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."" "Choose 1 of your opponent's level 1 or higher characters, your opponent chooses 1 level X or lower character in their waiting room, and exchanges them. X is equal to the level of the character you chose by this effect -1."
flavor: He won't even know what hit him.

【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: In a Bad Mood, Shino
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Anniversary》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 During this card's attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: It's like... yeah, he pisses me off.

name: 《Black Swordsman》 Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may choose 1 of your 《Anniversary》 characters, and move it to the open middle position of your center stage.
【ACT】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Choose 1 level X or lower 《Anniversary》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the number of "The World of Swords" in your waiting room.
flavor: No, I'm going to win. I'm going to win and end this game.

name: 《Ordinal Scale》 Silica & Asuna & Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, your opponent declares 0 or 1 or 2 or 3. Put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and if that card's level is the number your opponent declared, you draw up to X cards. X is equal to the number your opponent declared +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.

name: Assault Team, Agil
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character from your hand into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of characters your opponent has.
flavor: My name is Agil.

name: Giving Advice, Sinon
text: 【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put this card into your memory. If you do, at the beginning of your next draw phase, choose 1 "Giving Advice, Sinon" in your memory, and put it in any position of your stage.
flavor: I guess when it comes to combat, everyone's got their own style...

name: Even if It's a Trap, Klein
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
flavor: If I gotta chance to do some good for someone, I will!

name: Happy Family, Asuna & Yui
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Anniversary》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
flavor: Yui: "I'm going, too!"

name: For the World He Loves, Eugeo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of characters your opponent has ×2000.
flavor: It's because you love the people you met here.

name: 《Coat of Midnight》 Kirito
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 5500, Level 2 [(2) Reveal this card in your hand & Put it at the bottom of your deck] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +5500 power until end of turn)
flavor: A beater... that's a good name.

name: Alicization
text: Search your deck for up to 1 《Anniversary》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck. Put this card into your memory.
copyright:
©2020 REKI KAWAHARA/KADOKAWA CORPORATION/SAO-P Project
Illustrator: abec

name: SYSTEM ALERT
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose up to 2 of your 《Anniversary》 or 《Integrity Knight》 or 《Noble》 characters, and those characters get the following abilities until end of turn. "【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -2 soul." "【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may return this card to its previous stage postion as 【REST】." Put this card into your clock.
flavor: Eugeo: "If upholding such a law is the "right" thing to do..."

name: Night-Sky Blade
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Starburst... Stream!

name: "Cold-Hearted Sniper"
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Yer dead.

name: Unexpected Healing, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When your other "Conquering Floor 1's Boss, Kirito" attacks, if there are no markers underneath that character, you may put this card face up underneath that character as a marker. If you do, that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [Put the top card of your stock into your clock & 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 level 1 or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: To think that such wonderful bathtubs exist in this world!

name: Obsessed With Games, Misumi
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose another character, and that character gets +2 level until end of turn.
flavor: Asuna: "You should've seen your face then!"

name: Rare Item Obtained, Mito
text:
【CONT】 If your opponent has a level 3 or higher character, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If this card is in your center stage, all of your 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 characters get +1500 power.
flavor: I snagged the item!

name: Conquering Floor 1's Boss, Kirito
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +10000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When your other "Unexpected Healing, Asuna" is put underneath this card as a marker, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: The road to either death or glory, huh?{

name: Intersecting Feelings, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】."
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Anniversary》 or 《Progressive》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: The boss isn't done yet.

name: Intersecting Feelings, Mito
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", all of your characters with "Asuna(アスナ)" in their card names get 《Weapon》 until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 1 [(1) Reveal this card in your hand & Put this card at the bottom of your deck]
(Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: I won't let you die, no matter what.

name: Asuna Invites to Party
text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】[(1)］ When this card attacks, if a card named "<<Star Splash>>" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
flavor: Then, party up with me. It's been forever.

name: 《Lightning Flash》Asuna
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +4000 power and +1 soul.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's stock.
flavor: I'll protect you, too. I'll protect you forever.

name: Asuna Lays on the Sofa
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is not an 《Avatar》 character, put it into your clock. (If it is not, return the revealed card to its original place.)
flavor:
Hey…… Kirito.
Do you think it would be okay if we left the front lines for a bit.

name: Imprisoned Queen, Asuna
text: 【CONT】 If you have another character with “Kirito(キリト)” in its card name, this card gets +1000 power and "【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".
flavor: Save me, Kirito…

name: Asuna Changes Clothes
text: 【AUTO】 When another of your 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Kyaa!?

name: Asuna Dozed Off
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "A Sworn Promise" is in your climax area, until end of turn, all of your characters get +1000 power and your opponent cannot use "【AUTO】 Encore". （Your opponent cannot use the "【AUTO】 Encore [(3)］" rule either.)
【AUTO】 Accelerate ［Put the top card of your deck into your clock］ At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +3000 power until end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Mm…… I was just dreaming a little. About my old world……

name: Asuna's Commanding Strength
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand or by the effect of a card named "Returning to the Front Lines", you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】[(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room］ When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, all of your 《Avatar》 characters get +500 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I'll protect you…… So you protect me, okay?
copyright: Original Design: Shingo Adachi Finishing: Asuka Yokota Finish Work: Hiroka Takeshi

name: Asuna's Married Life
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You must be hungry. Let's eat.

name: Asuna's True Expression
text: 【AUTO】 Change[(1) Put a card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Imprisoned Queen, Asuna" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Even if this is a virtual world, my feelings are real.

name: Vice Commander, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if the number of 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters you have is two or more, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 ［Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] （Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.)
flavor:
I, Asuna, Vice Commander of the
Knights of the Blood Oath, will oversee this operation.

name: Asuna Takes Shelter
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1 level and +1500 power for each marker underneath this card.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: It kind of feels, like I was born and raised here for my entire life, it's just a feeling.

name: Asuna Replies to a Proposal
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this character gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is an 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn. (The revealed cards are returned to their original place.)
flavor: …… Yes.

name: Guild Commander, Heathcliff
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if a card named "Duel in the Arena" is in your climax area, choose one of your opponent's cost 1 or less characters, return it to your opponent's hand, and this card cannot 【REVERSE】 until end of turn.
flavor: If you can defeat me in combat, you may take Asuna. But if you lose, you will join the Knights of the Blood Oath.

name: Asuna's Strong Bond
text:
【AUTO】 Bond／"Kirito Joins the Knights of the Blood Oath" ［Put the top card of your deck into your clock］ （When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Kirito Joins the Knights of the Blood Oath" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
【ACT】[(1)］ Choose one of your 《Avatar》 characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
flavor: To me, Kirito is the meaning of my two years here, and proof that I'm alive.

name: Asuna Jumps to Conclusions
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: You dummy------!!

name: Observer, Kuradeel
text: 【ACT】[(1)］ Choose one of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it into your opponent's stock.
flavor:
Hell, no! A low-level player like you
couldn't possibly protect her!

name: Asuna - Start of the Battle
flavor:
So I'll accept your offer, and take it easy today.
You can play at forward.

name: Laughing Coffin
text: 【ACT】[(1) 【REST】 two of your characters］ This card gets +1500 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: No flavor text

name: Heathcliff's Hidden Identity
flavor: The plan was not to reveal that fact before we reached Floor 95.

name: Asuna's Veteran Cooking Skill
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, if the number of other 《Avatar》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
flavor: Let's see…… Then let's make a stew.

name: Returning to the Front Lines
text: You may choose one of your characters named "Asuna Replies to a Proposal", and put it into your waiting room. If you do, choose a card named "Asuna's Commanding Strength" in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: Kirito, Asuna: "Teleport-- Grandzam!"

name: Self-sacrifice
text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and that character gets +3500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Kirito: "No, Asuna…… This can't…… This can't be……"

name: A Sworn Promise
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor:

I, too, was always looking for something.
Something real in this world.

Please, from now on…… go and help
people in my place…… share your happiness with them……
