flavor: Daddy, Mummy, everyone, please use this!
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Perpetuation of the Promise
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Asuna: "Wow…"
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: 2 Years' Confrontation, Asuna
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +1500 power for each of your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters.
flavor: You've spent a lot of time in this game, I see.
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Seductive Shore, Leafa
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top two cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, 【REST】 this card.
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Bonus Time! Yuna
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, your opponent may draw two cards. If your opponent does, your opponent chooses two cards from your opponent's hand and puts it into his or her waiting room.
flavor: All right, let the battle begin! Music, start!
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: The Reason I Won't Lose, Kirito
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card’s battle opponent is higher than your opponent’s level, you may put that character on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: I can't lose to someone who denies his past self.
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Real Physical Sensation, Kirito
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to two times per turn. When your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [Put a climax from your hand into your waiting room] Until end of turn, this card gets +1000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may draw a card."
flavor: Is that all No. 2 can do?
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Precise Battle Orders, Asuna
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you do not have another 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: A wide-range attack is coming! Get down!
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: Maid Clothes Asuna
expansion_raw: Sword Art Online The Movie – Ordinal Scale –
text: 【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I'll go make us some tea.
copyright: ©2016 REKI KAWAHARA/PUBLISHED BY KADOKAWA CORPORATION ASCII MEDIA WORKS/SAO MOVIE Project

name: To the Cave in the North, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose 1 card from among them, put it into your clock, and put the rest into your waiting room. If you put 1 card into your clock, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Well, we have no choice but to go in now, right?

name: Resolution to Break Away, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Declaration of Independence" is in your climax area, look at the top card of your deck, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest on the top of your deck, and this card gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【AUTO】 When this card is being frontal attacked, you may return this card to your hand."
flavor: In order to accomplish what I must do, I will fight you!

name: "If You Want My Answer" Asuna
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters.
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by the 【AUTO】 effect of "Ocean Turtle, Asuna", when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to that card's level +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: It wasn't all just fun and games. There was so much pain and sadness, too, wasn't there?

name: Brilliant Female Knight, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When damage dealt by this card is canceled, if "Osmanthus Sword" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top 5 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose up to X cards in your opponent's waiting room, return them to your opponent's deck, your opponent shuffles his or her deck, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of cards with [SOUL] in its trigger icon revealed among those cards. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Who do you think I am?

name: Party in Full Swing, Selka
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: But chopping down the demon tree is amazing, huh?

name: Lifeline Chains, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: How About Something Sweet? Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room]
When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
flavor: It makes me trip a little, you know!

name: Cooking with the Sacred Arts, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Fluctlight》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Generate Thermal Element. Aqueous Element. Aerial Element.

name: Glittering Osmanthus, Alice
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Fluctlight》 characters in front of this card get +2000 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play event cards from hand."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and return it to his or her hand.
flavor: Spin, my flowers!

name: Information About the Virtual World, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into his or her stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: There was a boy and girl, and it seems like the girl broke the Taboo Index.

name: Sore Loser, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it in your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 When the damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may put this card into your stock.
flavor: Y-You insulted me yet again!

name: Incident of a Certain Summer, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When your other character with "Kirito(キリト)" or "Eugeo(ユージオ)" in its card name is placed on the stage from your hand, that character gets +1000 power and 《Lunch Box》 until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When your character's trigger check reveals a climax, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Deusolbert: "...Trespassing into the Dark Territory."

name: Memories of a Younger Sister, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that card into your opponent's memory.
flavor: It's true. I have a family.

name: Dauntless Perfect Control Art, Alice
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card at the bottom of your deck."
flavor: Could it be you're mocking me? To run towards me without drawing your swords...

name: Confrontation with PK Squadron, Asuna
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if you have another character with "Kirito(キリト)" in its card name, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card direct attacks, this card gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: Leave this to me!

name: Fighting with Minions, Alice
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if you have another character with "Kirito(キリト)" in its card name, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If you do, for each [SOUL] trigger icon on that card, this card gets +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: There's no doubt. What are they doing here?

name: Feelings Towards Older Sister, Selka
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card direct attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: For some reason, I feel a little better now.

name: Girl to Be Saved, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 level 0 or lower character in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage.

name: "Ocean Turtle" Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character, draw up to 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, and put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put this card into your waiting room] When "To Where You Are" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""If You Want My Answer" Asuna" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: Nice to meet you

name: Godsend
text: Search your deck for up to 1 character with "Alice(アリス)" in its card name and up to 1 character with "Kirito(キリト)" in its card name, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: Alice: "Why would you keep something like that in your pocket?"

name: Sergeant First Class Natsuki Aki
text: 【COUNTER】 If you do not have a 《Fluctlight》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. You may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room. Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: I pledge to protect young Kirigaya, life and limb, with full responsibility! And so on!

name: Osmanthus Sword
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Its attribute is "everlasting eternity."

name: Declaration of Independence
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Our glorious order of Integrity Knights has been destroyed as of today.

name: To Where You Are
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Kirito. Kirito!

name: "With Pride" Cardinal
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Fluctlight》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your clock] When your other 《Fluctlight》 character is being frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to your hand.
flavor: I will give you my life!

name: Spending a Day Off, Sortiliena
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters revealed among those cards ×1000.
flavor: What a coincidence.

name: Fight Between Bitter Enemies, Cardinal
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Conclusion After 200 Years" is in your climax area, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, put it into your stock, choose up to 1 "Charlotte's Assist" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Stay back!

name: Girls of Age, Ronie & Tiese
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to the level of that character ×500.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters with "Kirito(キリト)" or "Eugeo(ユージオ)" in its card name, and that card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Ronie: "Th-Thank you very much, Elite Disciple!"

name: "Perfect Control Art" Cardinal
text:
【CONT】 Assist All your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to the level of that character ×500.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "What It Means to Be Human" is placed on your climax area, choose up to 2 of your characters, and those characters get the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, put it into your stock." (Climax are regarded as level 0. Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Both of you close your eyes and think of your sword.

name: "The Sage of the Library" Cardinal
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose and perform 1 of the following effects. "Choose 1 card in your hand, and put it in your waiting room. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock." "Draw up to 2 cards, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room." "This card gets +4500 power and the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, all players cannot play "Backup" from hand.""
flavor: We've been detected. Can't use this back door anymore.

name: "The Legendary Hero" Bercouli Synthesis One
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Bercouli and the Northern White Dragon" is in your climax area, this card gets +1500 power and the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【AUTO】 [(2) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When the character facing this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 4 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Integrity Knight Commander Bercouli Synthesis One... is coming!

name: The Girl Called Lyserith, Cardinal
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When a climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Cardinal's Dagger" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Administrator: "If I can copy my own Fluctlight's thoughts and memories by overwriting this child's Fluctlight..."

name: "Sister-In-Training" Fizel Synthesis Twenty-Nine
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 ""Sister-In-Training" Linel Synthesis Twenty-Eight", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Um... I'm... no... I'm Fizel, an Axiom Church sister-in-training. And this is my fellow sister-in-training.

name: Appeal to the Integrity Knight, Tiese & Ronie
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.
flavor:
Eugeo: "Tiese!"
Kirito: "Ronie!"

name: Heroic Warrior, Bercouli
text: 【CONT】 You cannot play event cards and "Backup" from hand.

name: "Page" Tiese
text:
【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other card with "Eugeo(ユージオ)" in its card name becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card is on your back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 that character.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Fate Beginning to Change, Eugeo" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Fate Beginning to Change, Eugeo" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Eugeo: "So, Tiese, you come from a noble family, right? I thought all the nobles' mansions were in District Three and Four."

name: Serlut Style User, Sortiliena
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

name: "Detestable Face" Fanatio
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into his or her waiting room. If you do, put that character into his or her clock.
flavor: Criminal. I can see that you're unlike the ones I've fought before.

name: "The Crimson Knight" Deusolbert Synthesis Seven
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if your opponent's center stage has 1 or less characters, choose 1 character on your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I oversaw Norlangarth's northern border in District Seven.

name: "Page" Ronie
text: 【CONT】 If your level is 3 or higher, this card gets the following ability. "【ACT】 [Put this card into your waiting room] Choose up to 1 ""Lost Child of Vecta" Kirito" in your hand, and put it on the stage position that this card was on."
flavor: Kirito: "If it's any other trajectory, they'll change their footing for sure, so after seeing that, you'll still have time to block it."

name: "Sister-In-Training" Linel Synthesis Twenty-Eight
text: 【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot move to another position on the stage.
flavor: I-I'm Linel.

name: "Violet-Haired Suave Man" Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-One
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +4000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, if there is no opponent character facing this card, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and move it to the stage position facing this card."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "An Unexpected Welcome, Alice" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: I am just a novice, without my own territory... Perhaps you'll be so kind as to forgive that?

name: Information About the Virtual World, Leafa
text:
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When you use an 【ACT】, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 1 of your 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Asuna: "They said that, normally, it wouldn't have been possible."

name: "The Relentless Knight" Fanatio Synthesis Two
text: 【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, if this card is on the center stage, all characters on the center stage get -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: System Call. Enhance Armament!

name: Knight on Flying Dragon, Deulsolbert
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Alice: "Dragon Knights..."

name: "Swordsman's Pride" Volo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Fluctlight》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor: Sortiliena: "As has been mutually agreed, both will use real swords."

name: Cardinal's Dagger
text:
If you have 2 or less 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Choose up to 1 ""The Sage of the Library" Cardinal" in your hand, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor: Cardinal: "Meaning that any sacred arts I use will affect her without fail."

name: What It Means to Be Human
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: This is what it means to be human, huh?

name: Conclusion After 200 Years
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 green card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: "Please protect this world and its people."

name: Bercouli and the Northern White Dragon
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Kirito: "He took hold of a beautiful sword in the treasure, but the instant he did..."

name: "Pontifex of the Axiom Church" Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your clock, and put it at the bottom of your deck.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Put 2 《Fluctlight》 characters from your hand into your waiting room] When "Ruler of the 《Human Realm》" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, put it on an open position of your stage, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, you may deal 2 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: But was that love really meant only for you?

name: "Sacred Arts Researcher" Quinella
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 character with "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" in its card name, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【ACT】 Resonate [(1) Reveal a card named ""Pontifex of the Axiom Church" Administrator" in your hand & 【REST】 2 of your 《Fluctlight》 characters] Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: I gratefully accept, Father.

name: Preparation for the Load Test, Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a level 0 or lower character revealed among those cards, this card's soul does not decrease by side attacking until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I knew you'd emerge from your musty hole sooner or later.

name: Brutal Lightning Attack, Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax revealed among those cards, this card gets +3000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 1 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.

name: Sweet Temptation, Administrator
text:
【CONT】 Experience If all of the cards in your level have "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" or "Quinella(クィネラ)" in their card names, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if "Temptation into Eternal Stasis" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, choose 1 character with a level equal to or less than your level +1 in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage as 【REST】.
flavor: I'll bring you to the ultimate pleasure, one beyond your imagination!

name: "Ruler" Administrator
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【CONT】 Experience If all of the cards in your level have "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" or "Quinella(クィネラ)" in their card names, this card gets the following ability. "【AUTO】 When your card or your opponent's card in the clock is put into the waiting room due to respective card effects, that player may put the top 2 cards from stock into the waiting room. Otherwise, that player puts the top card of the deck into the clock."

name: Confrontation with PK Squadron, Lisbeth
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Accelerate [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock, and this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You dirty PK jerks, how do you like this?

name: "Sword Skill" Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 3 or higher, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: On your knees! Offer me your head! Submit to me!

name: "Endless Thirst to Rule" Quinella
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of characters your opponent has.
【AUTO】 Change [Return this card to your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to 1 ""Pontifex of the Axiom Church" Administrator" in your hand, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: She's a child of God! Surely, Lady Quinella is the holy child of the god Stacia!

name: Unexpected Limit, Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When a climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor:
Cardinal: "Her soul's capacity
for preserving her memories had reached its limit."

name: "Your Eminence, Prime Senator" Chudelkin
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your opponent's stock into his or her waiting room. If you do, choose 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it into his or her stock.
【AUTO】【ACT】 [Put this card into your waiting room] Choose 1 of your characters with "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" or "Quinella(クィネラ)" in its card name, and 【STAND】 it.
flavor: Have you dealt with those rebels, Number Thirty-two?

name: Information About the Virtual World, Silica
text:
【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play "Backup" from hand.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Asuna: "They think they might've found some kind of loophole."

name: "Sword Automaton" Sword Golem
text:
【CONT】 If you have another character with "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" or "Quinella(クィネラ)" in its card name, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top card of your deck into your clock, and 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Administrator: "Each of its swords has the Priority Level of a Divine Object. Do you think you can defeat this Sword Golem?"

name: Piety Module
text:
If you do not have a character with "Administrator(アドミニストレータ)" in its card name, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Choose 1 cost 1 or lower character on your opponent's back stage, put it into his or her waiting room, choose up to 1 level X character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. X is equal to the cost +1 of the character put into your opponent's waiting room by this effect.
flavor: Kirito: "There's an order inside you that you're not aware was put there by someone else."

name: Memory Crystal
text: Choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 face up card in your opponent's memory, and put that card face down. At the end of of your opponent's next turn, put that card face up.

name: Ruler of the 《Human Realm》
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Cardinal: "Administrator, you hollow fool!"

name: Temptation into Eternal Stasis
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: That's right. Now keep going. Remove Core Protection.

name: "Eugeo's Partner" Kirito
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 5 or higher, this card gets "【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power".
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over the top 4 cards of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax card revealed among them, search your deck for up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: I'm counting on you, partner. I promise to give you a name when this fight is over.

name: Roommate of a Free Spirit, Eugeo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters with "Kirito(キリト)" in its card name, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: S-Stay cool.

name: "Kirito's Partner" Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【ACT】 【CXCOMBO】 Experience [Put this card into your waiting room] If "Night-Sky-Colored Hero, Kirito" is in your level, choose 1 "Red Rose Sword" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Lend me your strength, Blue Rose Sword!

name: Night-Sky-Colored Hero, Kirito
text:
【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 6 or higher, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 1 card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, choose up to 1 ""Kirito's Partner" Eugeo" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Red Rose Sword" is in your climax area, deal 1 damage to your opponent, and if there is a marker underneath this card, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 3 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Eugeo: "Now stand, Kirito. My best friend. My... hero."

name: Repayment for Lunch, Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, at the beginning of your climax phase, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: (Think in terms of your avatar, not your physical body.)

name: "Power of Meaning" Kirito
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Night-Sky Blade" is in your climax area, you may choose 1 of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, and put it at the bottom of his or her deck.
flavor: Eugeo: "This is..."

name: Body into Sword, Eugeo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is put on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 When this card is placed into your waiting room from the stage, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you reveal 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: I just finally realized what my mission is.

name: Light from Sacred Arts, Eugeo
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Fluctlight》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: I see. They don't like the light from this grass.

name: Taboo and Justice, Eugeo
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 2 《Fluctlight》 characters from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it at the bottom of his or her deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)

name: "Eternal Ice and the Rose" Eugeo
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(3) Put 1 "Blue Rose Sword" from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character facing this card, deal X damage to your opponent, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn.
"【CONT】 This card cannot deal damage to a player." X is equal to that character's soul. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Eternal ice has the ability to freeze everything. And the rose's ability is...

name: Searching for Papa, Yui
text:
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, at the beginning of your climax phase, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Right. One possibility is that he may have been transported overseas.

name: To the Cave in the North, Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your opponent's climax area, you may put this card into your stock.
flavor: The white dragon won't mind if we just take some icicles.

name: Seventh-Generation Carver, Eugeo
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

name: Confrontation with PK Squadron, Kirito
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Temporary Alliance, Kirito" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card at the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Klein: "Man, I'd heard the rumors, but GGO sure is a hardcore game."

name: "Swordsman's Pride" Kirito
text: 【CONT】 Experience If the total level of cards in your level is 2 or higher, this card gets +1500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
flavor: Sortiliena: "The one-point match between Elite Disciple Levantein and Novice Trainee Kirito will now begin."

name: Information About the Virtual World, Sinon
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn.
"【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put that character into your opponent's memory."
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.)
flavor: Corrected? I thought the Fluctlights only observed each other, but they were given that kind of authority?

name: "Truce" Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character at the bottom of his or her deck.
【AUTO】 Bond/"Brilliant Female Knight, Alice" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Brilliant Female Knight, Alice" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Alice: "Return it to me washed, before I slay you."

name: Departure from Rulid Village, Kirito
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 Bond/""Kirito's Partner" Eugeo" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""Kirito's Partner" Eugeo" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Eugeo: "The wind feels a little damp. We should probably get going now."

name: Spurring on a Best Friend, Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 Experience If ""Eternal Ice and the Rose" Eugeo" is in your level, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Stay Cool" is placed on your climax area, if this card is on your center stage, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, put up to 2 cards from the top of your deck into your stock."
flavor: Kirito. I know you can stand again.

name: To the Cave in the North, Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, all of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. Draw up to X cards, choose X cards in your hand, and put them into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of climax revealed among those cards ×2.
flavor: There's ice! There's ice here!

name: Zephilia Buds, Kirito
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 2 of your 《Fluctlight》 characters] Choose 1 card in your level and 1 card in your waiting room, and exchange them.
flavor: (Along the way, I'd started identifying with these flowers that are fighting so hard to bloom in foreign soil.)

name: Former Appearance, Kirito
text: 【CONT】 All of your opponent's characters get "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
flavor: Administrator: "Why do you resist fate like a fool?"

name: Confrontation with PK Squadron, Sinon
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
【AUTO】 Change [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Reliable Reinforcement, Sinon" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on.
flavor: You're up! I'll cover you!

name: "The 32nd Knight" Eugeo Synthesis Thirty-Two
text: 【AUTO】 Experience When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if the total level of cards in your level is 3 or higher, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: I have nothing more to say to you.

name: Suspicious Part-Time Job? Kazuto
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn.
flavor: You think so?

name: Someone Else's Sword Skill, Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: But thank you. For bringing me my sword.

name: Charlotte's Assist
text: 【COUNTER】 If you do not have a 《Fluctlight》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot become 【REVERSE】."

name: "The Demon Tree" Gigas Cedar
text:
If your memory has 2 or less cards, put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Memory Experience [Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your main phase, if this card is in your memory, and the total level of the cards in your level is 5 or higher, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Night-Sky Blade" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Red Rose Sword
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: You can stand as many times as it takes.

name: Night-Sky Blade
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Blue Rose Sword
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Stay Cool
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Glitter of the Water's Surface, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 character attacks, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

name: Glitter of the Water's Surface, Alice
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Right back at you!

name: How a Noble Should Be, Tiese & Ronie
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(2) 【REST】 this card] Put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Tiese: "If war ever breaks out, we must be the first to take up our swords."

name: "The Other Pontifex" Cardinal
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: You're familiar with my original version, are you not?

name: Willowy Body, Administrator
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or at the bottom of your deck.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)
flavor: No metal object of any kind can damage my skin now.

name: Glitter of the Water's Surface, Eugeo & Kirito
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or at the bottom of your deck.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Eugeo: "Let's see how you like it!"

name: "Because We Were Together" Kirito & Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Fluctlight》, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step.
flavor: Eugeo: "I know already. Stay cool, right?"

name: "Memories That Shouldn't Exist" Alice
text:
【CONT】 All of your other ""Memories That Shouldn't Exist" Eugeo" get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 Bond/""Memories That Shouldn't Exist" Eugeo" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""Memories That Shouldn't Exist" Eugeo" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)

name: Dazzling Gold, Alice
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【AUTO】 When a climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Hey! What are you two whispering about?

name: Seeking Ice, Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor:
In the end, the Integrity Knights came from Centoria
and drove them away, right?

name: Hard Worker, Selka
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Eugeo: "After Alice was gone, she moved into the church to become a nun and to study the sacred arts."

name: "The Osmanthus Knight" Alice Synthesis Thirty
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot side attack.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Fluctlight》 characters you have ×1000.
flavor:
I am the overseer of the capital city of Centoria,
an Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church… Alice Synthesis Thirty.

name: "Female Childhood Friend" Alice
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters you have.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent." (Damage may be canceled)

name: Crime Committed by Fingertips
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: Right Hand Self to Left
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
flavor: (So Selka's transferring my life and her own?)

name: Somber Expression, Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, your other character in the middle position of the center stage gets +1500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, draw up to 1 card.
flavor:
I was hoping that
I'd be able to swing this sword one day.

name: Seeking Ice, Kirito
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +1 level and +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: That's it! Ice! Let's go search for ice!

name: "Primary Trainee" Eugeo & Kirito
text: 【CONT】 If your stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
flavor: Eugeo: "Some things never change, huh, Kirito?"

name: "Carver of the Giant Tree" Kirito
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Why are you such a goody-goody?

name: Lunch Time, Eugeo
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
flavor: The pie sure tastes awesome today!

name: Fate Beginning to Change, Eugeo
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Adventure of the Past" is in your climax area, and you have another 《Fluctlight》 character, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: I will become a swordsman!

name: "Carver of the Giant Tree" Eugeo
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor:
After all, it's our Calling
to cut down the Gigas Cedar.

name: "Lost Child of Vecta" Kirito
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
flavor: Where... am I?

name: Stacia Window
text: Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, put them on the top of your deck in the original order, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

name: Adventure of the Past
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Kirito: "What Bercouli supposedly tried to steal. It must be the Blue Rose Sword."

name: Together With a Memory, Asuna & Yuuki
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your stock into your clock & Put this card into your memory] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Yuuki: "I'll always be by your side."

name: Where the Soul Is, Alice
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Our Memories Are Here" is in your climax area, put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock, and reveal the top card of your deck. If that card has [SOUL] in its trigger icon, you may put it into your hand. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: These sensations flooding my heart are real!

name: Joint Battle, Asuna & Alice
text:
【CONT】 If your waiting room has 2 or less climax, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card gets +1500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Fluctlight》 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to X cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 card from among them, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters you have.
flavor: Alice: "Don't overdo it, Asuna."

name: Unbending Fighting Spirit, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Memory [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "《Mother's Rosario》" is in your climax area, and "Together With a Memory, Asuna & Yuuki" is in your memory, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top 11 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and deal 1 damage to your opponent X times. X is equal to the number of climax among those cards. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: To someone like you, who only knows how to hate... I will never lose!

name: 《Priestess of Light》 Alice
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "New World" is in your climax area, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, when damage dealt by this card is canceled, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room, and deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the level of that card +1. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Leave the rest to us, the Integrity Knights.

name: Splitting Sound of the Sword, Alice
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 marker underneath this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your climax phase, if you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and return it to their hand.
【AUTO】 When your character's trigger check reveals a climax with [ICON:RETURN] in its trigger icon, if there are no markers underneath this card, you may look at the top card of your deck. If you do, put that card face down underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Bloom, my flowers!

name: Charming Figure, Alice
text:
【CONT】 If you have another "Splitting Sound of the Sword, Alice", all of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 5 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax with [ICON:RETURN] in its trigger icon revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I win, right?

name: Street Pin-up, Asuna & Alice
text:
【CONT】 If your stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and move it to another open position of their center stage.
flavor: Asuna: "It's a really long story."

name: Are These Two Rivals? Asuna & Alice
text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.

name: 《Goddess of Creation Stacia》 Asuna
text: 【CONT】 Memory If "Together With a Memory, Asuna & Yuuki" is in your memory, this card gets the following 2 abilities. "【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +3000 power." "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room]"
flavor: I'll create another fissure and isolate the enemy.

name: Uneasy Night, Alice
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, your opponent puts all of their stock into their waiting room, and puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock.
flavor: Kirito. I... feel I might wither away.

name: To Kirito's Side, Asuna
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Night-Sky-Clad Hero, Kirito" get the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at the top card of your deck, put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn."
【AUTO】 Bond/"Night-Sky-Clad Hero, Kirito" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Night-Sky-Clad Hero, Kirito" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Where? Where are you, Kirito?

name: Time to Part, Alice
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
flavor: Father, please take care of everyone, and of Selka and Mother.

name: Her Hometown's Skies, Alice
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, all characters in your opponent's center stage get -X power until end of turn, you return all cards from your waiting room to your deck, and shuffle your deck. X is equal to the number of climax in your waiting room ×500.
flavor: Shall we head back?

name: Endless Summer by the Beach, Alice & Asuna
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Fluctlight》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)

name:
Oceanic Resource Exploration
& Research Institution, Rinko
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 3 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, you may choose 1 of your opponent's level 2 or lower characters, and put it into their waiting room.

name: Sisters' Private Time, Selka & Alice
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, search your deck for up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Selka: "Really. You're such a worrywart."

name: "As Long as I Can Wield a Sword" Alice
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
flavor: What else would one do in a training hall?

name: Alice on a Summer Day
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 2 cards in your hand, put them into your waiting room, and put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on an open position of their stage.
flavor: In that case, I'd like you to show me around this house first.

name: Asuna on a Summer Day
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters among those cards ×1000.
【AUTO】 During this card's battle, when the damage you received is canceled, you may return this card to your hand.
flavor: Please join us.

name: 《Niemon》
text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your waiting room.
flavor: Kayaba: "My dream... to connect the two worlds that are still divided."

name: Genius Engineer, Higa
text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 cost 0 or lower character with "Kirito(キリト)" or "Kazuto(和人)" in its card name in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage.
flavor:
You'll be using the superuser account -1,
Stacia, the Goddess of Creation, 'kay?

name: Lieutenant Colonel of the Ground Self-Defense Force, Kikuoka
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I'll see to it that Kirito recovers, no matter what.

name: 《Unlimited Landscape Alteration》 Asuna
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "A God or Something Else?" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, and you have 4 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets -2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: My name is Asuna. I'm a human being, just like you.

name: Beyond Time, Asuna
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Fluctlight》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Even if it were a thousand years, it wouldn't feel like a long time. If I'm with you.

name: "Memories Will Never Vanish" Asuna
text: 【CONT】 During your turn, this card gets +10000 power.
flavor: Even if our memories are gone, the memories will never vanish.

name: "Assure Me" Asuna
text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 4500, Level 2 [(2) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +4500 power until end of turn)
flavor: Of course I'll go. With you. I'll go wherever you go. No matter where!

name: Cloned Soul
text: Choose in your waiting room, 1 character with the same card name as a character in your stage or your opponent's stage, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Kirito: "This is Mr. Higa, I presume?"

name: Our Memories Are Here
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

name: 《Mother's Rosario》
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Yuuki: "Now stand, Asuna. To protect what you love."

name: New World
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I have returned.

name: A God or Something Else?
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: I'll build a bridge over the chasm.

name: As His Little Sister, Leafa
text:
【CONT】 Your other character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor:
Because I'm... Big Brother's...
Kirito the Black Swordsman's... little sister!

name: Integrity Knight, Eldrie
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Integrity Knight》 or 《Noble》 characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects."
【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] When your other 《Integrity Knight》 or 《Noble》 character is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to your hand.
flavor: I, Eldrie, shall never forget as long as I live the secret sword skills and techniques you taught me.

name: Reliable Juniors, Tiese & Ronie
text:
【CONT】 This card cannot be chosen by your opponent's effects.
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Integrity Knight》 or 《Noble》 characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to the number of markers underneath this card ×1000.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your "Shattered Self-Image, Kirito", and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
flavor: Tiese: "Let's guard the entrance."

name: Unexpected Reinforcements, Yuna & Eiji
text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your stock into your clock] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 level 1 or lower character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Yuna: "Let's do this, Eiji!"

name: 《Earth Goddess Terraria》 Leafa
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters you have ×500.

"【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand."
flavor: I'll take care of this, all right?

name: Commander of the Integrity Knights, Bercouli
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room & Put this card into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "The Time-Splitting Sword Uragiri" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock, and deal 4 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Have no fear, boy.

name: No Discrimination, Leafa
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all characters in your opponent's center stage get -500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Um, good afternoon. Or should it be good morning?

name: Lively Smile, Ronie
text:
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Fluctlight》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm At the beginning of your climax phase, if this card is the top card of your clock, and you have 3 or more 《Fluctlight》 characters, you may draw 1 card. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: We promise to protect Kirito, no matter what.

name: Miraculous Wish, Tiese
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 Memory When this card attacks, if there is a card in your memory, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I just... heard... Eugeo-senpai's voice.

name: Integrity Knight, Linel
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot be returned to hand or put into memory."
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
flavor: Along with that rebel, Kirito, right?

name: Integrity Knight, Fizel
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all players perform the following action. "If your memory has 5 or more cards, choose 4 cards in your memory, and put all cards in your memory except those cards into your waiting room."
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or 《Fluctlight》 character, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: The Supply Corps is behind the left flank, isn't it?

name: Manly Leader, Bercouli
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1000 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 [(2) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When a climax is placed on your opponent's climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character facing this card, and put it into your opponent's waiting room.
flavor: I'll be joining the raid unit.

name: Vice Commander of the Integrity Knights, Fanatio
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have 4 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, you may choose 1 《Fluctlight》 character in your waiting room, and put it into your stock.
flavor: Bercouli: "I'll leave the rest to you. To give our child a happy life."

name: Integrity Knight, Renly
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 other character from your stage into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, move this card to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: If it's my head you want, be ready to lay down your lives for it!

name: Overlapping Traces, Yuna

If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."

name: Integrity Knight, Sheyta
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have another character, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
【CONT】 The character facing this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore [(2)]".
flavor: Well, that's the spirit... then.

name: Revived Imposing Appearance, Eiji
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and return it to your hand.

name: Revived Imposing Appearance, Eiji
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I'm... the Knights of the Blood Oath's... Nautilus!

name: 《Unlimited Automatic Regeneration》 Leafa
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put the top card of your deck into your clock, and 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Because we're comrades, aren't we?

name: Pajama Party, Sortiliena
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if all of your characters are 《Fluctlight》, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

name: Full of Spirit, Leafa
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Fluctlight》 characters you have ×1000.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, choose 1 of your other 《Fluctlight》 characters, 【REST】 it, and move it to an open position of your back stage.
flavor: It won't be a problem to cut down all these enemies myself.

name: Integrity Knight, Deusolbert
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more "Commander of the Integrity Knights, Bercouli" in your waiting room, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Integrity Knight》 or 《Noble》 characters, this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all of your opponent's characters get -1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Those who stand before me, you shall burn so not even your bones remain!

name: Evil Should Be Slashed
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: It's not that.

name: The Time-Splitting Sword Uragiri
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: The Time-Splitting Sword Uragiri is the sword that slashes time.

name: Administrator Living On in Memories
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put this card into your clock] When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: This is the me that exists in your memory.

name: Affiliated With the Dark Knights, Lipia
text:
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, choose 1 level X or lower 《Dark Territory》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the total level of those cards. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: Yes, my lord.

name: Dark God Vecta
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
flavor: ALICE, your soul... will be so sweet!

name: Incarnation of Nihilism, Gabriel
text:
【CONT】 If this card is in your center stage, all of your 《Dark Territory》 characters get +1500 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Blade of Nihilism" is in your climax area, choose any number of 《Dark Territory》 characters in your hand, put them into your waiting room, deal X damage to your opponent, choose up to 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on top of their deck. X is equal to the number of characters put into your waiting room by this effect. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: It seems he's afraid now.

name: Persuasion to "Convert", Lisbeth
text:
【AUTO】 When your other character with "Convert(コンバート)" in its card name is placed on the stage from your waiting room, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or at the bottom of your deck.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 2 or higher, put it into your stock. (Otherwise, return it to its original place. Climax are regarded as level 0)
flavor: This world, as well as the countless virtual worlds connected to it, in no way are they make-believe refuges!

name: Agitator of the Opposition, Vassago
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your attack phase, choose 1 of your 《Dark Territory》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of characters with the same card name as that card ×500.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 2 of your characters] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 2 "Swarm of Red Copper, Dark Knights" in your waiting room, and return them to your hand.
flavor: He's been the only thing I want.

name: PoH
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Preaching of Hatred" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, and you have another 《Dark Territory》 character, you may choose 1 of your opponent's level 1 or higher characters. If you do, your opponent chooses 1 level X or lower character in their waiting room, and exchanges them. X is equal to the level of the character you chose -1.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of characters your opponent has ×500.
flavor: I'm glad you remember it.

name: Chance Meeting, Subtilizer
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Fluctlight》 characters, this card gets +3000 power.
