【CONT】 You can put up to 7 cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.
【COUNTER】 If you do not have a 《Deadly Sin》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Deadly Sin》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Full Counter
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Incredible Power
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gilthunder: Magic Words
text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Britannia》 character, you may put it face down underneath this card as a marker. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage with a character facing this card.
flavor: I am now more powerful than any of the Seven Deadly Sins.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Cheerful
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Britannia》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 During your turn, if all of your characters are 《Britannia》, this card gets +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your clock into your stock.
flavor: Yep! It’s me!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: Wielder of Chastiefol
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, if "Versatile Weapon" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top 6 cards of your deck into your waiting room, deal 1 damage to your opponent X times, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of climax among those cards. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: Who did this? Who did such terrible things to Diane?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King & Oslo: Away From the Bustle
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Britannia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: For a Special Someone
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: I happen to have a special objective, which is to help Diane out.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Childhood
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other 《Britannia》 characters, and the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn.
flavor: That's why I'm so glad I got to meet you, Harlequin.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Twirling Her Hair
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +500 power and the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock."
flavor: I wish I could be small like you...
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gilthunder: Smile of Relief
text:
【CONT】 If you have 4 or more 《Britannia》 characters, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 1 "Broken Curse" from your climax area into your waiting room] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 4 《Britannia》 characters from among them, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: You've released me from a curse that’s imprisoned me for years.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Wielder of Gideon
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, your opponent puts all of their stock into their waiting room, and puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock.
【AUTO】 When your other 《Britannia》 character attacks, this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: I know we'll be able to take back the kingdom.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Hypnotized
text:
【CONT】 If this card is in your stage, this card gets 《Holy Knight》.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 2 《Britannia》 characters from among them, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: I'm gonna tell you here and now I'm not losing to some Holy Knight!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: Unrecognizable
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", if you have a 《Britannia》 character, choose 1 of your characters in battle, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Ban: "On what planet is THAT supposed to be King?!"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Convincing Threat
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other 《Britannia》 characters get +1000 power.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your climax phase, choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Would you rather have this done to you at the hands of the Holy Knights, or by us?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: Incident of the Past
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if you have another 《Britannia》 character, this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to that character's soul ×1000.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gilthunder: Negative Little Gil
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, put them on the top of your deck in any order, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, and return it to their hand.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
flavor: I’m never gonna make it.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Helbram: Actual Form
text:
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, perform the following action. "Search your deck for up to 1 《Britannia》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, put it into your waiting room, and shuffle your deck."
flavor: Howzer: "A fairy?"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Margaret: Sacrificing Herself
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Gilthunder: Smile of Relief" get +1000 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play event cards or "Backup" from their hands."
【AUTO】 Bond/"Gilthunder: Smile of Relief" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Gilthunder: Smile of Relief" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)
flavor: Vivian: "I'll have you know Princess Margaret entered that cell of her own volition."
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Tough Giant
text:
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 1 "Last Minute Save" from your climax area into your waiting room] At the beginning of your encore step, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Britannia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Giants are a lot tougher than any of you puny little humans give us credit for!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: Breakdown
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Britannia》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock."
flavor: What did... What did you do to my friend Helbram?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Veronica: Sacrificing Herself
text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When your other character with "Elizabeth" in its card name is put into your waiting room from the stage, if this card is in your back stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return that character to its previous stage position as as 【REST】.
flavor: Elizabeth: "Don’t leave me! Veronicaaaa!"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Griamore: Loyal Bodyguard
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 character in your opponent's back stage with level higher than your opponent's level. That character cannot 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Helbram: Last Request to a Friend
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is cost 0 or lower, you may put the top card of your opponent's clock into their waiting room. If you do, put that character into your opponent's clock.
【ACT】 [【REST】 2 of your characters] Choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
flavor: While I’m still... me... please... just kill me...
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Bartra: Benevolent Ruler
text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Britannia》 characters, and return it to your hand.
flavor: From today forward, you shall not rest in your service of the kingdom.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Diane: Cowering
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Britannia》 characters you have ×1000.
【AUTO】 When this card's level 2 or higher battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: Bugs are the one thing I can't stand!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: King: Presentable Appearance
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Britannia》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Britannia》 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Hello, I am King the Grizzly Sin, of the Seven Deadly Sins.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Goddess Amber
text:
If you do not have a 《Britannia》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand.
Choose 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters, and put it into their memory.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Last Minute Save
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Broken Curse
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 level 1 or lower character in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Versatile Weapon
text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
flavor: Chastiefol, fifth configuration… Increase!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Merlin: Surprise Reveal
text:
【CONT】 Your other 《Britannia》 character in the middle position of your center stage gets +500 power.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: You’re always losing your head and getting into a rage. Thought I told you to kick that habit.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: For a Special Someone
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 《Britannia》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: I'll call on 'em and have 'em bring back Elaine.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Elaine: Facing a Demon
text:
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Britannia》 characters, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Fountain of Youth" is in your climax area, and you have another 《Britannia》 character, look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Britannia》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
flavor: Nothing can burn the Fairy King's Forest but the flames of Purgatory.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Ready to Kill
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Britannia》 characters you have ×500.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: I don’t want you to suffer, so don't resist.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Elaine: Guarding the Spring
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Britannia》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 [Put 1 《Britannia》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw 1 card.
flavor: Ban: "Are you lost, little girl, is that the deal?"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: Holding His Head Up
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Britannia》 characters among those cards ×1000.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Britannia》 character in your waiting room, return it to your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Now where are my glasses?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: Mind Manipulator
text:
【CONT】 The character facing this card cannot move to another position of the stage.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, this card gets +1500 power until end of turn.
flavor: Humans can be so fragile.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: True Identity
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(1)] When "Putting an End" is placed on your climax area, if this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your other 《Britannia》 characters, and 【STAND】 it.
flavor: I am the Goat Sin of Lust, Gowther.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Merlin: Joining the Party
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +2000 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: See, the Boar Sin Merlin is going to be tagging along if that’s okay with you.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: Wielder of Harlit
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Britannia》 characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 face up card in your opponent's memory, and put it face down. If you do, at the end of your turn, put that card face up.
flavor: Now, Rewrite Light!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Merlin: Superior Skills
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 character with level equal to or lower than your level in your hand, put it on any position of your stage, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, put it into their memory, and your opponent puts that character from their memory on any position of their stage.
flavor: Meliodas: "How’d you get rid of the spell, like that?"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Fresh Out of Prison
text:
【CONT】 If your stock has 2 or less cards, this card gets +1500 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [(1) Put 1 character from your stage into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Do ya think I had ya take off too much?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Merlin: Hooded Magician
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Britannia》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)
flavor: Arthur: "You got here just in time to save me! Thanks!"
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Rage
text:
【CONT】 If you do not have another 《Britannia》 character, this card cannot 【STAND】 during your stand phase.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 2 or more other 《Britannia》 characters, choose 1 character facing this card, and until end of turn, that character gets -1000 power and this card gets +1000 power.
flavor: Hey, Hendy... Wouldja’ mind tellin’ me where you found that thing?
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: Sinister Shadow
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Britannia》 characters.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Guila: "His love for me and my love for him is what must have protected me."
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Facing a Demon
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [(2)] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, if "Fountain of Youth" is in your climax area, and you have 4 or more other 《Britannia》 characters, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 3 damage to your opponent, and put that character on the top of your opponent's deck. (Damage may be canceled)
flavor: What the hell is that...?!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Armor Giant
text:
【CONT】 All of your other "Gowther: Forcibly Silenced" get +1500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 《Britannia》 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When your other "Gowther: Forcibly Silenced" is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock.
flavor: Alan: "Birds approach vegetation in order to gather food or find a resting spot."
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Gowther: Unassuming Disguise
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your 《Britannia》 characters, and that character gets +500 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Reunion
text:
【CONT】 If you have another "Meliodas: Reunion", this card gets +3000 power.
【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)
flavor: Captaaain...!
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Ban: Striking a Deal
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 《Britannia》 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 2 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: I want you to revive Elaine, and in exchange, take my life.
copyright: ©Nakaba Suzuki, KODANSHA/The Seven Deadly Sins Project, MBS. All Rights Reserved.

name: Elaine: Left Behind
text:

text:

name: Reason to Go on a Journey, Frieren
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 characters get +1500 power.

flavor: They gave me the courage to travel and taught me the joy of spending time with friends.

name: Tired of Waiting, Eisen
text:
【CONT】 If all of your characters are 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.

text:

text:

flavor: So I decided I'd prove him wrong by becoming a real hero.

text:

text: 【CONT】 Memory During your turn, if there is a card in your memory, this card gets +2500 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if the character facing this card is level 2, this card gets +6000 power until end of turn."

text:

text:

If you put 1 card into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Frieren: "It's dark and scary in here!"

text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room. If there is a climax among those cards, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: The quality of a mage is irrelevant.

name: Words of Deceit, Lügner
text:
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or an 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 character, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
【AUTO】 【CLOCK】 Alarm If this card is the top card of your clock, and your level is 1 or higher, at the beginning of your climax phase, you may choose 1 of your characters and this card, and exchange them.
flavor: I've kept my father's room the same since you killed him, too.

name: "Imitation Magic" Linie
text: 【CONT】 If you have 4 or more other 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 characters, this card gets +4500 power.

text:

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is "Magic That Subjugates Opponents" or an 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 character, you may choose 1 of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters, and put it into their waiting room. (Return the revealed card to its original place)

text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your level 3 or higher characters in front of this card get +2000 power.
【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 "Magic That Subjugates Opponents" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
flavor: Then that's all the more reason not to do this.

name: Solar Dragon
text:
【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each other 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 character in your back stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, your opponent reveals up to 3 cards from the top of their deck, chooses up to 1 event from among them, puts it into their hand, and puts the rest into their waiting room.

text: 【COUNTER】 If you have 1 or less 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 characters, this card cannot be played from your hand. Choose up to 1 "Aura the Guillotine" in your waiting room, return it to your hand or put it into your stock, choose up to 3 of your opponent's characters, and those characters get the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot become 【REVERSE】."
flavor: I win.

name: Phantom Magic
text: If you do not have an 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 character, this card cannot be played from your hand. Choose up to 3 characters in your opponent's center stage, and those characters get -2000 power until end of turn. Put this card into your memory.
flavor: I decided to pay you a visit because you've been a good girl.

name: Scales of Obedience
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [TREASURE] : When this card triggers, return this card to your hand. You may put the top card of your deck into your stock)
flavor: Either way, you are no match for me.

name: Cowardly and Unfair Way to Fight
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
( [TREASURE] : When this card triggers, return this card to your hand. You may put the top card of your deck into your stock)

name: Mirrored Lotus Bracelet, Fern
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 2 cards from among them, put them on the top of your deck in any order, and put the rest into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may 【REVERSE】 that character.
flavor: You put a lot of effort into choosing this gift for me. Don't ever say that again.

name: Clumsy Birthday, Stark
text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Put 1 "Privilege of the Young" from your climax area into your waiting room] At the beginning of your attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【STAND】 this card, choose up to 1 "Clumsy Birthday, Fern" in your waiting room, put it in any position of your stage, choose 1 of the following effects, and perform it. "This card gets "【CONT】 Great Performance" until the end of your opponent's next turn." "Choose up to 1 card in your waiting room, and put it into your stock."
flavor: My master never gave me any gifts, but he did make me birthday hamburg steaks.

name: Social Gathering, Fern
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is an event or an 《Adventurer》 or 《Magic》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When a climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: This past month has been hell.

name: Fern & Stark
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card attacks, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step. If performed 2 times, put the top card of your stock into your waiting room."

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all players perform the following action. "If your memory has 5 or more cards, choose 4 cards in your memory, and put all cards in your memory except those cards into your waiting room."
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 climax from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Changing the Tides of Battle, Draken
text:
【AUTO】 When you use this card's "Backup", reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Revenge》 character, put it into your hand, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2500 power until end of turn)
flavor: I'm going to protect all of you.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: No Matter How Many Times I Fail, Takemichi
text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your 《Revenge》 characters in front of this card get +2000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 《Revenge》 character from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is frontal attacked, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card cannot become 【REVERSE】 until end of turn."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, put them on the top of your deck in any order, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, and return it to their hand.
flavor: In the future... In the past... Always and forever... I've always loved you!
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Kid's Meal, Mikey
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 《Revenge》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.
【AUTO】 [Put all markers underneath this card at the bottom of your deck in any order] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 1 damage X times to your opponent. X is equal to the number of markers put at the bottom of your deck for the cost of this ability. (Damage may be canceled)
【AUTO】 [(1)] At the beginning of the encore step, if you do not have another 【REST】 character in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card.
flavor: Way to go, Ken-chin!
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Having It the Hardest, Mikey
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your opponent's characters, and that character gets the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn. "【CONT】 This card cannot move to another position of the stage."
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if this card's battle opponent is level 0 or lower, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
flavor: He promised me... that we'd rule the world together.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Hooked on the Occult, Naoto
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is level 1 or higher, you may put this card into your stock. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Birthday Present, Emma & Draken
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, all characters in your opponent's center stage get -500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 《Revenge》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavor: Happy birthday.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: You Always Turn Up Suddenly, Hina
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, all of your other characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] If there are no markers underneath this card, choose 1 "Clover Necklace" or 《Revenge》 character in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Return 1 marker underneath this card to your hand.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Successful Surgery, Hina & Emma
text:
【AUTO】 When your climax is placed on your climax area, choose 1 of your 《Revenge》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When "Hope It Goes Well" is placed on your climax area, put the top card of your deck into your waiting room. If that card is a 《Revenge》 character, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. When this card attacks, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Half-Siblings, Emma & Mikey
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to 1 level 0 or lower character, put it on any position of your stage, and shuffle your deck.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Please Save Everyone, Akkun
text:
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if you have 2 or less cards in your memory, you may put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is higher than your opponent's level, you may put that character into your opponent's stock. If you do, put the bottom card of your opponent's stock into their waiting room.
flavor: Please save everyone... Our crybaby hero.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Friends Starting Today, Takemichi & Mikey
text:
【CONT】 All of your other 《Revenge》 characters get +500 power.
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Choose 1 of your opponent's level 1 or higher characters, your opponent chooses 1 level X or lower character in their waiting room, and exchanges them. X is equal to the level of the character you chose -1.
flavor: Are you... really in middle school?
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Caring Towards Comrades, Akkun
text:
【CONT】 If "Thanks for the Courage, Takemichi" is in your clock, this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If you have 2 or more other 《Revenge》 characters, this card gets +3000 power.
【CONT】 【CXCOMBO】 If "Mizo Middle Five" is in your climax area, this card is in your center stage, and you have 2 or more other 《Revenge》 characters, your other "Thanks for the Courage, Takemichi" and "Caring Towards Comrades, Akkun" and "Childhood Friend, Takuya" and "Preoccupied with Perversions, Makoto" and "Mood Maker, Yamagishi" in all of your zones get [CHOICE] in the trigger icon.
flavor: Dreams? Maybe becoming a hairstylist?
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Trigger, Naoto
text: 【CONT】 Experience If the total level of the cards in your level is 3 or higher, all of your other 《Revenge》 characters get +X power. X is equal to that character's level ×500.
flavor: You traveled through time!
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Mood Maker, Yamagishi
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 card in your clock, and return it to your hand. If you do, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your clock.
【AUTO】 At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, if there is a character facing this card, you may move this card to an open position of your center stage.
flavor: You don't need to act like you're scared!
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Shampoo Hat, Draken
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your waiting room, and this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of 《Revenge》 characters among those cards ×1000.
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose 1 of your other 《Revenge》 characters, and that character gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of other 《Revenge》 characters you have ×500.
flavor: Quit messing around in a public bath.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Childhood Friend, Takuya
flavor: When I win, you better treat me to some gyudon.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Bathhouse Buddies, Mikey
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a 《Revenge》 character, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -6000 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Boo♡ !
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Preoccupied with Perversions, Makoto
text:
【CONT】 During your turn, if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +4000 power and the following ability. "【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, during that attack, perform a trigger check 2 times on the trigger step."
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may choose 1 "Childhood Friend, Takuya" in your waiting room, and put it face up underneath this card as a marker.

name: Reason Behind His Maturity, Draken
text: 【CONT】 This card gets +1500 power for each character in your opponent's back stage.
flavor: It's actually pretty cozy.

name: Cheerful Tone, Hina
text: 【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal 1 "Thanks for the Courage, Takemichi" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +4000 power until end of turn.
flavor: Bye-bye!

name: Hopeless Freeter, Takemichi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, put this card into your waiting room, and reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a character, put it on the stage position that this card was on as the defending character. (Otherwise, return it to its original place)

name: Way of the Delinquent, Draken
text:
【CONT】 【CXCOMBO】 If "The "Heart" That Cares for Others" is in your climax area, this card in all of your zones gets [STANDBY] in the trigger icon.
【CONT】 If your stock has 5 or less cards, this card gets +4000 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: New Era for Delinquents, Mikey
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Resonate [(3) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room & Reveal 1 "New Era for Delinquents, Mikey" in your hand] At the end of this card's attack, if "New Era for Delinquents" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your opponent's deck, choose up to 3 characters with X or lower total power from among them, put them into their clock in any order, and put the rest into their waiting room. X is equal to the power of this card.
flavor: What's so lame about that?
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Everyday Lives, Mikey & Draken
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.
【AUTO】 [(3) Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, deal 2 damage to your opponent, choose up to 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of their deck. (Damage may be canceled)
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: My Treasure, Baji
text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] During your opponent's turn, when this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 this card, and at the beginning of your next encore step, put this card into your memory.
【ACT】 [(1) Put this card into your waiting room] Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Revenge》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Older Brother Figure, Mitsuya
text:
【AUTO】 Resonate [Reveal 1 "New Era for Delinquents, Mikey" in your hand] At the beginning of your climax phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose up to 2 of your 《Revenge》 characters, and those characters get +500 power until end of turn.
【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, choose up to 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Just a Scratch, Baji
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's characters, put it into their memory, and your opponent puts that character from their memory on any position of their stage.
【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, you may reveal up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. If you revealed 1 or more cards, choose up to 1 《Revenge》 character from among them, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, choose 1 card in your hand, and put it into your waiting room.
flavor: Take care of Mikey for me.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Draken & Mikey & Takemichi
text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand or put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Let's Split Halves, Baji & Chifuyu
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 of your other 《Revenge》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Return this card to your hand] When your climax is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1 soul until end of turn.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: See? There's No One! Mikey
text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."
【AUTO】 When this card attacks, reveal the top of your deck. If that card is a 《Revenge》 character, all of your characters get +1500 power until end of turn. (Return the revealed card to its original place)
flavor: Anyone scared because Pah's bud got beat up?
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Commander, Mikey
text:
【AUTO】 [Put 2 cards from your hand into your waiting room] When you use this card's "Backup", you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your opponent's characters with level higher than your opponent's level, and put it into their memory.
【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1000, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn)
flavor: I'm out of dorayaki.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Can't Promise It, Chifuyu & Baji
text:

name: Can't Hit Ya, Chifuyu

name: I'm Never Going to Back Down! Takemichi
text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, this card gets +X power until end of turn. X is equal to the number of "Light of the 1st Division, Chifuyu" in your waiting room ×3000.

name: The Only Way is Attacking, Draken
text:
【CONT】 Memory If your memory has 2 or more "Becoming a Man That's Fitting, Takemichi", this card gets -1 level while in your hand.
【CONT】 If this card is in your center stage, all of your 《Revenge》 characters get +1500 power.
flavor: Are you friggin' serious?
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: Unwavering Loyalty, Chifuyu
text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to 2 cards, choose 2 cards in your hand, put them into your waiting room, and put up to 1 card from the top of your deck into your stock.
【AUTO】 [(3)] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, your opponent puts all of their stock into their waiting room, and puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock.
copyright: ©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.

name: 5th Division Captain, Mucho
text: 【AUTO】 [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck, choose 1 level X or lower character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand. X is equal to the level of the revealed card. (Climax are regarded as level 0. Return the revealed card to its original place)

name: Becoming a Man That's Fitting, Takemichi

name: Sin and Punishment, Hanma
text:
